blocks.en: From scratch, we developed the assay across agar, hydroponic, and soil systems, using defined stress treatments and untreated controls to compare plant response. A salt ladder established the working stress range for later experiments, and the CH Bio peptide produced our clearest rescue at 100 mM NaCl. The assay also helped refine the protocol itself, including transplanting established seedlings into hydroponics and checking bacterial preparations before plant application.

blocks.en: We cultivated Arabidopsis thaliana using three experimental systems, agar plates, hydroponic boxes and soil pots, to evaluate the effects of our bioprotectants under different growing conditions. Each system offered a different balance between experimental control and environmental realism: agar plates provided highly controlled conditions, soil more closely represented natural growing environments, and hydroponics offered an intermediate approach.
blocks.text: We cultivated Arabidopsis thaliana using three experimental systems, agar plates, hydroponic boxes and soil pots, to evaluate the effects of our bioprotectants under different growing conditions. Each system offered a different balance between experimental control and environmental realism: agar plates provided highly controlled conditions, soil more closely represented natural growing environments, and hydroponics offered an intermediate approach.
blocks.zh: 我們以三套實驗系統培養 Arabidopsis thaliana（阿拉伯芥）：瓊脂培養盤、水耕箱與土壤盆，用來評估我們的生物保護劑在不同生長條件下的效果。每套系統在實驗控制與環境真實性之間有不同的取捨：瓊脂培養盤提供高度控制的條件，土壤較接近自然的生長環境，水耕則介於兩者之間。

blocks.en: All three systems followed the same six-step experimental framework, with adjustments to the cultivation setup, bioprotectant application methods, and measurable plant responses according to the characteristics of each system.

blocks.en: To synchronize the germination of Arabidopsis thaliana seedlings and isolate the phenotypic effects of the stressor from baseline developmental variations, we did 4 days of stratification at 4 °C, which ensures homogeneous growth of the plants. Seed stratification suppresses the master dormancy gene DELAY OF GERMINATION 1 (DOG1) and its downstream regulators. This overcomes the genetic brakes holding back germination, shifting the hormonal balance from abscisic acid (ABA) to gibberellins (GA) and causing the enzymatic weakening of the seed coat, which allows the radicle to emerge [12].
blocks.text: To synchronize the germination of Arabidopsis thaliana seedlings and isolate the phenotypic effects of the stressor from baseline developmental variations, we did 4 days of stratification at 4 °C, which ensures homogeneous growth of the plants. Seed stratification suppresses the master dormancy gene DELAY OF GERMINATION 1 (DOG1) and its downstream regulators. This overcomes the genetic brakes holding back germination, shifting the hormonal balance from abscisic acid (ABA) to gibberellins (GA) and causing the enzymatic weakening of the seed coat, which allows the radicle to emerge [12].
blocks.zh: 為了讓 Arabidopsis thaliana 苗的發芽同步，並把逆境因子造成的表現型效應與發育本身的基礎變異分開，我們在 4 °C 下進行 4 天層積，以確保植物生長一致。種子層積會抑制主要休眠基因 DELAY OF GERMINATION 1（DOG1）及其下游調控因子，解除壓住發芽的遺傳煞車，使激素平衡由離層酸（ABA）轉向激勃素（GA），並使種皮在酵素作用下變弱，讓胚根得以突出 [12]。

blocks.en: We moved seedlings from the 4 °C refrigerator to grow in the 22 °C, 60% RH growth chamber (the day of transfer is counted as day 0 for salinity agar). Newly germinated Arabidopsis seedlings have fragile cotyledons and underdeveloped root systems that cannot immediately withstand harsh stress conditions. Pre-growing them for a set time under a controlled environment allows the greening of cotyledons, the establishment of true leaves, and the elongation of the primary root system.

blocks.en: Agar trials were conducted to fine-tune protectant treatments and NaCl stress within a controlled laboratory environment, ensuring uniform nutrient availability and precise stress exposure. This setup enabled the evaluation and screening of protectant efficacy, helping identify top performing protectant candidates while establishing clear physiological baselines prior to testing in complex soil systems and hydroponics. Furthermore, agar media provide essential nutrients and an accelerated timeframe for observing early physiological changes in Arabidopsis seedlings, facilitating rapid and high-throughput testing across subsequent experimental iterations.

blocks.zh: 進行瓊脂試驗，是為了在受控的實驗室環境中微調保護劑處理與 NaCl 逆境，確保養分供應一致、逆境暴露精確。這樣的設置讓我們能評估並篩選保護劑的效果，找出表現最好的保護劑候選，同時在進入複雜的土壤系統與水耕測試之前建立清楚的生理基準。此外，瓊脂培養基提供必要養分，也縮短了觀察 Arabidopsis 苗早期生理變化所需的時間，讓後續各輪實驗能快速、高通量地進行。

blocks.en: Targeting salinity stress, which is the toxic ion accumulation in the root zones, we took inspiration from Liu et al. (2020) for the early pretest experiment settings. Col-0 Arabidopsis Thaliana seeds were grown on divided agar plates containing MS medium with either 0 or 100 mM NaCl. Seeds were surface-sterilized with 75% ethanol following 95% ethanol, stratified for 2 days at 4 °C in the dark, and grown at 22 °C under 16h light/8h dark cycle. Salt was built into the medium, so seeds germinated under a fixed 100 mM stress from the start, with no gradual ramp. This set up provided the foundational agar system experimental conditions, yet we continuously revise and optimize the methods. Furthermore, this set up was limited to the early phase 1 experiment on trehalose protectant, following phase 2 and 3, we adjusted experimental conditions depending on the application method and different protectants such as ACCD, AtLEA14, or Bopep4.

blocks.zh: 針對鹽逆境，也就是根圈的毒性離子累積，我們早期預試的實驗設置參考了 Liu et al.（2020）。Col-0 Arabidopsis Thaliana 的種子種在分格瓊脂培養盤上，培養盤含 MS 培養基，NaCl 為 0 或 100 mM。種子先以 95% 乙醇、再以 75% 乙醇進行表面消毒，於 4 °C 黑暗中層積 2 天，再在 22 °C、16 小時光照／8 小時黑暗的週期下生長。鹽直接配進培養基，所以種子從一開始就在固定的 100 mM 逆境下發芽，沒有逐步升高的過程。這個設置提供了瓊脂系統的基礎實驗條件，不過我們持續修訂與最佳化方法。此外，這個設置只用於海藻糖保護劑的早期階段 1 實驗；進入階段 2 與 3 後，我們依施用方式以及 ACCD、AtLEA14 或 Bopep4 等不同保護劑調整實驗條件。

blocks.en: Targeting heat stress, we took inspiration from Auverlot et al. [3] for prolonged thermo-priming assays protocol designing. Initially, seeds are germinated and grown on Murashige and Skoog (MS) agar plates at 22 °C. Once the seedlings are 10 days old, they’re held at 37 °C for 5 days to induce acquired thermotolerance prior to subsequent higher stress damage, and then returned to 22 °C for 5 days of recovery. Following recovery, seedling survival and physiological damage are assessed and analyzed via quantitative readouts: fresh weight and chlorophyll content. Both the agar and soil based thermo priming assays are established based on this foundational framework and methodology, with specific parameters refined to accommodate our experimental setups.
blocks.text: Targeting heat stress, we took inspiration from Auverlot et al. [3] for prolonged thermo-priming assays protocol designing. Initially, seeds are germinated and grown on Murashige and Skoog (MS) agar plates at 22 °C. Once the seedlings are 10 days old, they’re held at 37 °C for 5 days to induce acquired thermotolerance prior to subsequent higher stress damage, and then returned to 22 °C for 5 days of recovery. Following recovery, seedling survival and physiological damage are assessed and analyzed via quantitative readouts: fresh weight and chlorophyll content. Both the agar and soil based thermo priming assays are established based on this foundational framework and methodology, with specific parameters refined to accommodate our experimental setups.
blocks.zh: 針對熱逆境，我們在設計長時間熱預備處理（thermo-priming）檢測的流程時參考了 Auverlot et al. [3]。種子先在 22 °C 的 Murashige and Skoog（MS）瓊脂培養盤上發芽與生長。待苗長到 10 天齡，於 37 °C 維持 5 天，以在後續更強的逆境傷害之前誘導出獲得性耐熱性，然後移回 22 °C 恢復 5 天。恢復期結束後，以定量指標評估並分析苗的存活與生理傷害：鮮重與葉綠素含量。瓊脂與土壤的熱預備處理檢測都建立在這套基礎架構與方法上，並依我們的實驗設置調整具體參數。

blocks.en: At the beginning of the plant trials, we established the experimental protocol and assessed the initial response of the plants to NaCl and to different trehalose concentrations: trehalose at 0, 0.125, 0.5 and 1 mM, and NaCl at 0, 50, 100, 150 and 250 mM. We later observed severe bleaching of the leaves under 250 mM NaCl within 3 days of observation, and 150 mM also led to visible chlorosis; plants in both groups died quickly under osmotic stress. We also noticed that trehalose at both 0.5 and 1 mM suppressed plant growth. This is supported by research: feeding low amounts of trehalose blocks, or feedback-inhibits, the plant’s endogenous trehalose-6-phosphate phosphatases (TPPs). This triggers hyper-accumulation of trehalose-6-phosphate (T6P), which signals a false sugar abundance, disrupts starch allocation and induces developmental arrest [22]. At higher concentrations, the plant significantly upregulates trehalase, the enzyme that breaks trehalose down into glucose. This detoxifies the excess trehalose and prevents the toxic accumulation of T6P, and the released glucose acts as a metabolizable carbon source that rescues the plant from growth arrest. Concurrently, the intact fraction functions as an osmoprotectant, mitigating salt stress. Going forward, we set our plant experiments at 75 and 100 mM NaCl, with trehalose at 0, 5 and 10 mM.

blocks.zh: 植物試驗一開始，我們先建立實驗流程，並評估植物對 NaCl 與不同海藻糖濃度的初步反應：海藻糖為 0、0.125、0.5 與 1 mM，NaCl 為 0、50、100、150 與 250 mM。後來我們看到 250 mM NaCl 下葉片在 3 天觀察期內就嚴重白化，150 mM 也出現明顯黃化；兩組的植物都在滲透逆境下迅速死亡。我們也注意到 0.5 與 1 mM 的海藻糖都抑制植物生長。這一點有研究支持：餵食少量海藻糖會阻斷、或回饋抑制植物內生的海藻糖-6-磷酸磷酸酶（TPPs），導致海藻糖-6-磷酸（T6P）過度累積，發出糖分充足的錯誤訊號，擾亂澱粉的分配，並造成發育停滯 [22]。在較高濃度下，植物會大幅上調海藻糖酶，也就是把海藻糖分解為葡萄糖的酵素。這會解除多餘海藻糖的毒性、避免 T6P 的毒性累積，而釋出的葡萄糖則作為可代謝的碳源，把植物從生長停滯中救回來。同時，未被分解的那一部分則作為滲透保護物質，減緩鹽逆境。接下來，我們把植物實驗設定在 75 與 100 mM NaCl，海藻糖為 0、5 與 10 mM。

blocks.en: From experimental set 7 onwards, we tested protectant effectiveness by application timing. Each experimental set includes a control, a pre-treatment, a co-treatment and a post-treatment group; the pre-treatment and post-treatment groups receive the protectant one day before and one day after the heat or salinity stress, respectively. With this application schedule we can test whether a protectant has to be applied before the stress surge, which is the role of our bioreactor, and whether a stress forecast from an AIoT prediction model and field stress sensors is needed.

Each experimental set includes a control, a pre-treatment, a co-treatment and a post-treatment group; the pre-treatment and post-treatment groups receive the protectant one day before and one day after the heat or salinity stress, respectively. With this application schedule we can test whether a protectant has to be applied before the stress surge, which is the role of our bioreactor, and whether a stress forecast from an AIoT prediction model and field stress sensors is needed.
blocks.zh: 從第 7 組實驗起，我們依施用時機測試保護劑的效果。每一組實驗都包含對照組、前處理、共處理與後處理；前處理組與後處理組分別在熱逆境或鹽逆境的前一天與後一天施用保護劑。有了這樣的施用排程，我們就能測試保護劑是否必須在逆境高峰之前施用（這正是我們生物反應器的角色），以及是否需要來自 AIoT 預測模型與田間逆境感測器的逆境預報。

blocks.en: Every protectant we tested ran through the same three treatment timings, and the three phases below differ only in how the protectant reached the plant: mixed into the agar before autoclaving in phase 1, drenched onto the plate surface in phase 2, and sprayed in phase 3. Salt stress was applied the same way throughout, as NaCl at the set concentration on day 0.

blocks.zh: 我們測試的每一種保護劑都跑過同樣的三個處理時機，以下三個階段的差別只在保護劑如何送到植物身上：階段 1 在高壓滅菌前混入瓊脂，階段 2 淋在培養盤表面，階段 3 噴施。鹽逆境的施加方式全程一致，都是在第 0 天加入設定濃度的 NaCl。
階段 1 · 海藻糖與 NaCl 的組合

blocks.en: In phase 1 of trehalose testing (3 sets of pre-tests and 4 sets of official experiments) fine tuned concentrations of trehalose were added directly into the mixture with agar before autoclaving, meaning each experimental group has its own trehalose and salinity concentration from the start and nothing is added to the plate afterwards. We selected vertical planting of agar plates to allow clearer and better observation of root length growth and analysis.
blocks.text: In phase 1 of trehalose testing (3 sets of pre-tests and 4 sets of official experiments) fine tuned concentrations of trehalose were added directly into the mixture with agar before autoclaving, meaning each experimental group has its own trehalose and salinity concentration from the start and nothing is added to the plate afterwards. We selected vertical planting of agar plates to allow clearer and better observation of root length growth and analysis.
blocks.zh: 在海藻糖測試的階段 1（3 組預試與 4 組正式實驗）中，微調後的海藻糖濃度在高壓滅菌前直接加進瓊脂混合液，也就是每一組實驗從一開始就有自己的海藻糖與鹽度濃度，之後不再往培養盤添加任何東西。我們選擇垂直擺放瓊脂培養盤，以便更清楚、更好地觀察與分析根長的生長。

blocks.en: On Day 0, sterilized Arabidopsis seeds were stratified on ½ MS neutral vertical agar plates for 4 days at 4 °C, and moved to the growth chamber for 4 days of germination. On day 8, 4-day-old Arabidopsis seedlings were transferred to each of the newly made vertical salinity agar plates containing a corresponding mixture of trehalose with NaCl. During the transferring process, we screen for seedlings with similar root lengths and similar growth levels, and place 12 seedlings per salinity plate with each of their tips of the roots onto a straight baseline drawn by a marker. Thus we could immediately start observing the seedling's root length difference and physiological changes after they’re exposed to different concentrations of NaCl and trehalose, evaluating the rescue effectiveness and growth for each combination over a course of 14 days.
blocks.text: On Day 0, sterilized Arabidopsis seeds were stratified on ½ MS neutral vertical agar plates for 4 days at 4 °C, and moved to the growth chamber for 4 days of germination. On day 8, 4-day-old Arabidopsis seedlings were transferred to each of the newly made vertical salinity agar plates containing a corresponding mixture of trehalose with NaCl. During the transferring process, we screen for seedlings with similar root lengths and similar growth levels, and place 12 seedlings per salinity plate with each of their tips of the roots onto a straight baseline drawn by a marker. Thus we could immediately start observing the seedling's root length difference and physiological changes after they’re exposed to different concentrations of NaCl and trehalose, evaluating the rescue effectiveness and growth for each combination over a course of 14 days.
blocks.zh: 第 0 天，消毒後的 Arabidopsis 種子在 ½ MS 中性垂直瓊脂培養盤上於 4 °C 層積 4 天，再移入生長箱發芽 4 天。第 8 天，把 4 天齡的 Arabidopsis 苗移到每一盤新製的垂直鹽度瓊脂培養盤上，盤中含對應的海藻糖與 NaCl 混合液。移植時，我們篩選根長相近、生長程度相近的苗，每一盤鹽度培養盤放 12 株，並把每株的根尖對齊用麥克筆畫好的直線基線。這樣一來，苗一暴露於不同濃度的 NaCl 與海藻糖後，我們就能立刻開始觀察根長差異與生理變化，在 14 天的期間評估每一種組合的挽救效果與生長情形。
階段 2 · CH Bio 胜肽與 NaCl

blocks.en: Using commercial CH Bio peptide, the primary objective is to evaluate the efficacy of commercial protectants’ effectiveness and identify its best application timing in response to the exact point where salinity stress hits. Therefore, CH Bio peptide application is categorized into 3 treatment timing groups: pre-treatment, co-treatment, and post-treatment. Different treatment timings are essential connecting to our project goal, “to supply protectants at the optimal timing before stress harms the plants”. These 3 treatment timing groups and the control group (no protectant) were each subjected to three NaCl concentrations (0 mM, 75 mM, and 100 mM), giving a total of 12 experimental conditions.

Therefore, CH Bio peptide application is categorized into 3 treatment timing groups: pre-treatment, co-treatment, and post-treatment. Different treatment timings are essential connecting to our project goal, “to supply protectants at the optimal timing before stress harms the plants”. These 3 treatment timing groups and the control group (no protectant) were each subjected to three NaCl concentrations (0 mM, 75 mM, and 100 mM), giving a total of 12 experimental conditions.
blocks.zh: 使用市售 CH Bio 胜肽的主要目的，是評估市售保護劑的效果，並找出相對於鹽逆境確切發生時點的最佳施用時機。因此，CH Bio 胜肽的施用分成 3 個處理時機組：前處理、共處理與後處理。不同的處理時機對接上我們的專題目標至關重要：「在逆境傷害植物之前，於最佳時機供給保護劑」。這 3 個處理時機組與對照組（不加保護劑）各自接受三種 NaCl 濃度（0 mM、75 mM 與 100 mM），共 12 種實驗條件。

blocks.en: Looking at the entire experiment timeline, on day 0, Arabidopsis seeds were stratified on ½ MS neutral agar for 4 days at 4 °C, then transferred to a growth chamber for 4 days germination. Protectant applications were initiated subsequently starting from Day 8, and administered at 24-hour intervals between each treatment timing. Treatment timings can be considered as another set of days (Day −1: pre-treatment, Day 0: NaCl + co-treatment, Day 1: post-treatment). Thus, the day of salt stress application is Day 0, whereas NaCl (75 mM and 100 mM NaCl) was applied to all corresponding treatment groups, coinciding with the application for the co-treatment group.

Protectant applications were initiated subsequently starting from Day 8, and administered at 24-hour intervals between each treatment timing. Treatment timings can be considered as another set of days (Day −1: pre-treatment, Day 0: NaCl + co-treatment, Day 1: post-treatment). Thus, the day of salt stress application is Day 0, whereas NaCl (75 mM and 100 mM NaCl) was applied to all corresponding treatment groups, coinciding with the application for the co-treatment group.
blocks.zh: 從整個實驗時間軸來看，第 0 天，Arabidopsis 種子在 ½ MS 中性瓊脂上於 4 °C 層積 4 天，再移入生長箱發芽 4 天。保護劑的施用隨後從第 8 天開始，各處理時機之間相隔 24 小時。處理時機可以看成另一套日次（第 −1 天：前處理；第 0 天：NaCl 加共處理；第 1 天：後處理）。因此，施加鹽逆境的那天就是第 0 天，NaCl（75 mM 與 100 mM NaCl）在這天加入所有對應的處理組，與共處理組的施用同時進行。

blocks.en: Timeline design for every experiment on commercial CH Bio peptide against salinity stress.
blocks.text: Timeline design for every experiment on commercial CH Bio peptide against salinity stress.
blocks.zh: 市售 CH Bio 胜肽對抗鹽逆境的每一次實驗的時間軸設計。

blocks.en: On the technical side, we applied the protectant directly onto the surface of the agar by adding 3 mL and then removing 2 mL of excess, to leave 1 mL of protectant. The surface tension of the agar causes uneven distribution of a small volume, so we first added a larger volume to completely submerge the surface and then removed the excess. Furthermore, to prevent sample variation, we added an equal volume of sterile water (1 mL) to every other group to simulate equal liquid effects on the plants.

The surface tension of the agar causes uneven distribution of a small volume, so we first added a larger volume to completely submerge the surface and then removed the excess. Furthermore, to prevent sample variation, we added an equal volume of sterile water (1 mL) to every other group to simulate equal liquid effects on the plants.
blocks.zh: 技術上，我們把保護劑直接施到瓊脂表面：先加 3 mL，再移除多餘的 2 mL，留下 1 mL 保護劑。瓊脂的表面張力會讓少量液體分布不均，所以我們先加入較大的體積把表面完全淹沒，再把多餘的移除。此外，為了避免樣品間的差異，我們在其他每一組都加入等量的無菌水（1 mL），以模擬液體對植物造成的相同影響。
階段 3 · 生物反應器產出的保護劑與 NaCl

blocks.en: Secreted by our engineered Bacillus subtilis, ACC deaminase, LEA14 and BoPEP4 were used as the protectant against salinity stress in Phase 3. Before applying, the protectant was filtered through a 0.22 µm filter. The main difference in this phase’s protectant application is that we utilized a spraying method. We used a sterilized spraying nozzle to dispense 3 sprays of ACC deaminase (ACCD) onto the surface of plants, administered by spraying in 3 equal areas of individual sections (one top left, one top right, and one bottom) through a distance of 10 cm between the nozzle and agar plate.

Before applying, the protectant was filtered through a 0.22 µm filter. The main difference in this phase’s protectant application is that we utilized a spraying method. We used a sterilized spraying nozzle to dispense 3 sprays of ACC deaminase (ACCD) onto the surface of plants, administered by spraying in 3 equal areas of individual sections (one top left, one top right, and one bottom) through a distance of 10 cm between the nozzle and agar plate.
blocks.zh: 階段 3 以我們工程改造的 Bacillus subtilis（枯草桿菌）分泌的 ACC 去胺酶、LEA14 與 BoPEP4 作為對抗鹽逆境的保護劑。施用前，保護劑先經 0.22 µm 濾膜過濾。這個階段在保護劑施用上最主要的差別是改用噴施。我們以消毒過的噴頭對植物表面噴 3 次 ACC 去胺酶（ACCD），分成 3 個等面積的區塊各噴一次（左上、右上與下方），噴頭與瓊脂培養盤之間距離 10 cm。

blocks.en: The overall experimental flow still follows the timeline from phase 2 of CH Bio peptide testing, while we extended the germination time from 4 days to 7 days (this suggestion was provided by Prof. Cheng to use stronger plants for stress testing).

blocks.en: Heat stress · phase 1 · CH Bio peptide at 37 °C
blocks.text: Heat stress · phase 1 · CH Bio peptide at 37 °C
blocks.zh: 熱逆境 · 階段 1 · 37 °C 下的 CH Bio 胜肽

blocks.en: We did not use heat shock, as it is rarely observed in actual field conditions. Instead, thermo-priming for 3 days was used to simulate a slow change of temperature. Vertical plates cannot retain as much liquid protectant on the surface as horizontal plates can, so we used a spray nozzle that dispensed 0.536 mL for every 3 sprays. This way, each plant receives a controlled amount of protectant, kept standardized across plant trials. Post-treatment was applied one day after the heat stress ended, followed by 3 to 5 days of recovery, so that we could watch how the plants scavenge the reactive oxygen species (ROS) built up under heat.
blocks.text: We did not use heat shock, as it is rarely observed in actual field conditions. Instead, thermo-priming for 3 days was used to simulate a slow change of temperature. Vertical plates cannot retain as much liquid protectant on the surface as horizontal plates can, so we used a spray nozzle that dispensed 0.536 mL for every 3 sprays. This way, each plant receives a controlled amount of protectant, kept standardized across plant trials. Post-treatment was applied one day after the heat stress ended, followed by 3 to 5 days of recovery, so that we could watch how the plants scavenge the reactive oxygen species (ROS) built up under heat.
blocks.zh: 我們沒有採用熱震（heat shock），因為實際田間條件很少出現這種情形。取而代之的是為期 3 天的熱預備處理，用來模擬溫度的緩慢變化。垂直盤的表面無法像水平盤那樣留住同樣多的液態保護劑，所以我們使用每噴 3 次送出 0.536 mL 的噴頭。這樣每一株植物接受的保護劑量都受到控制，在各次植物試驗間保持一致。後處理在熱逆境結束後一天施用，接著是 3 到 5 天的恢復期，讓我們能觀察植物如何清除熱逆境下累積的活性氧（ROS）。

blocks.en: Heat stress · phase 2 · ACC deaminase at 37 °C
blocks.text: Heat stress · phase 2 · ACC deaminase at 37 °C
blocks.zh: 熱逆境 · 階段 2 · 37 °C 下的 ACC 去胺酶

blocks.en: Protectants are usually administered through the roots, but ACC deaminase is a large enzyme and we expected root uptake to be poor, so we applied it to the shoots with a spray bottle, three sprays each time. During our first trial we observed contamination that obstructed our data collection, so we transferred only the clean seedlings from the contaminated plates onto new agar plates and continued with the same method. However, mold still grew extensively on the finished plates. Because the contamination might have come from an unsterilized spray nozzle, we cleaned the nozzles by spraying sterilized water, then 75% ethanol, then sterilized water again.

During our first trial we observed contamination that obstructed our data collection, so we transferred only the clean seedlings from the contaminated plates onto new agar plates and continued with the same method. However, mold still grew extensively on the finished plates. Because the contamination might have come from an unsterilized spray nozzle, we cleaned the nozzles by spraying sterilized water, then 75% ethanol, then sterilized water again.
blocks.zh: 保護劑通常從根部施用，但 ACC 去胺酶是分子量大的酵素，我們預期根部吸收不佳，因此改用噴瓶施到地上部，每次噴三下。第一次試驗時我們看到污染，妨礙了數據收集，所以只把污染培養盤上乾淨的苗移到新的瓊脂培養盤，並以相同方式繼續。不過，結束時的培養盤上仍長了大量黴菌。由於污染可能來自未消毒的噴頭，我們改以噴無菌水、再噴 75% 乙醇、最後再噴一次無菌水的方式清洗噴頭。

blocks.text: Experiment overview for the hydroponic tip box and tube rack: seed holder preparation, seed holder agar, medium preparation, and planting Arabidopsis seeds in the seed holders.
blocks.zh: 水耕吸頭盒與試管架的實驗概覽：種子座的製作、種子座瓊脂、培養液的配製，以及把 Arabidopsis 種子種進種子座。

blocks.en: Abiotic stress, such as salinity stress and heat stress, negatively affects crop productivity. To test the effectiveness of our self-produced protectants under both types of stress, we chose to use a hydroponic system that allows for precise control of environmental factors. Compared with soil-based systems, hydroponics reduces the number of uncontrolled variables, such as differences in soil composition, microbial communities, and water distribution. Therefore, we can establish and maintain consistent experimental conditions by precisely controlling environmental parameters, including pH, electrical conductivity, temperature, and dissolved oxygen. In addition, nutrients and stress treatments can be delivered more uniformly to all plants through the nutrient solution, improving experimental consistency. Because treatments are added directly to the root environment, the hydroponic cultivation system allows us to rapidly observe plant responses to different stress conditions and evaluate the protective effects of our target protectants.

blocks.zh: 鹽逆境與熱逆境這類非生物逆境會對作物生產力造成負面影響。為了測試我們自行生產的保護劑在這兩種逆境下的效果，我們選擇能精確控制環境因子的水耕系統。與土壤系統相比，水耕減少了不受控變數的數量，例如土壤組成、微生物相與水分分布的差異。因此，我們可以精確控制 pH、導電度、溫度與溶氧等環境參數，建立並維持一致的實驗條件。此外，養分與逆境處理可以透過養液更均勻地送到每一株植物，提升實驗的一致性。由於處理直接加到根部環境，水耕培養系統讓我們能迅速觀察植物對不同逆境條件的反應，並評估目標保護劑的保護效果。

blocks.en: We are inspired by Matthew Gilliham’s hydroponics culture system (Conn et al., 2013) [5]. First, Arabidopsis seeds were sown on 0.6% agar containing black microcentrifuge-tube lids, each with a 3 mm diameter hole punched using a leather punch. Then, the lids containing seeds were placed on a microcentrifuge tube rack with the agar side facing down. Each well was filled with 2.1 mL of ½ MS medium, allowing the agar to remain in contact with the medium throughout stratification and germination. The seeds were stratified at 4 °C in the dark for at least 48 hours, and then transferred to a growth chamber maintained at 22 °C under a 16-hour light/8-hour dark photoperiod. After germination, 4-day-old seedlings were directly transferred onto the floating board or holder and left to grow in the hydroponic box. The tank was kept dark to reduce algal growth and continuously aerated with air stones to maintain sufficient dissolved oxygen. The nutrient solution was regularly replaced every 2–3 days, and the plants were then used for experimental treatments and physiological measurements.

blocks.zh: 我們受到 Matthew Gilliham 的水耕培養系統（Conn et al., 2013）[5] 啟發。首先，把 Arabidopsis 種子播在裝有 0.6% 瓊脂的黑色微量離心管蓋內，每個管蓋都用皮革打孔器打出一個直徑 3 mm 的孔。接著把裝有種子的管蓋瓊脂面朝下放在微量離心管架上。每個孔注入 2.1 mL 的 ½ MS 培養液，讓瓊脂在整個層積與發芽期間都與培養液接觸。種子於 4 °C 黑暗中層積至少 48 小時，再移入維持 22 °C、16 小時光照／8 小時黑暗光週期的生長箱。發芽後，把 4 天齡的苗直接移到浮板或承座上，留在水耕箱中生長。水槽保持遮光以減少藻類生長，並以氣泡石持續打氣，維持足夠的溶氧。養液每 2–3 天定期更換，之後這些植物就用於實驗處理與生理量測。

blocks.en: Big black plastic hydroponic box with black taped foam board.
blocks.text: Big black plastic hydroponic box with black taped foam board.
blocks.zh: 大型黑色塑膠水耕箱，配貼黑膠帶的泡棉板。

blocks.en: This is our first design of a hydroponics box. We chose a larger box in the beginning, with five agar-containing seed holders, and the tank can be filled with about 500 mL of ½ MS medium. This design wasn't ideal because the foam board had more space to accommodate more seed holders, but we only used five. In addition, the texture of the board is too fragile to be reused; it is cut from the foam and then taped with black tape. These processes are more time-consuming and difficult to scale up for mass production. Furthermore, the depth of the box made it difficult to observe the root system. The black box also made it difficult to monitor the medium when it became turbid.

blocks.zh: 這是我們第一版水耕箱設計。一開始我們選了較大的箱子，放五個裝瓊脂的種子座，水槽可注入約 500 mL 的 ½ MS 培養液。這個設計並不理想，因為泡棉板還有空間可以放更多種子座，我們卻只用了五個。此外，板子的質地太脆，無法重複使用；它是從泡棉切下、再貼上黑膠帶做成的，這些步驟相當費時，也難以放大量產。再者，箱子太深，不易觀察根系。黑色箱體也讓培養液變混濁時難以察覺。

blocks.en: Small hydroponic box with removable lids and platform.
blocks.text: Small hydroponic box with removable lids and platform.
blocks.zh: 小型水耕箱，配可拆的蓋子與平台。

blocks.en: Therefore, for the second version of the hydroponic box we chose a much smaller box than the previous one. We found this box on the internet and thought this may be a good hydroponic box. This box has holders for the lids and labels on the box lid. However, the medium easily leaks from two sites when we try to move the box. One is the joint, and the other is the bottom. Even when we tried to cover the hole with black tape to prevent leakage from the bottom, it was not sufficient to avoid the leak. Another problem is the lid easily falls into the box if we don’t place it at a specific angle.

blocks.zh: 因此，第二版水耕箱我們選了比前一版小得多的箱子。這個箱子是我們在網路上找到的，當時覺得它可能是個不錯的水耕箱。它有放管蓋的承座，箱蓋上也有標示欄。不過，我們要搬動箱子時，培養液很容易從兩個地方漏出來：一處是接合處，另一處是底部。即使我們試著用黑膠帶把底部的孔貼起來防漏，仍然無法完全避免滲漏。另一個問題是，蓋子如果不以特定角度擺放，很容易掉進箱子裡。

blocks.en: Long transparent box with square black-taped foam board.
blocks.text: Long transparent box with square black-taped foam board.
blocks.zh: 長條透明盒，配貼黑膠帶的方形泡棉板。

blocks.en: So we kept adjusting the design and developed the third version of the hydroponic box. Due to our previous experience, we discovered the importance of the box being opaque and deep enough to provide sufficient space for Arabidopsis root development. However, when we tried to fix two main problems from the previous prototypes, prototype 1 not easily showing the turbidity of the medium and the leakage of the medium in prototype 2, we encountered some new issues. First, the foam board was too tightly fitted with the box and difficult to reach when we tried to change the medium. Additionally, the box is too narrow for the plants to grow and limits the number of plants we can grow in each box.

blocks.zh: 於是我們持續調整設計，做出第三版水耕箱。從先前的經驗中，我們發現箱子必須不透光，而且要夠深，才能給 Arabidopsis 的根部足夠的發育空間。不過，當我們試著解決前兩版的兩個主要問題（原型 1 不容易看出培養液混濁、原型 2 培養液滲漏）時，又遇到新的狀況。首先，泡棉板與箱子卡得太緊，要更換培養液時很難取出。其次，箱子太窄，植物長不開，也限制了每箱能種的植株數。

blocks.en: Transparent tip box with foam board.
blocks.text: Transparent tip box with foam board.

blocks.en: After several rounds of trial and error, we developed the final version of the hydroponic box. We realized a medium-sized box would be ideal because it doesn't occupy too much space. It also allows us to easily observe the medium turbidity and root system, so we chose a 1000 µL tip box. The advantage of using a tip box is that it is suitable to reuse. We can reuse it multiple times after cleaning and autoclaving. Its size is enough to plant the amount of plants we want and it is transparent for us to observe the root system. We can punch at least 5 to 13 holes in one board. The contamination of this box is also less often than the previous two that we tested.

blocks.zh: 經過幾輪試錯，我們做出最終版的水耕箱。我們意識到中等大小的箱子最理想，因為它不會佔太多空間，也讓我們容易觀察培養液的混濁度與根系，所以選用 1000 µL 的吸頭盒。使用吸頭盒的好處是適合重複使用：清洗並高壓滅菌後可以多次再用。它的尺寸足以種下我們想要的植株數，而且是透明的，便於觀察根系。一塊板子上至少可以打 5 到 13 個孔。這個箱子的污染情形也比我們測過的前兩版少。

blocks.en: Transparent tip box with 3D printed board.
blocks.text: Transparent tip box with 3D printed board.
blocks.zh: 透明吸頭盒，配 3D 列印浮板。

blocks.en: This is our finalized and improved hydroponic box prototype, version 4.1. We replaced the foam board with a 3D-printed board and added a carrying handle on each side. This carrying handle makes it easier for us to change the hydroponic medium. The reason why we changed it is because the foam board is really fragile and easy to break. The foam board became softened after it stayed in the water for a long time. To make the quality of the hydroponic system more consistent, we decided to use a 3D printed board, so that it is far simpler to maintain the shape of the board and prevent broken boards in the middle of changing medium.

blocks.zh: 這是我們定案並改良後的水耕箱原型 4.1 版。我們把泡棉板換成 3D 列印浮板，並在兩側各加一個提把。提把讓我們更容易更換水耕培養液。改用列印板的原因是泡棉板真的很脆、容易壞，長時間浸在水中之後還會變軟。為了讓水耕系統的品質更一致，我們決定改用 3D 列印浮板，這樣板子的形狀好維持得多，也能避免在換液途中把板子弄破。

blocks.en: The final hydroponic box, in its light-blocking box.
blocks.text: The final hydroponic box, in its light-blocking box.
blocks.zh: 最終版水耕箱，置於遮光盒中。

blocks.en: The final hydroponic setup consisted of a version 4.1 tip box equipped with a black 3D-printed floating plate, placed inside a light-blocking enclosure measuring 14.7 × 11.5 × 6.2 cm. The outer enclosure minimized light exposure to reduce algal growth, while a side notch allowed the clear inner reservoir to be easily removed for observation of the root system.

blocks.zh: 最終的水耕配置是一個 4.1 版吸頭盒，裝上黑色 3D 列印浮板，再放進 14.7 × 11.5 × 6.2 cm 的遮光外盒。外盒把透光降到最低以減少藻類生長，側面的缺口則讓透明的內槽容易取出觀察根系。

blocks.en: To evaluate whether our protectants could reduce abiotic stress in plants, we developed multiple experimental platforms, not only agar systems. We needed a platform in which stress could be easily applied for different durations and the concentration of protectants could be precisely controlled. As a result, we can measure the fresh weight or root length of these treated plants, providing simple and accessible ways to quantify the results. In the beginning, we reviewed related papers to figure out how they established stress protocols on Arabidopsis. Here we focused on heat and salinity stress.

We needed a platform in which stress could be easily applied for different durations and the concentration of protectants could be precisely controlled. As a result, we can measure the fresh weight or root length of these treated plants, providing simple and accessible ways to quantify the results. In the beginning, we reviewed related papers to figure out how they established stress protocols on Arabidopsis. Here we focused on heat and salinity stress.
blocks.zh: 為了評估我們的保護劑能否減輕植物的非生物逆境，我們開發了多個實驗平台，不只瓊脂系統。我們需要一個能輕易施加不同持續時間的逆境、並能精確控制保護劑濃度的平台。這樣我們就能量測這些受處理植物的鮮重或根長，提供簡單而容易取得的量化方式。一開始，我們回顧相關論文，了解他們如何在 Arabidopsis 上建立逆境流程。這裡我們聚焦於熱逆境與鹽逆境。

blocks.en: First, we followed Cortés-Jiménez et al. [8]. This experiment tested six NaCl concentrations, 0, 50, 100, 150, 200 and 250 mM, rescued by Azospirillum brasilense, the most studied plant growth promoting bacteria (PGPB). According to the results, plant stems under 0–100 mM NaCl did better than under 150–250 mM, and best at 50 and 100 mM NaCl. This means that these two salinity concentrations are moderate enough for the plant to be rescued by the bacteria. According to the pretests from agar, Arabidopsis applied with 100 mM NaCl expresses a strong stress response but doesn’t die at this threshold and could be rescued. Therefore, we decided to test 100 mM NaCl in our salinity test. Next, we decided to use CH Bio peptide to evaluate the stress response of plants under 100 mM NaCl. We used CH Bio peptide since it is a commercial product that helps plants resist abiotic stress.

blocks.zh: 首先，我們參照 Cortés-Jiménez et al. [8]。該實驗測試六種 NaCl 濃度：0、50、100、150、200 與 250 mM，並以研究最多的植物生長促進菌（PGPB）Azospirillum brasilense 進行挽救。根據結果，0–100 mM NaCl 下的植物莖部表現優於 150–250 mM，其中 50 與 100 mM NaCl 最好。這表示這兩個鹽度濃度溫和到足以讓植物被細菌挽救。根據瓊脂的預試，施加 100 mM NaCl 的 Arabidopsis 表現出強烈的逆境反應，但在這個門檻下不會死亡，而且可以被挽救。因此我們決定在鹽度試驗中採用 100 mM NaCl。接下來，我們決定用 CH Bio 胜肽來評估植物在 100 mM NaCl 下的逆境反應。我們之所以使用 CH Bio 胜肽，是因為它是市售產品，能幫助植物抵抗非生物逆境。

blocks.en: One of our main reference papers on heat stress is Lee et al. [2], which describes how different stages of a plant may have different heat tolerance. This helped us make a quick decision about which developmental stage is most suitable for each condition, as well as the growth medium composition, the timing of stress application, and the days of recovery. This information was particularly important for us because this was our first time cultivating Arabidopsis on the hydroponic platform and our first heat treatment. We therefore designed the system around three variables: plant developmental stage → timing of protectant application → timing and intensity of stress. Integrating all of this information helped us accelerate our experiments and increase the success of protectant testing in the hydroponic system.

blocks.zh: 我們在熱逆境上的主要參考論文之一是 Lee et al. [2]，它描述植物在不同階段可能有不同的耐熱性。這幫助我們很快決定每種條件下最適合的發育階段，以及生長培養基的組成、逆境施加的時機與恢復的天數。這些資訊對我們特別重要，因為那是我們第一次在水耕平台上培養 Arabidopsis，也是第一次做熱處理。因此我們圍繞三個變數設計這套系統：植物發育階段 → 保護劑施用時機 → 逆境的時機與強度。把所有這些資訊整合起來，有助於加快實驗進度，並提高水耕系統中保護劑測試的成功率。

blocks.en: The soil-based experimental workflow, beginning with soil preparation and seed sowing, followed by salinity and heat stress treatments under controlled conditions, and concluding with phenotypic evaluation of plant responses.
blocks.text: The soil-based experimental workflow, beginning with soil preparation and seed sowing, followed by salinity and heat stress treatments under controlled conditions, and concluding with phenotypic evaluation of plant responses.
blocks.zh: 以土壤為基礎的實驗流程，從介質配製與播種開始，接著是受控條件下的鹽逆境與熱逆境處理，最後是植物反應的表現型評估。

blocks.en: Soil trials were done to simulate real field conditions and allow protectants to be validated under complex conditions after testing in controlled environments such as agar and hydroponics. Soil introduces physical matrix interactions, including water retention and pore size distribution, which affect how the NaCl and protectant diffuse and reach the plant roots. Additionally, soil contains native microbial flora, allowing us to validate its real world viability. Hydroponics and agar assays are for baseline fine tuning, protocol simulations, and controlled proof of concept, while demonstrating efficacy in real soil reflects smallholder farming realities.

Additionally, soil contains native microbial flora, allowing us to validate its real world viability. Hydroponics and agar assays are for baseline fine tuning, protocol simulations, and controlled proof of concept, while demonstrating efficacy in real soil reflects smallholder farming realities.
blocks.zh: 進行土壤試驗，是為了模擬真實的田間條件，讓保護劑在瓊脂與水耕等受控環境測試之後，能在複雜條件下得到驗證。土壤帶入了物理基質的交互作用，包括保水性與孔徑分布，這些都會影響 NaCl 與保護劑如何擴散並到達植物根部。此外，土壤含有原生微生物相，讓我們能驗證它在真實世界的可行性。水耕與瓊脂檢測用於基準微調、流程模擬與受控的概念驗證，而在真實土壤中展現效果則反映小農耕作的現實。

blocks.en: After determining the planting protocol, we optimized the plant growth stage by aligning our experiment timeline with the life cycle of Arabidopsis thaliana, because choosing the correct developmental stage is vital for capturing active metabolic and phenotypic responses. Arabidopsis progresses through a rapid life cycle of approximately 6 to 8 weeks, structured into distinct principal growth stages [1]: germination and seedling establishment (stages 0.1–0.7, days 0–7), when the radicle emerges through the seed coat, the cotyledons expand and the first true leaf appears; the rosette growth phase (stages 1.0–1.12, weeks 2–4), with exponential leaf expansion and primary root elongation; the floral transition and bolting (stages 5.0–6.5, weeks 4–5), driven by floral regulators such as LEAFY (LFY) and APETALA1 (AP1); and reproductive senescence (stages 8.0–9.0, weeks 6–8 and later), when resources are reallocated, chlorophyll breaks down and the siliques mature.
blocks.text: After determining the planting protocol, we optimized the plant growth stage by aligning our experiment timeline with the life cycle of Arabidopsis thaliana, because choosing the correct developmental stage is vital for capturing active metabolic and phenotypic responses. Arabidopsis progresses through a rapid life cycle of approximately 6 to 8 weeks, structured into distinct principal growth stages [1]: germination and seedling establishment (stages 0.1–0.7, days 0–7), when the radicle emerges through the seed coat, the cotyledons expand and the first true leaf appears; the rosette growth phase (stages 1.0–1.12, weeks 2–4), with exponential leaf expansion and primary root elongation; the floral transition and bolting (stages 5.0–6.5, weeks 4–5), driven by floral regulators such as LEAFY (LFY) and APETALA1 (AP1); and reproductive senescence (stages 8.0–9.0, weeks 6–8 and later), when resources are reallocated, chlorophyll breaks down and the siliques mature.
blocks.zh: 確定種植流程之後，我們把實驗時程對齊 Arabidopsis thaliana 的生命週期，以最佳化植物的生長階段，因為選對發育階段對於捕捉活躍的代謝與表現型反應非常關鍵。Arabidopsis 的生命週期約 6 到 8 週，相當快速，可分為幾個明確的主要生長階段 [1]：發芽與苗的建立（階段 0.1–0.7，第 0–7 天），此時胚根突出種皮、子葉展開、第一片真葉出現；蓮座葉叢生長期（階段 1.0–1.12，第 2–4 週），葉片呈指數擴張、主根伸長；花期轉換與抽梗（階段 5.0–6.5，第 4–5 週），由 LEAFY（LFY）與 APETALA1（AP1）等花器調控因子驅動；以及生殖衰老（階段 8.0–9.0，第 6–8 週及之後），此時資源重新配置、葉綠素分解、長角果成熟。

blocks.en: We initially conducted salinity assays on 1-month-old plants, at the late rosette to early bolting phase. At this developmental junction, Arabidopsis shifts its resource allocation toward floral meristem development rather than general vegetative homeostasis [15], and the lower leaves begin early senescence, which introduces baseline physiological variability into our assay data. The difference between stressed and unstressed plants may therefore be less obvious, which affects our conclusions on protectant efficacy. Following suggestions from Prof. Cheng, we moved our testing window to 2-week-old plants (stages 1.02–1.04). At 14 days after germination, Arabidopsis is in an active vegetative growth phase, and the absence of floral transition and senescence gives uniform tissue and reproducible experimental responses.
blocks.text: We initially conducted salinity assays on 1-month-old plants, at the late rosette to early bolting phase. At this developmental junction, Arabidopsis shifts its resource allocation toward floral meristem development rather than general vegetative homeostasis [15], and the lower leaves begin early senescence, which introduces baseline physiological variability into our assay data. The difference between stressed and unstressed plants may therefore be less obvious, which affects our conclusions on protectant efficacy. Following suggestions from Prof. Cheng, we moved our testing window to 2-week-old plants (stages 1.02–1.04). At 14 days after germination, Arabidopsis is in an active vegetative growth phase, and the absence of floral transition and senescence gives uniform tissue and reproducible experimental responses.
blocks.zh: 我們最初在 1 個月齡的植物上進行鹽度檢測，也就是蓮座葉叢後期到抽梗初期。在這個發育交界點，Arabidopsis 會把資源配置轉向花分生組織的發育，而非一般的營養生長恆定 [15]，下位葉也開始提早衰老，這會把發育本身的基礎生理變異帶進我們的檢測數據。受逆境與未受逆境植物之間的差異因此可能較不明顯，進而影響我們對保護劑效果的結論。依 Prof. Cheng 的建議，我們把測試窗口移到 2 週齡的植物（階段 1.02–1.04）。發芽後 14 天的 Arabidopsis 處於活躍的營養生長期，沒有花期轉換與衰老，可提供均一的組織與可重現的實驗反應。
最初使用 1 個月齡的植物。

blocks.en: ProblemThe plant is already close to the end of its life cycle.
blocks.text: ProblemThe plant is already close to the end of its life cycle.
blocks.zh: 問題植物已接近生命週期的尾聲。

blocks.en: Then used 2-week-old plants, following Prof. Cheng’s suggestions.
blocks.text: Then used 2-week-old plants, following Prof. Cheng’s suggestions.
blocks.zh: 之後依 Prof. Cheng 的建議改用 2 週齡的植物。

blocks.en: Salt behaves differently in soil than on agar, so the salinity concentrations and protectant doses had to be re-evaluated to maximize the observable differences in rescue effectiveness. Evaluating the protective efficacy of ACC deaminase requires a soil salinity model that induces measurable stress without causing immediate, lethal tissue necrosis. We evaluated two established soil salinization protocols on 2-week-old Arabidopsis thaliana in growth chambers: a top-down wash method [7], with direct surface application of 100, 200 and 300 mM NaCl until it washes through, and a sub-irrigation accumulation method [6], with successive doses of 100 mM NaCl in the bottom trays, drawn upward into the root zone by capillary action. In earlier trials, a gradual ramp of 25 mM NaCl per day up to 100 mM, adapted from Dr. Verslues’ suggestions, produced minimal phenotypic damage and did not separate the control from the ACC deaminase groups. As Prof. Cheng noted, sub-irrigation accumulation was also insufficiently stressful, because plain-water irrigation every 2 days flushed the accumulated ions out of the active root zone.
blocks.text: Salt behaves differently in soil than on agar, so the salinity concentrations and protectant doses had to be re-evaluated to maximize the observable differences in rescue effectiveness. Evaluating the protective efficacy of ACC deaminase requires a soil salinity model that induces measurable stress without causing immediate, lethal tissue necrosis. We evaluated two established soil salinization protocols on 2-week-old Arabidopsis thaliana in growth chambers: a top-down wash method [7], with direct surface application of 100, 200 and 300 mM NaCl until it washes through, and a sub-irrigation accumulation method [6], with successive doses of 100 mM NaCl in the bottom trays, drawn upward into the root zone by capillary action. In earlier trials, a gradual ramp of 25 mM NaCl per day up to 100 mM, adapted from Dr. Verslues’ suggestions, produced minimal phenotypic damage and did not separate the control from the ACC deaminase groups. As Prof. Cheng noted, sub-irrigation accumulation was also insufficiently stressful, because plain-water irrigation every 2 days flushed the accumulated ions out of the active root zone.
blocks.zh: 鹽在土壤中的行為與在瓊脂上不同，因此鹽度濃度與保護劑劑量必須重新評估，才能讓挽救效果的差異最明顯。要評估 ACC 去胺酶的保護效果，需要一個土壤鹽化模式：能誘發可量測的逆境，又不會立刻造成致死性的組織壞死。我們在生長箱中以 2 週齡的 Arabidopsis thaliana 評估兩種既有的土壤鹽化流程：一是由上往下的沖洗法 [7]，直接在表面施加 100、200 與 300 mM NaCl 直到溶液流穿；二是底部灌溉的累積法 [6]，在底盤中連續給予 100 mM NaCl，靠毛細作用向上帶入根圈。在較早的試驗中，取自 Dr. Verslues 建議、每天升高 25 mM NaCl 直到 100 mM 的漸進方式，造成的表現型傷害極小，也無法把對照組與 ACC 去胺酶各組區分開來。如 Prof. Cheng 所指出的，底部灌溉累積法的逆境強度也不足，因為每 2 天一次的清水灌溉把累積的離子沖出了活躍根圈。

blocks.en: To resolve these problems, we developed a sequential top-drenching protocol for evaluating the three protectant timings (pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment). Plants receive equal volumes (30 to 50 mL per pot) of 100, then 200, and finally 300 mM NaCl, with no freshwater irrigation in between to prevent salt leaching. Runoff at the base of each pot confirms that the root system is fully saturated, and each tray reservoir is kept 1 to 2 cm deep, holding 200 to 400 mL, so that the root zone stays in equilibrium with the salt solution. Instead of following a fixed calendar, the protocol repeats 300 mM NaCl until clear phenotypic markers appear.

Plants receive equal volumes (30 to 50 mL per pot) of 100, then 200, and finally 300 mM NaCl, with no freshwater irrigation in between to prevent salt leaching. Runoff at the base of each pot confirms that the root system is fully saturated, and each tray reservoir is kept 1 to 2 cm deep, holding 200 to 400 mL, so that the root zone stays in equilibrium with the salt solution. Instead of following a fixed calendar, the protocol repeats 300 mM NaCl until clear phenotypic markers appear.
blocks.zh: 為了解決這些問題，我們發展出一套依序由上淋灌的流程，用來評估三個保護劑施用時機（前處理、共處理與後處理）。植物依序接受等量（每盆 30 至 50 mL）的 100、再 200、最後 300 mM NaCl，期間不以清水灌溉，以避免鹽被淋洗掉。每盆底部出現流出液，即確認根系已完全飽和；每個底盤的蓄液維持 1 至 2 cm 深、約 200 至 400 mL，使根圈與鹽溶液保持平衡。這套流程不照固定的日程走，而是重複施加 300 mM NaCl，直到出現明確的表現型指標。

blocks.en: To evaluate the thermal protective capacity of ACC deaminase, we adapted established thermo-priming frameworks to our soil platform, building on the heat stress assays of Auverlot et al. [3] and following the same method as our agar system. In the agar trials, 10-day-old seedlings were exposed to 37 °C for 5 days to induce acquired thermotolerance and sustained heat stress, followed by 5 days of recovery at 22 °C before survival, fresh weight, chlorophyll retention and anthocyanin accumulation were measured. Translating this framework to soil required adapting both the incubation parameters and the treatment schedule: two-week-old plants were placed in a 37 °C incubator for 5 days of heat stress, followed by 5 days of recovery in a 22 to 25 °C growth chamber.
blocks.text: To evaluate the thermal protective capacity of ACC deaminase, we adapted established thermo-priming frameworks to our soil platform, building on the heat stress assays of Auverlot et al. [3] and following the same method as our agar system. In the agar trials, 10-day-old seedlings were exposed to 37 °C for 5 days to induce acquired thermotolerance and sustained heat stress, followed by 5 days of recovery at 22 °C before survival, fresh weight, chlorophyll retention and anthocyanin accumulation were measured. Translating this framework to soil required adapting both the incubation parameters and the treatment schedule: two-week-old plants were placed in a 37 °C incubator for 5 days of heat stress, followed by 5 days of recovery in a 22 to 25 °C growth chamber.
blocks.zh: 為了評估 ACC 去胺酶的熱保護能力，我們把既有的熱預備處理架構套用到土壤平台，以 Auverlot et al. [3] 的熱逆境檢測為基礎，並沿用與瓊脂系統相同的方法。在瓊脂試驗中，10 天齡的苗暴露於 37 °C 五天，以誘導獲得性耐熱性並維持熱逆境，接著在 22 °C 恢復 5 天，再量測存活率、鮮重、葉綠素保留與花青素累積。要把這套架構轉到土壤，培養參數與處理排程都得調整：2 週齡的植物放進 37 °C 培養箱承受 5 天熱逆境，接著在 22 至 25 °C 的生長箱恢復 5 天。

blocks.en: In farming environments, abiotic stresses such as high salinity and extreme heat rarely occur predictably; they arrive as dynamic, fluctuating events. By testing three intervention timings, we simulate how farmers might apply microbial inoculants across different phases of the stress.
blocks.text: In farming environments, abiotic stresses such as high salinity and extreme heat rarely occur predictably; they arrive as dynamic, fluctuating events. By testing three intervention timings, we simulate how farmers might apply microbial inoculants across different phases of the stress.
blocks.zh: 在農業環境中，高鹽度與極端高溫這類非生物逆境很少可以預測地發生；它們是動態、起伏的事件。藉由測試三個介入時機，我們模擬農友可能在逆境的不同階段施用微生物接種劑的情形。

blocks.en: Pre-treatment simulates applying bio-inoculants or seed coatings before an anticipated stress, for instance when a farmer sees a heatwave in the seasonal forecast. It allows beneficial bacteria to colonize the rhizosphere and prime the plant’s defenses before cellular damage occurs.
blocks.text: Pre-treatment simulates applying bio-inoculants or seed coatings before an anticipated stress, for instance when a farmer sees a heatwave in the seasonal forecast. It allows beneficial bacteria to colonize the rhizosphere and prime the plant’s defenses before cellular damage occurs.
blocks.zh: 前處理模擬在預期的逆境之前施用生物接種劑或種子包覆，例如農友在季節預報中看到熱浪時。它讓有益細菌在細胞受損之前先在根圈定殖，並預先啟動植物的防禦。

blocks.en: Co-treatment simulates application at the moment a stressor arrives, such as sudden soil salinization after flooding or fertilizer runoff. It tests whether the protectant can intercept stress signals immediately: supplied together with NaCl or heat, ACC deaminase cleaves the ethylene precursor ACC as the stress develops, limiting root growth arrest and photosynthetic decline.
blocks.text: Co-treatment simulates application at the moment a stressor arrives, such as sudden soil salinization after flooding or fertilizer runoff. It tests whether the protectant can intercept stress signals immediately: supplied together with NaCl or heat, ACC deaminase cleaves the ethylene precursor ACC as the stress develops, limiting root growth arrest and photosynthetic decline.
blocks.zh: 共處理模擬在逆境因子到來的當下施用，例如淹水或肥料逕流之後土壤突然鹽化。它測試保護劑能否立刻攔截逆境訊號：與 NaCl 或熱一起供給時，ACC 去胺酶會在逆境發展的同時切解乙烯前驅物 ACC，減少根生長停滯與光合作用下降。

blocks.en: Post-treatment simulates a rescue application after an extreme event, such as spraying crops after a heatwave or salt-water intrusion, and tests the restorative capacity of the protectant. In our thermo-priming assays, post-treatment was applied one day after the plants were moved from the 37 °C incubator to the 22 °C growth chamber.
blocks.text: Post-treatment simulates a rescue application after an extreme event, such as spraying crops after a heatwave or salt-water intrusion, and tests the restorative capacity of the protectant. In our thermo-priming assays, post-treatment was applied one day after the plants were moved from the 37 °C incubator to the 22 °C growth chamber.
blocks.zh: 後處理模擬極端事件後的挽救性施用，例如熱浪或海水入侵之後對作物噴施，用來測試保護劑的修復能力。在我們的熱預備處理檢測中，後處理是在植物從 37 °C 培養箱移到 22 °C 生長箱之後一天施用。

blocks.zh: 在測試我們工程改造的保護劑之前，我們先用海藻糖做初步實驗，以建立合適的鹽逆境條件，並改進以瓊脂為基礎的植物檢測。在實驗第 1–3 組中，我們測試不同的 NaCl 與海藻糖濃度組合，以找出合適的培養流程。

blocks.en: These preliminary experiments helped us identify visible indicators of salinity stress, including stunted primary root growth and reduced leaf area, and they informed our choice of concentrations for subsequent experiments. Because our experimental procedures had not yet been fully standardized, we relied primarily on photographic documentation rather than quantitative measurements for these early pretest sets. All three pretest sets were grown as circular horizontal plates.

blocks.en: Beginning with experimental set 4, we adopted vertical agar plates to better observe gravitropic root growth and to quantify primary root length with ImageJ. We also introduced fresh weight and chlorophyll content measurements to evaluate plant growth and physiological responses to salinity stress.
blocks.text: Beginning with experimental set 4, we adopted vertical agar plates to better observe gravitropic root growth and to quantify primary root length with ImageJ. We also introduced fresh weight and chlorophyll content measurements to evaluate plant growth and physiological responses to salinity stress.
blocks.zh: 從實驗第 4 組開始，我們改用垂直瓊脂培養盤，以便更好地觀察根的向地性生長，並以 ImageJ 量化主根長度。我們也納入鮮重與葉綠素含量的量測，以評估植物的生長與對鹽逆境的生理反應。

blocks.en: 100 mM NaCl suppressed plant growth severely, producing visibly stunted roots and reduced leaf blades across the 100 mM NaCl row of the plates (e–h). Among these salt-stressed groups, the roots of every trehalose-supplemented group bent towards the left, whereas the untreated stressed control grew straight down gravitropically (e). The roots are bending away from the saline environment, a behavior known as halotropism, or salt-avoidance tropism. Halotropism is driven mainly by the redistribution of the plant hormone auxin in the root tip, which lets seedlings reduce their exposure to salt by growing around it, and Arabidopsis has been shown to display this response under a salt gradient [23].
blocks.text: 100 mM NaCl suppressed plant growth severely, producing visibly stunted roots and reduced leaf blades across the 100 mM NaCl row of the plates (e–h). Among these salt-stressed groups, the roots of every trehalose-supplemented group bent towards the left, whereas the untreated stressed control grew straight down gravitropically (e). The roots are bending away from the saline environment, a behavior known as halotropism, or salt-avoidance tropism. Halotropism is driven mainly by the redistribution of the plant hormone auxin in the root tip, which lets seedlings reduce their exposure to salt by growing around it, and Arabidopsis has been shown to display this response under a salt gradient [23].
blocks.zh: 100 mM NaCl 嚴重抑制植物生長，培養盤 100 mM NaCl 那一排（e–h）都可見根部受阻、葉片變小。在這些受鹽逆境的組別中，每一個補充海藻糖的組根都向左彎，而未處理的逆境對照組則依向地性直直向下生長（e）。這些根正在彎離鹽環境，這種行為稱為避鹽性（halotropism），也就是避鹽的趨性。避鹽性主要由植物荷爾蒙生長素在根尖的重新分布所驅動，讓苗能繞過鹽、減少接觸，而 Arabidopsis 已被證實在鹽梯度下會表現這種反應 [23]。

blocks.en: Taken together, the stunted growth and the halotropism confirm that the salinity treatment reached the seedlings and caused damage at the level we intended.
blocks.text: Taken together, the stunted growth and the halotropism confirm that the salinity treatment reached the seedlings and caused damage at the level we intended.
blocks.zh: 綜合來看，生長受阻與避鹽性確認鹽度處理確實到達了苗，並造成我們預期程度的傷害。

blocks.en: 1.0 mM trehalose rescues plants under 100 mM NaCl
blocks.text: 1.0 mM trehalose rescues plants under 100 mM NaCl
blocks.zh: 1.0 mM 海藻糖挽救 100 mM NaCl 下的植物

blocks.en: Of the trehalose doses tested under 100 mM NaCl, 1.0 mM gave a visible rescue (h). Compared with the other salt-stressed groups, seedlings treated with 1.0 mM trehalose showed more lateral root growth and longer primary roots.
blocks.text: Of the trehalose doses tested under 100 mM NaCl, 1.0 mM gave a visible rescue (h). Compared with the other salt-stressed groups, seedlings treated with 1.0 mM trehalose showed more lateral root growth and longer primary roots.
blocks.zh: 在 100 mM NaCl 下測試的各海藻糖劑量中，1.0 mM 帶來可見的挽救（h）。與其他受鹽逆境的組別相比，以 1.0 mM 海藻糖處理的苗有更多的側根生長與更長的主根。

blocks.en: Because 100 mM NaCl strongly suppresses fresh weight (panel a), normalizing chlorophyll content by the biomass of severely damaged plants inflates the relative values and breaks the agreement between what the plates show and what the numbers say. The chlorophyll interpretation for this set therefore rests on panel c, the relative total chlorophyll content.
blocks.text: Because 100 mM NaCl strongly suppresses fresh weight (panel a), normalizing chlorophyll content by the biomass of severely damaged plants inflates the relative values and breaks the agreement between what the plates show and what the numbers say. The chlorophyll interpretation for this set therefore rests on panel c, the relative total chlorophyll content.
blocks.zh: 由於 100 mM NaCl 強烈抑制鮮重（圖板 a），以受損嚴重的植物的生物量去標準化葉綠素含量，會把相對值放大，使培養盤所呈現的與數字所說的不再一致。因此這一組的葉綠素解讀以圖板 c，也就是相對總葉綠素含量為準。

blocks.en: Three readouts support the rescue at 1.0 mM. First, in panel c the plants supplemented with 1.0 mM trehalose retained more chlorophyll under 100 mM NaCl than the untreated salt-stressed control, so the exogenous trehalose let them tolerate the salinity and limited the degradation of the photosystem. Second, primary root length in panel d shows the same pattern: the 1.0 mM group had the longest average primary root, 46.4 mm against approximately 35.8 mm in the untreated salt-stressed control. The other two doses, 0.25 and 0.5 mM, also gave longer primary roots, but by smaller margins; the roughly 30% gain at 1.0 mM is the largest. Third, fresh weight in panel a shows the limit of the effect: trehalose did not relieve the salt-induced loss of biomass, and 1.0 mM was not enough to raise fresh weight above the untreated salt-stressed control.
blocks.text: Three readouts support the rescue at 1.0 mM. First, in panel c the plants supplemented with 1.0 mM trehalose retained more chlorophyll under 100 mM NaCl than the untreated salt-stressed control, so the exogenous trehalose let them tolerate the salinity and limited the degradation of the photosystem. Second, primary root length in panel d shows the same pattern: the 1.0 mM group had the longest average primary root, 46.4 mm against approximately 35.8 mm in the untreated salt-stressed control. The other two doses, 0.25 and 0.5 mM, also gave longer primary roots, but by smaller margins; the roughly 30% gain at 1.0 mM is the largest. Third, fresh weight in panel a shows the limit of the effect: trehalose did not relieve the salt-induced loss of biomass, and 1.0 mM was not enough to raise fresh weight above the untreated salt-stressed control.
blocks.zh: 有三項判讀支持 1.0 mM 的挽救。第一，在圖板 c 中，補充 1.0 mM 海藻糖的植物在 100 mM NaCl 下保留的葉綠素多於未處理的鹽逆境對照組，因此外源海藻糖讓它們得以耐受鹽度，並限制了光系統的降解。第二，圖板 d 的主根長度呈現同樣的型態：1.0 mM 組的平均主根最長，為 46.4 mm，未處理的鹽逆境對照組約為 35.8 mm。另外兩個劑量 0.25 與 0.5 mM 也讓主根變長，但幅度較小；1.0 mM 約 30% 的增幅是最大的。第三，圖板 a 的鮮重顯示了這個效應的限度：海藻糖並未減輕鹽所造成的生物量損失，而 1.0 mM 也不足以把鮮重拉高到未處理鹽逆境對照組之上。

blocks.en: The rescue by trehalose therefore shows up in chlorophyll retention and primary root elongation rather than in biomass.
blocks.text: The rescue by trehalose therefore shows up in chlorophyll retention and primary root elongation rather than in biomass.
blocks.zh: 因此海藻糖的挽救表現在葉綠素的保留與主根的伸長上，而不在生物量。

blocks.en: Exogenous trehalose at 1.0 mM significantly improved plant recovery under 100 mM NaCl stress.

blocks.en: The rescue is in chlorophyll content and primary root elongation, not in biomass.
blocks.text: The rescue is in chlorophyll content and primary root elongation, not in biomass.
blocks.zh: 挽救發生在葉綠素含量與主根伸長，而不在生物量。

blocks.en: Effects of higher trehalose concentrations under severe salinity stress
blocks.text: Effects of higher trehalose concentrations under severe salinity stress
blocks.zh: 嚴重鹽逆境下較高海藻糖濃度的效應

blocks.en: Some plants began to show chlorosis after 2 to 3 days of exposure to the high-salinity conditions, and severe chlorosis can cost a leaf a large part of its chlorophyll. Even at 5 and 10 mM trehalose, at least one seedling per plate shrivelled and whitened. Control groups without trehalose reached root lengths of up to 82.476 mm, whereas root growth in the 150 mM NaCl groups was limited to approximately 4 to 5 mm, and the 250 mM groups were stunted further still, staying below 1 mm. We repeated the whole experiment in trial 2 to confirm these results.

Even at 5 and 10 mM trehalose, at least one seedling per plate shrivelled and whitened. Control groups without trehalose reached root lengths of up to 82.476 mm, whereas root growth in the 150 mM NaCl groups was limited to approximately 4 to 5 mm, and the 250 mM groups were stunted further still, staying below 1 mm. blocks.zh: 有些植物在暴露於高鹽度條件 2 到 3 天後開始出現黃化，而嚴重黃化會讓一片葉子失去大部分的葉綠素。即使在 5 與 10 mM 海藻糖下，每一盤仍至少有一株苗萎縮變白。沒有海藻糖的對照組根長可達 82.476 mm，而 150 mM NaCl 各組的根生長只有約 4 到 5 mm，250 mM 各組受阻更嚴重，不到 1 mm。我們在試驗 2 中重複整個實驗，以確認這些結果。

未受逆境條件下的效應

blocks.en: In the untreated control groups, chlorophyll content stayed stable across the trehalose doses (panel b). The plants gain no growth boost from an exogenous protectant when they are not under stress, and the trehalose imposes no metabolic toxicity on them either.
blocks.text: In the untreated control groups, chlorophyll content stayed stable across the trehalose doses (panel b). The plants gain no growth boost from an exogenous protectant when they are not under stress, and the trehalose imposes no metabolic toxicity on them either.
blocks.zh: 在未處理的對照組中，葉綠素含量在各海藻糖劑量間保持穩定（圖板 b）。植物在未受逆境時不會因外源保護劑而加速生長，海藻糖也不會對它們造成代謝毒性。

blocks.en: Under 150 mM NaCl, chlorophyll content recovered in a dose-dependent way (panel b): 5 and 10 mM trehalose gave statistically significant improvements over the untreated stressed control, limiting the salt-induced degradation of the chlorophyll pigment. The protective effect therefore rises with the trehalose dose against a high salinity stress. Despite these improvements, 150 mM NaCl substantially inhibited primary root elongation and fresh weight accumulation, so trehalose did not fully restore overall plant growth.
blocks.text: Under 150 mM NaCl, chlorophyll content recovered in a dose-dependent way (panel b): 5 and 10 mM trehalose gave statistically significant improvements over the untreated stressed control, limiting the salt-induced degradation of the chlorophyll pigment. The protective effect therefore rises with the trehalose dose against a high salinity stress. Despite these improvements, 150 mM NaCl substantially inhibited primary root elongation and fresh weight accumulation, so trehalose did not fully restore overall plant growth.
blocks.zh: 在 150 mM NaCl 下，葉綠素含量以劑量依賴的方式回升（圖板 b）：5 與 10 mM 海藻糖相較未處理的逆境對照組有統計上顯著的改善，限制了鹽所造成的葉綠素色素降解。因此在高鹽逆境下，保護效果隨海藻糖劑量上升。儘管有這些改善，150 mM NaCl 仍大幅抑制主根伸長與鮮重累積，所以海藻糖並未完全恢復植物的整體生長。

blocks.en: 250 mM NaCl causes excessive growth inhibition.
blocks.text: 250 mM NaCl causes excessive growth inhibition.
blocks.zh: 250 mM NaCl 造成過度的生長抑制。

blocks.en: While 150 mM NaCl is a severity the plants can be rescued from, 250 mM exceeds what the seedlings tolerate: chlorosis, stunted roots and loss of chlorophyll pigment. Primary root growth stayed within 1 mm (panel d; j: 1.075 mm, k: 0.9415 mm). On the plates, the 5 and 10 mM trehalose groups are extensively damaged, with severe chlorosis on every leaf, and are living on what is left of the ½ MS agar. Trehalose supplementation did not produce clear evidence of recovery at this level.

On the plates, the 5 and 10 mM trehalose groups are extensively damaged, with severe chlorosis on every leaf, and are living on what is left of the ½ MS agar. blocks.zh: 150 mM NaCl 是植物還能被挽救的嚴重度，250 mM 則超出苗所能耐受的範圍：黃化、根部受阻、葉綠素色素流失。主根生長停在 1 mm 以內（圖板 d；j：1.075 mm，k：0.9415 mm）。在培養盤上，5 與 10 mM 海藻糖組受損廣泛，每一片葉子都嚴重黃化，靠著 ½ MS 瓊脂剩下的養分存活。在這個強度下，補充海藻糖並未產生明確的恢復證據。

blocks.en: Trehalose at 1, 5 and 10 mM gave a significant dose-dependent rescue under 150 mM NaCl: chlorophyll content rises with the trehalose dose.
blocks.text: Trehalose at 1, 5 and 10 mM gave a significant dose-dependent rescue under 150 mM NaCl: chlorophyll content rises with the trehalose dose.

blocks.en: 250 mM NaCl is too severe for the plants to sustain, even with a protectant.

blocks.text: Evaluating 5 mM trehalose across different salinity stress levels
blocks.zh: 評估 5 mM 海藻糖在不同鹽逆境強度下的表現

blocks.en: The previous set demonstrated that extreme salt stress such as 250 mM NaCl was too severe for the plants to sustain, so we brought the NaCl concentration down below 150 mM for this set. The phenotypes showed that plants at 100 mM NaCl changed leaf color after 3 days of treatment, which suggests that 5 mM of protectant may not be enough against the more severe salinity stress at 150 mM NaCl. Overall we selected 75, 100 and 150 mM NaCl for this set.

blocks.zh: 前一組顯示 250 mM NaCl 這類極端鹽逆境的嚴重度超出植物所能承受，因此這一組我們把 NaCl 濃度降到 150 mM 以下。表現型顯示 100 mM NaCl 的植物在處理 3 天後葉色改變，這表示 5 mM 的保護劑可能不足以應對 150 mM NaCl 這種更嚴重的鹽逆境。整體而言，這一組我們選用 75、100 與 150 mM NaCl。

blocks.text: 5 mM trehalose significantly enhanced plant salt tolerance under 100 mM NaCl-induced stress (red box).
blocks.zh: 5 mM 海藻糖在 100 mM NaCl 誘導的逆境下顯著提升植物的耐鹽性（紅框）。

blocks.en: (a) Fresh weight. (b) Fresh-weight-normalized relative chlorophyll content. (c) Relative total chlorophyll a + b. (d) Primary root length. A consistent sample size of 9 seedlings per condition was used for each extraction. Sterilized seeds were sown onto neutral ½ MS agar plates, cold stratified for 4 days, and transferred to plates containing NaCl (0, 75, 100, 150 mM) on the seventh day of growth. Data represent mean ± SEM. Chlorophyll extraction and root length analysis were performed on day 13 of plant growth. Asterisks indicate significance: **P < 0.01, ****P < 0.0001; ns, not significant.

blocks.zh: （a）鮮重。（b）以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素含量。（c）相對總葉綠素 a + b。（d）主根長度。每次萃取在每種條件下都採用一致的樣本數 9 株苗。消毒後的種子播於中性 ½ MS 瓊脂培養盤，低溫層積 4 天，於生長第七天移到含 NaCl（0、75、100、150 mM）的培養盤。數據為平均值 ± SEM。葉綠素萃取與根長分析於植物生長第 13 天進行。星號表示顯著性：**P < 0.01、****P < 0.0001；ns 為不顯著。

blocks.en: The application of 5 mM trehalose significantly enhanced plant salt tolerance under 100 mM NaCl stress. This is shown by an approximately 8.7-fold increase in chlorophyll content (panel b) and a 3 cm increase in root length (panel d) relative to the untreated control (red outlines), with **** p<0.0001. Each analysis shows a correlation between growth parameters and physiological performance, and the plates show the same: the 5 mM trehalose-treated group consistently had better growth than the untreated stressed group.
blocks.text: The application of 5 mM trehalose significantly enhanced plant salt tolerance under 100 mM NaCl stress. This is shown by an approximately 8.7-fold increase in chlorophyll content (panel b) and a 3 cm increase in root length (panel d) relative to the untreated control (red outlines), with **** p<0.0001. Each analysis shows a correlation between growth parameters and physiological performance, and the plates show the same: the 5 mM trehalose-treated group consistently had better growth than the untreated stressed group.
blocks.zh: 施用 5 mM 海藻糖在 100 mM NaCl 逆境下顯著提升植物的耐鹽性。這表現在相較未處理對照組（紅框），葉綠素含量約增加 8.7 倍（圖板 b）、根長增加 3 cm（圖板 d），**** p<0.0001。每一項分析都顯示生長參數與生理表現之間的相關，培養盤也呈現同樣的結果：以 5 mM 海藻糖處理的組別生長一致優於未處理的逆境組。

blocks.en: Through the experimental records, chlorophyll levels in the groups without salt were comparable between the 0 mM and 5 mM trehalose groups, indicating that the protectant alone has a negligible effect on non-stressed plants. At 150 mM NaCl, the high stress severely damaged the plants, as shown by leaf bleaching and visible stunting of root growth. Here 5 mM trehalose did little to rescue the plants, giving only a minor increase in root length (within 1 cm) and a decrease in chlorophyll content, which indicates an insufficient dose.

At 150 mM NaCl, the high stress severely damaged the plants, as shown by leaf bleaching and visible stunting of root growth. Here 5 mM trehalose did little to rescue the plants, giving only a minor increase in root length (within 1 cm) and a decrease in chlorophyll content, which indicates an insufficient dose.
blocks.zh: 從實驗記錄來看，未加鹽各組中 0 mM 與 5 mM 海藻糖組的葉綠素濃度相當，顯示單用保護劑對未受逆境的植物影響可忽略。在 150 mM NaCl 下，高逆境嚴重傷害植物，表現為葉片白化與根生長明顯受阻。在這裡 5 mM 海藻糖幾乎無法挽救植物，只讓根長小幅增加（1 cm 以內），葉綠素含量反而下降，顯示劑量不足。

blocks.en: What we found unexpected in this experiment
blocks.text: What we found unexpected in this experiment
blocks.zh: 這次實驗中出乎我們意料的地方

blocks.en: Contrary to our initial hypothesis, 5 mM trehalose did not have a protective effect under mild salt stress (75 mM NaCl) relative to the untreated stressed control; instead, the trehalose-treated group had reduced chlorophyll content (panel b). We had expected 5 mM trehalose to work better at the lower stress level, but it was effective only under 100 mM NaCl. This suggests that 75 mM NaCl is a mild salt stress, at which the plants’ endogenous regulatory systems can still maintain homeostasis without exogenous protectants. In contrast, 100 mM NaCl likely exceeds the plants’ tolerance threshold, triggering protective mechanisms that make more effective use of exogenous trehalose to mitigate cellular damage, so the 100 mM NaCl groups treated with 5 mM trehalose sustained significantly better growth than their untreated control.

We had expected 5 mM trehalose to work better at the lower stress level, but it was effective only under 100 mM NaCl. This suggests that 75 mM NaCl is a mild salt stress, at which the plants’ endogenous regulatory systems can still maintain homeostasis without exogenous protectants. In contrast, 100 mM NaCl likely exceeds the plants’ tolerance threshold, triggering protective mechanisms that make more effective use of exogenous trehalose to mitigate cellular damage, so the 100 mM NaCl groups treated with 5 mM trehalose sustained significantly better growth than their untreated control.
blocks.zh: 與我們最初的假設相反，在輕度鹽逆境（75 mM NaCl）下，5 mM 海藻糖相較未處理的逆境對照組並沒有保護效果；反而是加了海藻糖的組葉綠素含量下降（圖板 b）。我們原本預期 5 mM 海藻糖在較低的逆境強度下效果更好，但它只在 100 mM NaCl 下有效。這表示 75 mM NaCl 屬於輕度鹽逆境，植物內生的調節系統在沒有外源保護劑的情況下仍能維持恆定。相對地，100 mM NaCl 可能超過植物的耐受門檻，啟動了保護機制，使外源海藻糖得以更有效地被利用來減輕細胞損傷，因此以 5 mM 海藻糖處理的 100 mM NaCl 各組，生長顯著優於它們的未處理對照組。

blocks.en: Comparing 75 and 100 mM NaCl shows the relatively strong growth inhibition caused by 100 mM: root length at 100 mM was much lower than at 75 mM, with barely any growth even after 6–7 days of protectant and NaCl treatment.
blocks.text: Comparing 75 and 100 mM NaCl shows the relatively strong growth inhibition caused by 100 mM: root length at 100 mM was much lower than at 75 mM, with barely any growth even after 6–7 days of protectant and NaCl treatment.
blocks.zh: 比較 75 與 100 mM NaCl，可以看出 100 mM 造成相對強烈的生長抑制：100 mM 下的根長遠低於 75 mM，即使經過 6–7 天的保護劑與 NaCl 處理也幾乎沒有生長。

blocks.en: 5 mM trehalose significantly enhanced plant salt tolerance under 100 mM NaCl-induced stress.
blocks.text: 5 mM trehalose significantly enhanced plant salt tolerance under 100 mM NaCl-induced stress.
blocks.zh: 5 mM 海藻糖在 100 mM NaCl 誘導的逆境下顯著提升植物的耐鹽性。

blocks.en: 5 mM trehalose had a negligible effect against mild 75 mM NaCl stress and was insufficient to rescue plants at 150 mM NaCl.
blocks.text: 5 mM trehalose had a negligible effect against mild 75 mM NaCl stress and was insufficient to rescue plants at 150 mM NaCl.
blocks.zh: 5 mM 海藻糖對 75 mM NaCl 的輕度逆境效果可忽略，在 150 mM NaCl 下也不足以挽救植物。

blocks.en: In phase 1 we used trehalose, a commercial sample protectant, to settle the protocol and the experimental conditions. We tuned trehalose up and down against low, moderate and high salinity stress, so that we could tell which dose gives the most rescue at which level of stress, with chlorophyll content and primary root length behind each judgment. Two things are taken forward from these sets: halotropism is an adaptive change of root growth direction that marks the presence of salt stress, and 5 mM trehalose significantly enhanced plant salt tolerance under 100 mM NaCl.

We tuned trehalose up and down against low, moderate and high salinity stress, so that we could tell which dose gives the most rescue at which level of stress, with chlorophyll content and primary root length behind each judgment. Two things are taken forward from these sets: halotropism is an adaptive change of root growth direction that marks the presence of salt stress, and 5 mM trehalose significantly enhanced plant salt tolerance under 100 mM NaCl.
blocks.zh: 在階段 1，我們以市售的樣品保護劑海藻糖來確立流程與實驗條件。我們針對低、中、高三種鹽逆境把海藻糖劑量往上往下調，以便判斷哪一個劑量在哪一個逆境強度下挽救效果最好，每一項判斷背後都有葉綠素含量與主根長度支撐。這幾組實驗帶出兩件事：避鹽性是標示鹽逆境存在的一種根生長方向的適應性改變；以及 5 mM 海藻糖在 100 mM NaCl 下顯著提升了植物的耐鹽性。

blocks.en: Despite limited rescue, post-treatment gave the highest relative chlorophyll content and fresh weight among the stressed groups. (a) Fresh weight (g). (b) Fresh-weight-normalized chlorophyll content (mg g<sup>−1</sup>). (c) Relative chlorophyll content without fresh-weight normalization (mg/L). A consistent sample size of 25 seedlings per condition was used for each extraction. Seeds were sown onto neutral ½ MS agar plates, cold stratified for 4 days and grown in a 22 °C growth chamber for 4 days; pre-treatment began on the 4th day of growth, followed by co-treatment (stress and protectant together) and post-treatment one day apart. Data represent mean ± SEM. Fresh weight and chlorophyll were measured on day 8 of plant growth. Asterisks indicate significance: *P < 0.05, ****P < 0.0001; ns, not significant.
blocks.text: Despite limited rescue, post-treatment gave the highest relative chlorophyll content and fresh weight among the stressed groups. (a) Fresh weight (g). (b) Fresh-weight-normalized chlorophyll content (mg g−1). (c) Relative chlorophyll content without fresh-weight normalization (mg/L). A consistent sample size of 25 seedlings per condition was used for each extraction. Seeds were sown onto neutral ½ MS agar plates, cold stratified for 4 days and grown in a 22 °C growth chamber for 4 days; pre-treatment began on the 4th day of growth, followed by co-treatment (stress and protectant together) and post-treatment one day apart. Data represent mean ± SEM. Fresh weight and chlorophyll were measured on day 8 of plant growth. Asterisks indicate significance: *P < 0.05, ****P < 0.0001; ns, not significant.
blocks.zh: 儘管挽救有限，後處理在受逆境各組中帶來最高的相對葉綠素含量與鮮重。（a）鮮重（g）。（b）以鮮重標準化的葉綠素含量（mg g<sup>−1</sup>）。（c）未以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素含量（mg/L）。每次萃取在每種條件下都採用一致的樣本數 25 株苗。種子播於中性 ½ MS 瓊脂培養盤，低溫層積 4 天，再在 22 °C 生長箱中生長 4 天；前處理從生長第 4 天開始，接著相隔一天進行共處理（逆境與保護劑同時）與後處理。數據為平均值 ± SEM。鮮重與葉綠素於植物生長第 8 天量測。星號表示顯著性：*P < 0.05、****P < 0.0001；ns 為不顯著。

blocks.en: 100 mM NaCl severely damaged 4-day-old seedlings, with widespread chlorosis in every treatment group.
blocks.text: 100 mM NaCl severely damaged 4-day-old seedlings, with widespread chlorosis in every treatment group.
blocks.zh: 100 mM NaCl 嚴重傷害 4 天齡的苗，每一個處理組都普遍出現黃化。

blocks.en: Under 100 mM NaCl stress, post-treatment gave the highest relative chlorophyll content and fresh weight of the three timings.
blocks.text: Under 100 mM NaCl stress, post-treatment gave the highest relative chlorophyll content and fresh weight of the three timings.
blocks.zh: 在 100 mM NaCl 逆境下，後處理在三個時機中帶來最高的相對葉綠素含量與鮮重。

blocks.en: 4-day-old seedlings are too vulnerable for the salinity treatment.
blocks.text: 4-day-old seedlings are too vulnerable for the salinity treatment.
blocks.zh: 4 天齡的苗太脆弱，承受不住鹽度處理。

blocks.en: We analyzed chlorophyll content in two subsets: non-stressed plants and plants exposed to 100 mM NaCl. Among the non-stressed plants, pre-treatment and post-treatment with the CH Bio peptide gave significantly higher relative chlorophyll content than co-treatment (panel b). Under 100 mM NaCl, chlorophyll content increased with later peptide application: pre-treated and co-treated seedlings remained severely inhibited by salt stress, whereas post-treated seedlings kept significantly more chlorophyll. These results suggest that applying the CH Bio peptide after stress exposure is the most effective of the three timings for preserving chlorophyll under high salinity.

Among the non-stressed plants, pre-treatment and post-treatment with the CH Bio peptide gave significantly higher relative chlorophyll content than co-treatment (panel b). Under 100 mM NaCl, chlorophyll content increased with later peptide application: pre-treated and co-treated seedlings remained severely inhibited by salt stress, whereas post-treated seedlings kept significantly more chlorophyll. These results suggest that applying the CH Bio peptide after stress exposure is the most effective of the three timings for preserving chlorophyll under high salinity.
blocks.zh: 我們把葉綠素含量分成兩組來分析：未受逆境的植物，以及暴露於 100 mM NaCl 的植物。在未受逆境的植物中，以 CH Bio 胜肽做前處理與後處理的相對葉綠素含量顯著高於共處理（圖板 b）。在 100 mM NaCl 下，葉綠素含量隨胜肽施用時間愈晚而愈高：前處理與共處理的苗仍受鹽逆境嚴重抑制，而後處理的苗則保留顯著更多的葉綠素。這些結果顯示，在三個時機中，暴露於逆境後再施用 CH Bio 胜肽，是在高鹽度下保全葉綠素最有效的做法。
