blocks.zh: 後處理的 CH Bio 胜肽在葉綠素保留上帶來最多的恢復。（a）鮮重（g）。（b）與（c）相對總葉綠素含量（mg/L）。每次萃取在每種條件下都採用一致的樣本數 9 株苗。種子低溫層積 4 天，再在 22 °C 生長箱中生長 4 天；保護劑與 NaCl 都以由上淋灌的方式施用，每次 1 mL。數據為平均值 ± SEM。星號表示顯著性：***P < 0.001、****P < 0.0001；ns 為不顯著。

blocks.en: Experimental trends are marked by the colored lines on the plates. The red line follows the increasing NaCl concentration (0 to 100 mM), which produced progressively more severe salt stress: 75 and 100 mM NaCl clearly suppressed growth, with severe chlorosis and anthocyanin accumulation (b and e). This validates our stress application method, top drenching with 1 mL of NaCl solution.
blocks.text: Experimental trends are marked by the colored lines on the plates. The red line follows the increasing NaCl concentration (0 to 100 mM), which produced progressively more severe salt stress: 75 and 100 mM NaCl clearly suppressed growth, with severe chlorosis and anthocyanin accumulation (b and e). This validates our stress application method, top drenching with 1 mL of NaCl solution.
blocks.zh: 實驗趨勢以培養盤上的彩色線標示。紅線沿著 NaCl 濃度上升（0 到 100 mM），鹽逆境也逐步加重：75 與 100 mM NaCl 明顯抑制生長，伴隨嚴重黃化與花青素累積（b 與 e）。這驗證了我們施加逆境的方式，也就是由上淋灌 1 mL 的 NaCl 溶液。

blocks.en: The second line compares co- and post-treatment within the 75 mM NaCl group. Co-treatment with the CH Bio peptide (c) substantially reduced salt-induced growth inhibition relative to the untreated 75 mM group (b), with greater leaf area, longer petioles, more extensive root elongation and minimal visible anthocyanin accumulation. In contrast, post-treatment at 75 mM (d) resembled the untreated group, indicating limited rescue. At 100 mM NaCl, co-treatment showed less rescue, with more anthocyanin accumulation in the center of the seedlings (f). Supplying the CH Bio peptide together with the stress therefore improved salt tolerance more under moderate stress than at 100 mM, which appears to exceed the rescue threshold of the peptide at the co-treatment timing.
blocks.text: The second line compares co- and post-treatment within the 75 mM NaCl group. Co-treatment with the CH Bio peptide (c) substantially reduced salt-induced growth inhibition relative to the untreated 75 mM group (b), with greater leaf area, longer petioles, more extensive root elongation and minimal visible anthocyanin accumulation. In contrast, post-treatment at 75 mM (d) resembled the untreated group, indicating limited rescue. At 100 mM NaCl, co-treatment showed less rescue, with more anthocyanin accumulation in the center of the seedlings (f). Supplying the CH Bio peptide together with the stress therefore improved salt tolerance more under moderate stress than at 100 mM, which appears to exceed the rescue threshold of the peptide at the co-treatment timing.
blocks.zh: 第二條線比較 75 mM NaCl 組內的共處理與後處理。以 CH Bio 胜肽共處理（c）相較未處理的 75 mM 組（b）大幅減少鹽所造成的生長抑制，葉面積較大、葉柄較長、根伸長較廣，且幾乎看不到花青素累積。相對地，75 mM 的後處理（d）與未處理組相似，顯示挽救有限。在 100 mM NaCl 下，共處理的挽救較少，苗中心累積較多花青素（f）。因此把 CH Bio 胜肽與逆境一同供給，在中度逆境下對耐鹽性的改善大於 100 mM；100 mM 似乎超出了胜肽在共處理時機下的挽救門檻。

blocks.en: The third line compares treatments within the 100 mM NaCl group, where both co- and post-treatment markedly reduced salt damage relative to the untreated plants (e). Post-treatment (g) produced the strongest recovery, with brighter green foliage, larger leaf area, less anthocyanin accumulation and overall growth comparable to the 0 mM mock-treated control (a).
blocks.text: The third line compares treatments within the 100 mM NaCl group, where both co- and post-treatment markedly reduced salt damage relative to the untreated plants (e). Post-treatment (g) produced the strongest recovery, with brighter green foliage, larger leaf area, less anthocyanin accumulation and overall growth comparable to the 0 mM mock-treated control (a).
blocks.zh: 第三條線比較 100 mM NaCl 組內的各種處理，其中共處理與後處理相較未處理的植物（e）都明顯減輕鹽害。後處理（g）帶來最強的恢復，葉片更亮綠、葉面積更大、花青素累積較少，整體生長與 0 mM 的模擬處理對照組（a）相當。

blocks.en: Salt exposure suppressed fresh weight in all conditions (panel a), and neither co-treatment nor post-treatment with the CH Bio peptide substantially increased total fresh weight compared with the mock-untreated control. The decrease in relative total chlorophyll content from 0 to 100 mM NaCl in the control (panel c) further supports progressive salt damage.

blocks.en: In this first test of our filtered, bioreactor-produced ACC deaminase on Arabidopsis thaliana in agar plates, ACCD showed minimal rescue in all three timing groups compared with the untreated group. Post-treatment is the one timing that rescued the salt-stressed plates, most clearly at 75 and 100 mM NaCl; neither pre- nor co-treatment separated from the untreated column. On relative chlorophyll content (panel b), co-treatment gave the highest average chlorophyll per gram of sample and pre-treatment the next highest, but the plates were contaminated throughout, so the pre-treatment group has to be repeated before the chlorophyll ranking can be read as a real difference between timings.

blocks.zh: 在這第一次把過濾後、由生物反應器產出的 ACC 去胺酶用在瓊脂培養盤上的 Arabidopsis thaliana 的測試中，ACCD 在三個時機組相較未處理組的挽救都很小。後處理是唯一挽救了受鹽逆境培養盤的時機，在 75 與 100 mM NaCl 下最明顯；前處理與共處理都沒有與未處理那一欄分開。在相對葉綠素含量（圖板 b）上，共處理的每公克樣品平均葉綠素最高，前處理次之，但培養盤全程都有污染，因此在把葉綠素的高低排序讀成各時機之間的真實差異之前，前處理組必須重做。

blocks.en: The untreated 75 and 100 mM NaCl control groups show chlorosis, with white and yellow leaves, consistent with the applied salt stress. Despite contamination, all groups given pre-treatment ACC deaminase had visibly greater rosette area, denser foliage and more extensive petioles and roots (b, f, j). In the pre-treatment 100 mM NaCl group, a minority of leaves turned slightly yellow or white and some accumulated anthocyanin (j); the pre-treatment 75 mM plants also showed slight chlorosis but retained most of their chlorophyll pigments. In the co-treatment groups, seedlings showed severe inhibition of growth under salinity stress as salt increased from 0 to 100 mM (g, k). ACC deaminase therefore showed its rescue effectiveness at the pre-treatment and post-treatment timings rather than at co-treatment.

Despite contamination, all groups given pre-treatment ACC deaminase had visibly greater rosette area, denser foliage and more extensive petioles and roots (b, f, j). In the pre-treatment 100 mM NaCl group, a minority of leaves turned slightly yellow or white and some accumulated anthocyanin (j); the pre-treatment 75 mM plants also showed slight chlorosis but retained most of their chlorophyll pigments. In the co-treatment groups, seedlings showed severe inhibition of growth under salinity stress as salt increased from 0 to 100 mM (g, k). ACC deaminase therefore showed its rescue effectiveness at the pre-treatment and post-treatment timings rather than at co-treatment.
blocks.zh: 未處理的 75 與 100 mM NaCl 對照組出現黃化，葉片發白、發黃，與施加的鹽逆境一致。儘管有污染，所有接受 ACC 去胺酶前處理的組別都可見更大的蓮座葉叢面積、更密的葉片，以及更長的葉柄與根（b、f、j）。在前處理的 100 mM NaCl 組中，少數葉片略為轉黃或轉白，部分累積花青素（j）；前處理的 75 mM 植物也出現輕微黃化，但保留了大部分的葉綠素色素。在共處理各組中，隨著鹽從 0 增加到 100 mM，苗在鹽逆境下的生長受到嚴重抑制（g、k）。因此 ACC 去胺酶的挽救效果出現在前處理與後處理，而不是共處理。

blocks.en: Fresh weight (panel a) agrees with the plates for the pre- and co-treatment groups. With pre-treatment ACC deaminase, fresh weight increased from 0 to 100 mM NaCl (0.122, 0.164 and 0.225 g), matching the denser foliage at 100 mM. This suggests that priming plants with ACC deaminase before the stress supports a substantial rescue of fresh weight. Conversely, with co-treatment, fresh weight decreased as NaCl increased (0.220, 0.144 and 0.114 g), returning at 100 mM to a level similar to the untreated 100 mM control, which shows inadequate rescue when ACC deaminase is applied together with the stress. This trend requires further trials to validate.

With pre-treatment ACC deaminase, fresh weight increased from 0 to 100 mM NaCl (0.122, 0.164 and 0.225 g), matching the denser foliage at 100 mM. This suggests that priming plants with ACC deaminase before the stress supports a substantial rescue of fresh weight. Conversely, with co-treatment, fresh weight decreased as NaCl increased (0.220, 0.144 and 0.114 g), returning at 100 mM to a level similar to the untreated 100 mM control, which shows inadequate rescue when ACC deaminase is applied together with the stress. This trend requires further trials to validate.
blocks.zh: 鮮重（圖板 a）在前處理與共處理各組上與培養盤一致。以 ACC 去胺酶前處理時，鮮重隨 NaCl 由 0 升到 100 mM 而增加（0.122、0.164 與 0.225 g），與 100 mM 下葉片較密相符。這表示在逆境之前先以 ACC 去胺酶預備植物，有助於鮮重的大幅挽救。相反地，共處理時鮮重隨 NaCl 增加而下降（0.220、0.144 與 0.114 g），在 100 mM 時回到與未處理的 100 mM 對照組相近的水準，顯示把 ACC 去胺酶與逆境一同施用時挽救不足。這個趨勢仍需更多試驗來驗證。

blocks.en: In panel b, pre-treatment ACC deaminase under 100 mM NaCl shows substantial rescue compared with the untreated control: about 1.74 mg g<sup>−1</sup> against about 1.03 mg g<sup>−1</sup> under the same salinity. This roughly 70% increase in chlorophyll content is the strongest rescue we saw under high salinity, and it supports the idea that priming before the stress confers physiological protection, although the trend still requires further trials to validate.

blocks.zh: 在圖板 b 中，100 mM NaCl 下以 ACC 去胺酶前處理相較未處理對照組顯示大幅挽救：約 1.74 mg g<sup>−1</sup>，對上同樣鹽度下的約 1.03 mg g<sup>−1</sup>。這約 70% 的葉綠素含量增幅，是我們在高鹽度下看到最強的挽救，也支持在逆境之前先行預備能帶來生理保護的看法，不過這個趨勢仍需更多試驗來驗證。

blocks.en: The plates show clear stress damage across the 0 to 100 mM NaCl gradient in the untreated groups (a, d, g). Growth declined visibly as the NaCl concentration rose, with progressively smaller leaf blades and a shrinking rosette area. The untreated, non-stressed control (a) shows lush growth and dense foliage, which is the baseline we compare the treatment groups against. At 100 mM NaCl the untreated seedlings (g) show anthocyanin accumulation, yellowish chlorotic leaves and stunted growth next to the milder damage at 75 mM (d). Top drenching 2 mL of NaCl onto the agar therefore applies the salt stress directly, as intended.

Growth declined visibly as the NaCl concentration rose, with progressively smaller leaf blades and a shrinking rosette area. The untreated, non-stressed control (a) shows lush growth and dense foliage, which is the baseline we compare the treatment groups against. blocks.zh: 培養盤顯示未處理各組在 0 到 100 mM NaCl 的梯度上有明確的逆境傷害（a、d、g）。隨著 NaCl 濃度上升，生長明顯下降，葉片愈來愈小，蓮座葉叢面積也縮小。未處理、未受逆境的對照組（a）生長茂盛、葉片茂密，這就是我們用來比較各處理組的基準。在 100 mM NaCl 下，未處理的苗（g）出現花青素累積、泛黃的黃化葉片與生長受阻，與 75 mM（d）較輕微的傷害形成對比。因此把 2 mL NaCl 由上淋灌到瓊脂上，確實如預期直接施加了鹽逆境。

blocks.en: Co-treatment BoPEP4 made the salt damage worse
blocks.text: Co-treatment BoPEP4 made the salt damage worse
blocks.zh: 共處理的 BoPEP4 使鹽害更嚴重

blocks.en: The BoPEP4 co-treated plates (b, e, h) show progressive salt damage as the NaCl concentration rises from 0 to 100 mM. At 100 mM the damage is extensive chlorosis, with yellow-to-green leaf margins and partial leaf bleaching. Every co-treated plate also shows a green-to-yellow gradient from leaf to leaf, with round, spatulate leaves. Chlorosis across all the co-treatment groups suggests that BoPEP4 applied at the same moment as the stress is inhibitory in itself. At 75 mM the co-treated plate contains seedlings of varying sizes, mostly green rosettes with many chlorotic leaves, some whitish patches near the edges and little browning. At 100 mM (h) the phenotype is the most severe: chlorosis, whitish stems and hypocotyl bases, bleaching and early necrosis on some leaves. Even without salt, the co-treated plates grew less well than the unstressed mock control. The readouts agree: both the fresh weight and the relative total chlorophyll content of the unstressed co-treatment group fall below the mock-untreated control (panel c), and the chlorophyll falls much further.

blocks.zh: BoPEP4 共處理的培養盤（b、e、h）隨 NaCl 濃度由 0 升到 100 mM 而逐步出現鹽害。在 100 mM 下，傷害是大範圍的黃化，葉緣由黃轉綠，部分葉片白化。每一個共處理盤也都呈現葉與葉之間由綠到黃的梯度，葉片呈圓形、匙狀。所有共處理組都出現黃化，顯示在與逆境同一時刻施用的 BoPEP4 本身就有抑制作用。在 75 mM 下，共處理盤中的苗大小不一，多為綠色蓮座葉叢並帶有許多黃化葉片，邊緣附近有一些發白的斑塊，褐化很少。在 100 mM（h）表現型最嚴重：黃化、莖與下胚軸基部發白、白化，部分葉片已開始壞死。即使沒有加鹽，共處理盤的生長也比未受逆境的模擬對照組差。判讀結果一致：未受逆境的共處理組的鮮重與相對總葉綠素含量都低於模擬未處理對照組（圖板 c），而葉綠素下降得多得多。

blocks.en: The post-treatment plates (c, f, i) keep their green rosettes at 0, 75 and 100 mM NaCl alike, with no bleaching and little anthocyanin. In panel b the post-treatment group is the only one with significant gains in fresh-weight-normalized chlorophyll content over its own 0 mM NaCl level, at both 75 and 100 mM, and in panel c the post-treatment 100 mM group has the highest relative total chlorophyll of the stressed groups. BoPEP4 given one day after the salt therefore gives a comparable rescue across the salt levels we tested, while the same peptide given with the salt does not.

blocks.zh: 後處理的培養盤（c、f、i）在 0、75 與 100 mM NaCl 下都同樣保持綠色的蓮座葉叢，沒有白化，花青素也很少。在圖板 b 中，後處理組是唯一在 75 與 100 mM 下，以鮮重標準化的葉綠素含量都顯著高於自身 0 mM NaCl 水準的組；在圖板 c 中，後處理的 100 mM 組在受逆境各組裡相對總葉綠素最高。因此在加鹽後一天給予 BoPEP4，在我們測試的各鹽度下都帶來相當的挽救，而同一種胜肽與鹽一起給予則沒有。

blocks.en: Every plate in this trial grew better than in the earlier sets, which made the differences between stressed and unstressed, treated and untreated, harder to read. Among the pre-treatment plates the 75 mM NaCl group (e) held fuller foliage than the 100 mM group (h) and than the untreated control, and the post-treatment plates behaved the same way: the 75 mM group (f) kept both the broader leaf area and the darker leaf color. Both timings point the same way, towards AtLEA14 working best at the middle salt level.

This supports AtLEA14 performing best under moderate stress, and setting growth back when it is released without that demand.

blocks.en: Pre-treatment ACC deaminase under 37 °C heat stress shows rescue relative to the untreated heat-stressed control. (a) Fresh weight (g). blocks.en: After 17 days, plants at 37 °C and 22 °C differed markedly in size and growth, with fresh weight under heat stress roughly 95% lower. Normalizing chlorophyll to fresh weight (panel b) therefore amplifies variation and inflates chlorophyll content, because the stressed samples weigh only about 0.02 g, and it gives implausible values, such as higher apparent chlorophyll in heat-stressed than in non-stressed controls. Our interpretation therefore focuses on panel c, total chlorophyll a + b without fresh-weight normalization, calculated with the equations of Arnon [20] for 80% acetone extracts. This measure reflects the total pigment in the extract and is partly influenced by biomass.
blocks.text: After 17 days, plants at 37 °C and 22 °C differed markedly in size and growth, with fresh weight under heat stress roughly 95% lower. Normalizing chlorophyll to fresh weight (panel b) therefore amplifies variation and inflates chlorophyll content, because the stressed samples weigh only about 0.02 g, and it gives implausible values, such as higher apparent chlorophyll in heat-stressed than in non-stressed controls. Our interpretation therefore focuses on panel c, total chlorophyll a + b without fresh-weight normalization, calculated with the equations of Arnon [20] for 80% acetone extracts. This measure reflects the total pigment in the extract and is partly influenced by biomass.
blocks.zh: 17 天後，37 °C 與 22 °C 的植物在大小與生長上差異顯著，熱逆境下的鮮重約低 95%。因此把葉綠素以鮮重標準化（圖板 b）會放大變異並把葉綠素含量撐高，因為受逆境的樣品只有約 0.02 g，並會產生不合理的數值，例如受熱逆境者的表觀葉綠素高於未受逆境的對照組。因此我們的解讀聚焦在圖板 c，也就是未以鮮重標準化的總葉綠素 a + b，依 Arnon [20] 針對 80% 丙酮萃取液的公式計算。這個指標反映萃取液中的總色素量，並部分受生物量影響。

blocks.en: Prolonged heat stress was applied by keeping seedlings at 37 °C in an incubator for 5 days, to simulate the prolonged rising temperatures of global warming. The phenotypes show consistent damage: severely stunted primary root elongation, a much smaller rosette area, and severe chlorosis with white and yellow bleached leaves compared with the mock-untreated control. This response matches the protocol of Auverlot et al. [3] and confirms that the stress treatment was effective.
blocks.text: Prolonged heat stress was applied by keeping seedlings at 37 °C in an incubator for 5 days, to simulate the prolonged rising temperatures of global warming. The phenotypes show consistent damage: severely stunted primary root elongation, a much smaller rosette area, and severe chlorosis with white and yellow bleached leaves compared with the mock-untreated control. This response matches the protocol of Auverlot et al. [3] and confirms that the stress treatment was effective.
blocks.zh: 長時間熱逆境的施加方式是把苗放在培養箱中以 37 °C 維持 5 天，以模擬全球暖化下長時間上升的溫度。表現型呈現一致的傷害：主根伸長嚴重受阻、蓮座葉叢面積小得多，以及相較模擬未處理對照組出現嚴重黃化、葉片發白發黃。這個反應與 Auverlot et al. [3] 的流程相符，也確認逆境處理有效。

blocks.en: Under non-stressed conditions, post-treatment ACC deaminase produced growth comparable to the control, whereas pre- and co-treatment reduced fresh weight (panel a).
blocks.text: Under non-stressed conditions, post-treatment ACC deaminase produced growth comparable to the control, whereas pre- and co-treatment reduced fresh weight (panel a).
blocks.zh: 在未受逆境的條件下，後處理的 ACC 去胺酶使生長與對照組相當，而前處理與共處理則降低鮮重（圖板 a）。

blocks.en: Under 37 °C thermo-priming, ACC deaminase supplied at different timings gave different phenotypes. All heat-stressed groups given ACC deaminase had visibly longer roots, with pre- and post-treatment showing longer roots and better chlorophyll retention than the heat-stressed control, whereas co-treatment showed reduced survival and severe chlorosis. Co-treatment was also the least effective timing in the ACC deaminase salinity assay (experimental set 9). Across both salinity and heat stress, ACC deaminase was therefore more effective when applied before or after the stress than together with it.
blocks.text: Under 37 °C thermo-priming, ACC deaminase supplied at different timings gave different phenotypes. All heat-stressed groups given ACC deaminase had visibly longer roots, with pre- and post-treatment showing longer roots and better chlorophyll retention than the heat-stressed control, whereas co-treatment showed reduced survival and severe chlorosis. Co-treatment was also the least effective timing in the ACC deaminase salinity assay (experimental set 9). Across both salinity and heat stress, ACC deaminase was therefore more effective when applied before or after the stress than together with it.
blocks.zh: 在 37 °C 熱預備處理下，不同時機供給的 ACC 去胺酶產生不同的表現型。所有加了 ACC 去胺酶的熱逆境組根都明顯較長，其中前處理與後處理的根比熱逆境對照組更長、葉綠素保留也更好，而共處理則存活率下降且嚴重黃化。在 ACC 去胺酶的鹽度檢測（實驗第 9 組）中，共處理也是效果最差的時機。因此在鹽逆境與熱逆境兩者，ACC 去胺酶在逆境之前或之後施用都比與逆境同時施用更有效。

blocks.en: In panel c, among the groups under 37 °C heat stress, pre-treatment ACC deaminase retained the most chlorophyll, around 13% of its non-stressed value. This suggests that supplying ACC deaminase before prolonged heat stress helps, which is consistent with the purpose of priming plants ahead of a forecast heatwave using the AIoT forecasting system of our bioreactor.
blocks.text: In panel c, among the groups under 37 °C heat stress, pre-treatment ACC deaminase retained the most chlorophyll, around 13% of its non-stressed value. This suggests that supplying ACC deaminase before prolonged heat stress helps, which is consistent with the purpose of priming plants ahead of a forecast heatwave using the AIoT forecasting system of our bioreactor.
blocks.zh: 在圖板 c 中，受 37 °C 熱逆境的各組裡，前處理的 ACC 去胺酶保留最多葉綠素，約為其未受逆境值的 13%。這表示在長時間熱逆境之前供給 ACC 去胺酶有幫助，也與我們生物反應器利用 AIoT 預報系統在預報的熱浪之前先行預備植物的目的一致。

blocks.en: In the second heat trial, ACC deaminase showed better rescue than in the first. The plates show a clear difference between the heat-stressed control and the heat-stressed post-treatment group: the control underwent severe chlorosis, while the post-treatment group held more biomass and more chlorophyll. The standardized chlorophyll content of the post-treatment heat group was 14% higher than that of the heat-stressed control. Co-treatment and pre-treatment gave less rescue than post-treatment but kept a stable amount of chlorophyll across the 9 seedlings tested.
blocks.text: In the second heat trial, ACC deaminase showed better rescue than in the first. The plates show a clear difference between the heat-stressed control and the heat-stressed post-treatment group: the control underwent severe chlorosis, while the post-treatment group held more biomass and more chlorophyll. The standardized chlorophyll content of the post-treatment heat group was 14% higher than that of the heat-stressed control. Co-treatment and pre-treatment gave less rescue than post-treatment but kept a stable amount of chlorophyll across the 9 seedlings tested.
blocks.zh: 在第二次熱試驗中，ACC 去胺酶的挽救比第一次更好。培養盤顯示熱逆境對照組與熱逆境後處理組之間有明確差異：對照組發生嚴重黃化，而後處理組保有較多生物量與較多葉綠素。後處理熱逆境組的標準化葉綠素含量比熱逆境對照組高 14%。共處理與前處理的挽救不如後處理，但在受測的 9 株苗間維持了穩定的葉綠素量。

blocks.en: Different effects of ACC deaminase at different timings
blocks.text: Different effects of ACC deaminase at different timings
blocks.zh: ACC 去胺酶在不同時機的不同效果

blocks.en: This trial also shows that the application timing of ACC deaminase makes a significant difference to its effectiveness. Under 37 °C heat stress, adding ACC deaminase after the stress and the recovery period kept the most chlorophyll, followed by co-treatment and then pre-treatment. Ethylene production increases at two points, when heat is applied and when it is removed: after leaving the 37 °C incubator, plants enter recovery and produce ethylene to manage cellular damage and adjust their metabolism [18], [19].
blocks.text: This trial also shows that the application timing of ACC deaminase makes a significant difference to its effectiveness. Under 37 °C heat stress, adding ACC deaminase after the stress and the recovery period kept the most chlorophyll, followed by co-treatment and then pre-treatment. Ethylene production increases at two points, when heat is applied and when it is removed: after leaving the 37 °C incubator, plants enter recovery and produce ethylene to manage cellular damage and adjust their metabolism [18], [19].
blocks.zh: 這次試驗也顯示 ACC 去胺酶的施用時機對效果有顯著影響。在 37 °C 熱逆境下，在逆境與恢復期之後加入 ACC 去胺酶保留最多葉綠素，其次是共處理，再次是前處理。乙烯生成會在兩個時點增加：施加熱時與移除熱時；離開 37 °C 培養箱後，植物進入恢復期並生成乙烯，以處理細胞損傷並調整代謝 [18]、[19]。

blocks.en: We encountered several issues when using tip boxes as hydroponic systems, including growth inhibition and contamination. After several trials, we found that Arabidopsis grew better in tube racks, so we switched our culture system from tip boxes to tube racks to improve plant growth and speed up our experiments. The CH Bio peptide pre-tests ran in the tip boxes; the protectant tests below ran on tube racks.
blocks.text: We encountered several issues when using tip boxes as hydroponic systems, including growth inhibition and contamination. After several trials, we found that Arabidopsis grew better in tube racks, so we switched our culture system from tip boxes to tube racks to improve plant growth and speed up our experiments. The CH Bio peptide pre-tests ran in the tip boxes; the protectant tests below ran on tube racks.
blocks.zh: 以吸頭盒作為水耕系統時我們遇到幾個問題，包括生長抑制與污染。經過幾次試驗，我們發現 Arabidopsis 在試管架上長得比較好，於是把培養系統從吸頭盒換成試管架，以改善植物生長並加快實驗進度。CH Bio 胜肽的預試是在吸頭盒中進行；以下的保護劑測試則在試管架上進行。

blocks.en: CH Bio peptide at 1:500 against 100 mM NaCl, by treatment timing
blocks.text: CH Bio peptide at 1:500 against 100 mM NaCl, by treatment timing
blocks.zh: 1:500 的 CH Bio 胜肽對抗 100 mM NaCl，依處理時機

blocks.en: In order to determine suitable experimental conditions, we used CH Bio peptide, a commercial protectant against drought stress, to conduct preliminary tests under both salinity and heat stress at a dilution factor of 1:500. The objective of these pre-tests was to evaluate whether this product exhibits similar protective effects under these two stress conditions.
blocks.text: In order to determine suitable experimental conditions, we used CH Bio peptide, a commercial protectant against drought stress, to conduct preliminary tests under both salinity and heat stress at a dilution factor of 1:500. The objective of these pre-tests was to evaluate whether this product exhibits similar protective effects under these two stress conditions.
blocks.zh: 為了確定合適的實驗條件，我們用對抗乾旱逆境的市售保護劑 CH Bio 胜肽，以 1:500 的稀釋倍率在鹽逆境與熱逆境下進行初步測試。這些預試的目的是評估這個產品在這兩種逆境條件下是否呈現類似的保護效果。

blocks.en: To evaluate the salt sensitivity of Arabidopsis, 13-day-old Arabidopsis were treated with 100 mM NaCl for 7 days. CH Bio peptide treatments were performed using three different regimens, pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment, in separate hydroponic boxes. The control group was also treated with 100 mM NaCl, but not treated with CH Bio peptide. In this test, the co-treatment group grew the best after salinity treatment. We found out that 100 mM of NaCl would cause significant stress on Arabidopsis but won’t cause death, which helped us to determine the appropriate NaCl concentration for further experiments.

CH Bio peptide treatments were performed using three different regimens, pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment, in separate hydroponic boxes. The control group was also treated with 100 mM NaCl, but not treated with CH Bio peptide. In this test, the co-treatment group grew the best after salinity treatment. We found out that 100 mM of NaCl would cause significant stress on Arabidopsis but won’t cause death, which helped us to determine the appropriate NaCl concentration for further experiments.
blocks.zh: 為了評估 Arabidopsis 對鹽的敏感度，13 天齡的 Arabidopsis 以 100 mM NaCl 處理 7 天。CH Bio 胜肽的處理採三種不同方案：前處理、共處理與後處理，分別在不同的水耕箱中進行。對照組同樣以 100 mM NaCl 處理，但不施用 CH Bio 胜肽。在這次測試中，共處理組在鹽度處理後長得最好。我們發現 100 mM 的 NaCl 會對 Arabidopsis 造成顯著逆境但不致死，這幫助我們為後續實驗確定合適的 NaCl 濃度。

blocks.en: Effect of CH Bio peptide on fresh weight, chlorophyll content per plant and relative chlorophyll content in Arabidopsis after 7 days of 100 mM NaCl, at 20 days old.
blocks.text: Effect of CH Bio peptide on fresh weight, chlorophyll content per plant and relative chlorophyll content in Arabidopsis after 7 days of 100 mM NaCl, at 20 days old.
blocks.zh: 100 mM NaCl 處理 7 天後、20 天齡的 Arabidopsis，CH Bio 胜肽對鮮重、每株葉綠素含量與相對葉綠素含量的影響。

blocks.en: The co-treatment group showed higher rescue effectiveness based on the observation of rosette leaf area and also chlorophyll content. After 7 days of salinity stress, most leaves in the co-treatment group remained green, whereas leaves in the other treatment groups turned yellow or white. Moreover, the co-treatment group had the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll contents, showing that the co-treatment group grew the best.

After 7 days of salinity stress, most leaves in the co-treatment group remained green, whereas leaves in the other treatment groups turned yellow or white. Moreover, the co-treatment group had the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll contents, showing that the co-treatment group grew the best.
blocks.zh: 依蓮座葉叢葉面積與葉綠素含量的觀察，共處理組顯示較高的挽救效果。經過 7 天鹽逆境後，共處理組多數葉片仍保持綠色，而其他處理組的葉片轉黃或轉白。此外，共處理組的鮮重與葉綠素含量都最高，顯示共處理組長得最好。

blocks.text: Hydroponics · CH Bio peptide pre-test · 12-day-old plants · 7 days of heat stress

blocks.en: CH Bio peptide against heat stress, by treatment timing
blocks.text: CH Bio peptide against heat stress, by treatment timing
blocks.zh: CH Bio 胜肽對抗熱逆境，依處理時機

blocks.en: Our second set of pre-tests is heat stress testing, where 12-day-old Arabidopsis were treated at 37 °C for 7 days. Except for the control group, CH Bio peptide was applied with a duration of 1 day at 3 different time periods: 1 day before heat treatment (pre-treatment), simultaneously with heat treatment (co-treatment), and 1 day after heat was applied (post-treatment). No obvious difference was shown between the treatment groups based on observation of plant size and color.
blocks.text: Our second set of pre-tests is heat stress testing, where 12-day-old Arabidopsis were treated at 37 °C for 7 days. Except for the control group, CH Bio peptide was applied with a duration of 1 day at 3 different time periods: 1 day before heat treatment (pre-treatment), simultaneously with heat treatment (co-treatment), and 1 day after heat was applied (post-treatment). No obvious difference was shown between the treatment groups based on observation of plant size and color.
blocks.zh: 我們第二組預試是熱逆境測試，12 天齡的 Arabidopsis 在 37 °C 下處理 7 天。除對照組外，CH Bio 胜肽在 3 個不同時間點各施用 1 天：熱處理前 1 天（前處理）、與熱處理同時（共處理），以及施加熱之後 1 天（後處理）。從植物大小與顏色的觀察來看，各處理組之間沒有明顯差異。

blocks.en: Effect of CH Bio peptide on fresh weight, chlorophyll content per plant and relative chlorophyll content in Arabidopsis after 7 days of heat stress, at 19 days old.
blocks.text: Effect of CH Bio peptide on fresh weight, chlorophyll content per plant and relative chlorophyll content in Arabidopsis after 7 days of heat stress, at 19 days old.
blocks.zh: 熱逆境處理 7 天後、19 天齡的 Arabidopsis，CH Bio 胜肽對鮮重、每株葉綠素含量與相對葉綠素含量的影響。

blocks.en: The pre-treatment group had a relatively high fresh weight among all the groups, and the control and pre-treatment groups had similar chlorophyll content, which indicates a relatively positive effect of the CH Bio peptide on plant growth. However, the relative chlorophyll content of all treatments was lower than that of the control. We think failed manual operation may have caused this inconsistency.

However, the relative chlorophyll content of all treatments was lower than that of the control. We think failed manual operation may have caused this inconsistency.
blocks.zh: 前處理組在所有組別中鮮重相對較高，對照組與前處理組的葉綠素含量相近，顯示 CH Bio 胜肽對植物生長有相對正面的效果。不過，所有處理的相對葉綠素含量都低於對照組。我們認為這個不一致可能是人工操作失誤造成的。

blocks.en: WB800 culture (protectant-negative control), by dilution and pH
blocks.text: WB800 culture (protectant-negative control), by dilution and pH
blocks.zh: WB800 培養液（保護劑陰性對照），依稀釋倍數與 pH

blocks.en: In our proposed system, the protectants are released directly from the bioreactor, so we first needed to minimize the potential effects of the TB medium. Before applying the protectants, B. subtilis WB800 culture alone was pretested to exclude the effect of the medium on the plants, at dilution factors of 0, 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16.
blocks.text: In our proposed system, the protectants are released directly from the bioreactor, so we first needed to minimize the potential effects of the TB medium. Before applying the protectants, B. subtilis WB800 culture alone was pretested to exclude the effect of the medium on the plants, at dilution factors of 0, 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16.
blocks.zh: 在我們提出的系統中，保護劑直接從生物反應器釋出，因此我們首先需要把 TB 培養液可能造成的影響降到最低。在施用保護劑之前，我們先單獨預試 B. subtilis WB800 培養液，以排除培養液對植物的影響，稀釋倍數為 0、1、1/2、1/4、1/8 與 1/16。

blocks.en: The pH of the 0.1× MS medium is 5.7, which is suitable for plant growth, but the optimal pH for 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase (ACCD) activity is 7.5 [16]. ACCD still shows about 75% of its activity at pH 7 [16], so we compared plant growth at pH 5.7 and pH 7.
blocks.text: The pH of the 0.1× MS medium is 5.7, which is suitable for plant growth, but the optimal pH for 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase (ACCD) activity is 7.5 [16]. ACCD still shows about 75% of its activity at pH 7 [16], so we compared plant growth at pH 5.7 and pH 7.
blocks.zh: 0.1× MS 培養液的 pH 為 5.7，適合植物生長，但 1-胺基環丙烷-1-羧酸去胺酶（ACCD）活性的最適 pH 為 7.5 [16]。ACCD 在 pH 7 時仍有約 75% 的活性 [16]，因此我們比較了 pH 5.7 與 pH 7 下的植物生長。

blocks.en: Representative images of 18-day-old Arabidopsis after 5 days of treatment with B. subtilis WB800 cultures at different pH and dilution factors.
blocks.text: Representative images of 18-day-old Arabidopsis after 5 days of treatment with B. subtilis WB800 cultures at different pH and dilution factors.
blocks.zh: 以不同 pH 與稀釋倍數的 B. subtilis WB800 培養液處理 5 天後、18 天齡 Arabidopsis 的代表性影像。

blocks.en: Effects of pH and culture concentration on fresh weight and chlorophyll content per plant in Arabidopsis.
blocks.text: Effects of pH and culture concentration on fresh weight and chlorophyll content per plant in Arabidopsis.
blocks.zh: pH 與培養液濃度對 Arabidopsis 鮮重與每株葉綠素含量的影響。

blocks.en: Arabidopsis treated with B. subtilis WB800 cultures showed signs of stress under both pH conditions. At the 1 and 1/2 dilution factors the stress was most severe: leaves turned yellow and the plants were small. The 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16 groups showed significant anthocyanin accumulation, a stress response visible as the darker color of the leaves. The untreated group, which received no WB800 culture, had the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll content of all groups, suggesting that WB800 culture may negatively affect plant growth at certain concentrations. Based on these results, we decided to dilute the culture at least 16-fold in subsequent experiments.
blocks.text: Arabidopsis treated with B. subtilis WB800 cultures showed signs of stress under both pH conditions. At the 1 and 1/2 dilution factors the stress was most severe: leaves turned yellow and the plants were small. The 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16 groups showed significant anthocyanin accumulation, a stress response visible as the darker color of the leaves. The untreated group, which received no WB800 culture, had the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll content of all groups, suggesting that WB800 culture may negatively affect plant growth at certain concentrations. Based on these results, we decided to dilute the culture at least 16-fold in subsequent experiments.
blocks.zh: 以 B. subtilis WB800 培養液處理的 Arabidopsis 在兩種 pH 條件下都出現逆境徵狀。在 1 與 1/2 稀釋倍數下逆境最嚴重：葉片轉黃、植株矮小。1/4、1/8 與 1/16 組出現明顯的花青素累積，這是一種可從葉色變深看出的逆境反應。未處理組（未加 WB800 培養液）在所有組別中鮮重與葉綠素含量最高，顯示 WB800 培養液在某些濃度下可能對植物生長有負面影響。根據這些結果，我們決定在後續實驗中把培養液至少稀釋 16 倍。

blocks.en: Hydroponics · ACC deaminase · 13-day-old plants · 5 days of salt stress

blocks.en: ACC deaminase against 100 mM NaCl, by concentration
blocks.text: ACC deaminase against 100 mM NaCl, by concentration
blocks.zh: ACC 去胺酶對抗 100 mM NaCl，依濃度

blocks.en: To evaluate the protective effect of ACC deaminase under salinity stress, 13-day-old Arabidopsis seedlings were treated with 100 mM NaCl for 5 days and exposed to ACC deaminase at dilution factors of 1/60, 1/40, 1/20 and 1/10. Because ACC deaminase is a pyridoxal 5′-phosphate (PLP)-dependent enzyme [17], PLP was applied together with it, at a 1:100 dilution in 0.1× MS medium.
blocks.text: To evaluate the protective effect of ACC deaminase under salinity stress, 13-day-old Arabidopsis seedlings were treated with 100 mM NaCl for 5 days and exposed to ACC deaminase at dilution factors of 1/60, 1/40, 1/20 and 1/10. Because ACC deaminase is a pyridoxal 5′-phosphate (PLP)-dependent enzyme [17], PLP was applied together with it, at a 1:100 dilution in 0.1× MS medium.
blocks.zh: 為了評估 ACC 去胺酶在鹽逆境下的保護效果，13 天齡的 Arabidopsis 苗以 100 mM NaCl 處理 5 天，並暴露於稀釋倍數 1/60、1/40、1/20 與 1/10 的 ACC 去胺酶。由於 ACC 去胺酶是依賴吡哆醛 5′-磷酸（PLP）的酵素 [17]，PLP 與它一同施用，在 0.1× MS 培養液中以 1:100 稀釋。

blocks.en: Treatment groups of 18-day-old Arabidopsis after 5 days of ACC deaminase and NaCl.
blocks.text: Treatment groups of 18-day-old Arabidopsis after 5 days of ACC deaminase and NaCl.
blocks.zh: 經過 5 天 ACC 去胺酶與 NaCl 處理後、18 天齡 Arabidopsis 的各處理組。

blocks.en: Effects of different concentrations of ACCD on Arabidopsis fresh weight and chlorophyll contents per plant after salinity stress.
blocks.text: Effects of different concentrations of ACCD on Arabidopsis fresh weight and chlorophyll contents per plant after salinity stress.
blocks.zh: 鹽逆境後不同濃度的 ACCD 對 Arabidopsis 鮮重與每株葉綠素含量的影響。

blocks.en: The 1/20 WB800 culture used as the negative control showed a clear stress response of its own: the plants stayed much smaller and the leaves accumulated anthocyanin heavily, so a 1/20 culture still affects growth. Without NaCl, the leaves of the 1/10 and 1/20 ACC deaminase groups bleached while the 1/40 group did not, and the 1/40 group came closest to the no-culture (0 ACCD) group on both fresh weight and chlorophyll content. We therefore set 1/40 as the highest culture dose and as the negative control for later experiments.
blocks.text: The 1/20 WB800 culture used as the negative control showed a clear stress response of its own: the plants stayed much smaller and the leaves accumulated anthocyanin heavily, so a 1/20 culture still affects growth. Without NaCl, the leaves of the 1/10 and 1/20 ACC deaminase groups bleached while the 1/40 group did not, and the 1/40 group came closest to the no-culture (0 ACCD) group on both fresh weight and chlorophyll content. We therefore set 1/40 as the highest culture dose and as the negative control for later experiments.
blocks.zh: 作為陰性對照的 1/20 WB800 培養液本身就顯示明確的逆境反應：植株明顯較小，葉片大量累積花青素，可見 1/20 的培養液仍會影響生長。在沒有 NaCl 的情況下，1/10 與 1/20 ACC 去胺酶組的葉片白化，而 1/40 組沒有，且 1/40 組在鮮重與葉綠素含量上都最接近未加培養液（0 ACCD）的組別。因此我們把 1/40 定為最高的培養液劑量，並作為後續實驗的陰性對照。

blocks.en: After the experiment, Dr. Peng pointed out that we had not standardized the volume of B. subtilis culture added to each group, so higher ACC deaminase levels came with larger volumes of culture. We could not separate the effects of ACC deaminase from those of the culture medium, so the protective effect of ACC deaminase under salinity stress could not be determined from this run. It showed us the importance of standardizing the culture volume across all treatment groups.
blocks.text: After the experiment, Dr. Peng pointed out that we had not standardized the volume of B. subtilis culture added to each group, so higher ACC deaminase levels came with larger volumes of culture. We could not separate the effects of ACC deaminase from those of the culture medium, so the protective effect of ACC deaminase under salinity stress could not be determined from this run. It showed us the importance of standardizing the culture volume across all treatment groups.
blocks.zh: 實驗結束後，Dr. Peng 指出我們沒有把加到每一組的 B. subtilis 培養液體積標準化，因此 ACC 去胺酶濃度較高時培養液的體積也較大。我們無法把 ACC 去胺酶的效應與培養液的效應分開，所以這一次無法判定 ACC 去胺酶在鹽逆境下的保護效果。這讓我們看到把培養液體積在所有處理組之間標準化的重要性。

blocks.en: ACC deaminase against 37 °C heat stress, by concentration
blocks.text: ACC deaminase against 37 °C heat stress, by concentration
blocks.zh: ACC 去胺酶對抗 37 °C 熱逆境，依濃度

blocks.en: We followed the heat stress conditions of Lee et al. [2], because long-term heat stress more closely reflects the temperature fluctuations plants experience in natural environments. The experiment has a control condition and a heat stress condition, and four ACC deaminase dilutions (1:40, 1:60, 1:80 and 1:100) were tested under each.
blocks.text: We followed the heat stress conditions of Lee et al. [2], because long-term heat stress more closely reflects the temperature fluctuations plants experience in natural environments. The experiment has a control condition and a heat stress condition, and four ACC deaminase dilutions (1:40, 1:60, 1:80 and 1:100) were tested under each.
blocks.zh: 我們沿用 Lee et al. [2] 的熱逆境條件，因為長期熱逆境更接近植物在自然環境中經歷的溫度起伏。實驗設有對照條件與熱逆境條件，每一種條件下都測試四個 ACC 去胺酶稀釋倍數（1:40、1:60、1:80 與 1:100）。

blocks.en: Effects of different concentrations of ACCD on Arabidopsis fresh weight and chlorophyll contents per plant after heat stress. WB800 is the TB medium carrying B. subtilis without a protectant.
blocks.text: Effects of different concentrations of ACCD on Arabidopsis fresh weight and chlorophyll contents per plant after heat stress. WB800 is the TB medium carrying B. subtilis without a protectant.
blocks.zh: 熱逆境後不同濃度的 ACCD 對 Arabidopsis 鮮重與每株葉綠素含量的影響。WB800 是帶有 B. subtilis、但不含保護劑的 TB 培養液。

blocks.en: After 4 days of 37 °C heat stress, Arabidopsis showed a significant decrease in fresh weight and chlorophyll content. Fresh weight did not differ much between the ACC deaminase dilutions, so the separation between them is in chlorophyll content, which also matches what the racks looked like. The 1/40, 1/60 and 1/80 ACC deaminase groups had slightly higher chlorophyll content than the controls (the 1/40 WB800 group and the 0.1× MS medium group), while the 1/100 group had the lowest chlorophyll content of the ACC deaminase groups, the weakest protective effect. ACC deaminase therefore shows potential to improve heat tolerance in Arabidopsis at a dilution of 1/80 or more concentrated.
blocks.text: After 4 days of 37 °C heat stress, Arabidopsis showed a significant decrease in fresh weight and chlorophyll content. Fresh weight did not differ much between the ACC deaminase dilutions, so the separation between them is in chlorophyll content, which also matches what the racks looked like. The 1/40, 1/60 and 1/80 ACC deaminase groups had slightly higher chlorophyll content than the controls (the 1/40 WB800 group and the 0.1× MS medium group), while the 1/100 group had the lowest chlorophyll content of the ACC deaminase groups, the weakest protective effect. ACC deaminase therefore shows potential to improve heat tolerance in Arabidopsis at a dilution of 1/80 or more concentrated.
blocks.zh: 經過 4 天 37 °C 熱逆境後，Arabidopsis 的鮮重與葉綠素含量顯著下降。各 ACC 去胺酶稀釋倍數之間鮮重差異不大，因此彼此的區別在葉綠素含量，而這也與試管架上看到的情形相符。1/40、1/60 與 1/80 ACC 去胺酶組的葉綠素含量略高於對照組（1/40 WB800 組與 0.1× MS 培養液組），而 1/100 組在各 ACC 去胺酶組中葉綠素含量最低，保護效果最弱。因此 ACC 去胺酶在 1/80 或更濃的稀釋倍數下，顯示有改善 Arabidopsis 耐熱性的潛力。

blocks.en: Effects of different concentrations of BoPep4 on Arabidopsis fresh weight and chlorophyll contents per plant after heat stress.

blocks.en: 37 °C heat stress caused significant damage, decreasing fresh weight and chlorophyll content. BoPEP4 slightly rescued Arabidopsis at 1/40, with higher chlorophyll content than both the 1/40 WB800 group and the 0.1× MS medium group. Between 1/60 and 1/100 there was no significant difference, with chlorophyll content as low as the control. BoPEP4 therefore gives a slight rescue under heat stress at a dilution of 1/40.
blocks.text: 37 °C heat stress caused significant damage, decreasing fresh weight and chlorophyll content. BoPEP4 slightly rescued Arabidopsis at 1/40, with higher chlorophyll content than both the 1/40 WB800 group and the 0.1× MS medium group. Between 1/60 and 1/100 there was no significant difference, with chlorophyll content as low as the control. BoPEP4 therefore gives a slight rescue under heat stress at a dilution of 1/40.
blocks.zh: 37 °C 熱逆境造成顯著傷害，使鮮重與葉綠素含量下降。BoPEP4 在 1/40 下對 Arabidopsis 有輕微挽救，葉綠素含量高於 1/40 WB800 組與 0.1× MS 培養液組。1/60 到 1/100 之間沒有顯著差異，葉綠素含量低到與對照組相當。因此 BoPEP4 在 1/40 的稀釋倍數下對熱逆境有輕微的挽救。

WB800 is the TB medium carrying B. subtilis without a protectant. blocks.text: Effects of different concentrations of BoPep4 on Arabidopsis fresh weight and chlorophyll contents per plant after salinity stress. WB800 is the TB medium carrying B. subtilis without a protectant. The samples dried between harvest and reading, so the chlorophyll readout we use here is the amount per plant rather than the relative content.
blocks.zh: 鹽逆境後不同濃度的 BoPep4 對 Arabidopsis 鮮重與每株葉綠素含量的影響。WB800 是帶有 B. subtilis、但不含保護劑的 TB 培養液。樣品在採收與判讀之間乾掉了，因此這裡採用的葉綠素指標是每株的量，而不是相對含量。

blocks.en: In the groups without salinity stress, Arabidopsis showed slight anthocyanin accumulation at BoPEP4 dilutions from 1/40 to 1/100, while the 1/40 WB800 and 0.1× MS medium groups did not, which suggests that BoPEP4 might inhibit plant growth when no stress is applied.
blocks.text: In the groups without salinity stress, Arabidopsis showed slight anthocyanin accumulation at BoPEP4 dilutions from 1/40 to 1/100, while the 1/40 WB800 and 0.1× MS medium groups did not, which suggests that BoPEP4 might inhibit plant growth when no stress is applied.
blocks.zh: 在未受鹽逆境的各組中，BoPEP4 稀釋倍數由 1/40 到 1/100 的 Arabidopsis 出現輕微的花青素累積，而 1/40 WB800 與 0.1× MS 培養液組沒有，這表示在未施加逆境時 BoPEP4 可能抑制植物生長。

blocks.en: Under 100 mM NaCl, fresh weight and chlorophyll content fell sharply and most groups showed leaf bleaching and died. The leaves of the 1/40 BoPEP4 group mostly stayed green, with only a little anthocyanin, and this group had the highest fresh weight and the highest chlorophyll content per plant of all the groups under salt. BoPEP4 at 1/40 or stronger therefore improved the salinity tolerance of Arabidopsis, while weaker concentrations showed no rescue under salinity stress.

The leaves of the 1/40 BoPEP4 group mostly stayed green, with only a little anthocyanin, and this group had the highest fresh weight and the highest chlorophyll content per plant of all the groups under salt. BoPEP4 at 1/40 or stronger therefore improved the salinity tolerance of Arabidopsis, while weaker concentrations showed no rescue under salinity stress.
blocks.zh: 在 100 mM NaCl 下，鮮重與葉綠素含量急遽下降，多數組別葉片白化並死亡。1/40 BoPEP4 組的葉片大多保持綠色，只有少量花青素，而且這一組在所有加鹽組別中鮮重最高、每株葉綠素含量也最高。因此 BoPEP4 在 1/40 或更濃時改善了 Arabidopsis 的耐鹽性，而較稀的濃度在鹽逆境下沒有顯示挽救。

blocks.en: Because of time constraints, only two B. subtilis-expressed protectants, ACC deaminase and BoPEP4, were evaluated in the hydroponic system.

blocks.zh: 由於時間限制，水耕系統中只評估了兩種由 B. subtilis 表現的保護劑：ACC 去胺酶與 BoPEP4。

blocks.en: ACC deaminase showed potential to improve heat tolerance at a dilution of 1/80 or more concentrated.
blocks.text: ACC deaminase showed potential to improve heat tolerance at a dilution of 1/80 or more concentrated.

blocks.en: BoPEP4 at 1/40 improved salinity tolerance and gave a slight protective effect against heat stress.

blocks.en: Establish the appropriate stress levels and treatment method
blocks.text: Establish the appropriate stress levels and treatment method
blocks.zh: 確立合適的逆境強度與處理方式

blocks.en: We directly compared the sub-irrigation accumulation method [6] with the top-down wash (drench) method [7] on 2-week-old Arabidopsis thaliana. Seeds were stratified in 1 mL of sterile water for 4 days and dispersed evenly into soil pots with a micropipette, followed by selection for uniform rosette development. The accumulation method applied sequential sub-irrigation doses of 100 mM NaCl by tray capillary action, with plain-water irrigation between doses. The wash method applied sequential surface drenches of 100, 200 and 300 mM NaCl (30 to 50 mL per pot) without plain water until the pots were fully saturated and the root zone had equilibrated. Phenotype, fresh weight and chlorophyll were measured at the end of the stress cycle.
blocks.text: We directly compared the sub-irrigation accumulation method [6] with the top-down wash (drench) method [7] on 2-week-old Arabidopsis thaliana. Seeds were stratified in 1 mL of sterile water for 4 days and dispersed evenly into soil pots with a micropipette, followed by selection for uniform rosette development. The accumulation method applied sequential sub-irrigation doses of 100 mM NaCl by tray capillary action, with plain-water irrigation between doses. The wash method applied sequential surface drenches of 100, 200 and 300 mM NaCl (30 to 50 mL per pot) without plain water until the pots were fully saturated and the root zone had equilibrated. Phenotype, fresh weight and chlorophyll were measured at the end of the stress cycle.
blocks.zh: 我們在 2 週齡的 Arabidopsis thaliana 上直接比較底部灌溉累積法 [6] 與由上往下的沖洗（淋灌）法 [7]。種子在 1 mL 無菌水中層積 4 天，以微量吸管均勻分散播入土壤盆，之後再挑選蓮座葉叢發育一致的植株。累積法以底盤毛細作用依序給予 100 mM NaCl，各次之間以清水灌溉。沖洗法則依序在表面淋灌 100、200 與 300 mM NaCl（每盆 30 至 50 mL），期間不給清水，直到盆土完全飽和、根圈達到平衡。逆境循環結束時量測表現型、鮮重與葉綠素。

blocks.en: The top-down wash protocol induced reproducible salt stress and observable phenotypic differences in soil-grown seedlings, while the sub-irrigation accumulation method did not. First row, day 0 of salinity application; second row, day 5.
blocks.text: The top-down wash protocol induced reproducible salt stress and observable phenotypic differences in soil-grown seedlings, while the sub-irrigation accumulation method did not. First row, day 0 of salinity application; second row, day 5.
blocks.zh: 由上往下的沖洗流程在土壤栽培的苗上誘發了可重現的鹽逆境與可觀察的表現型差異，而底部灌溉累積法則沒有。第一排為施加鹽度的第 0 天；第二排為第 5 天。

blocks.en: Fresh weight (g) of soil-grown Arabidopsis thaliana under the top-down wash protocol (Prof. Cheng) and the sub-irrigation accumulation method (100 mM accumulate).
blocks.text: Fresh weight (g) of soil-grown Arabidopsis thaliana under the top-down wash protocol (Prof. Cheng) and the sub-irrigation accumulation method (100 mM accumulate).
blocks.zh: 土壤栽培 Arabidopsis thaliana 在由上往下沖洗流程（Prof. Cheng）與底部灌溉累積法（100 mM 累積）下的鮮重（g）。

blocks.en: Relative chlorophyll content of the same two groups, without fresh weight normalization.
blocks.text: Relative chlorophyll content of the same two groups, without fresh weight normalization.
blocks.zh: 同樣這兩組未以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素含量。

blocks.en: Both the accumulation and the wash pots started out with lush leaves and round, broad leaf areas. After 5 days of salinity application, the accumulation pots were close to where they had started, while the wash pots had lost leaf area, shrunk and turned chlorotic, which is why the two methods are read as day 0 against day 5.
blocks.text: Both the accumulation and the wash pots started out with lush leaves and round, broad leaf areas. After 5 days of salinity application, the accumulation pots were close to where they had started, while the wash pots had lost leaf area, shrunk and turned chlorotic, which is why the two methods are read as day 0 against day 5.
blocks.zh: 累積法與沖洗法的盆栽一開始葉片都很茂盛，葉面圓而寬。施加鹽度 5 天後，累積法的盆栽與一開始差不多，而沖洗法的盆栽則葉面積減少、植株縮小並黃化，這就是為什麼兩種方法被讀成第 0 天對第 5 天。

blocks.en: The sub-irrigation accumulation method did not induce sufficient osmotic stress, giving lush rosettes and a high average fresh weight of approximately 0.42 g, because the plain water between doses flushed accumulated ions out of the active root zone. In contrast, Prof. Cheng’s top-down drench gave a fresh weight of 0.15 g, a reduction of approximately 64%, which shows that top-down drenching impairs cell expansion and tissue water accumulation. The drench protocol produced clear, reproducible growth inhibition and salt stress symptoms without immediate lethal necrosis, which makes it the better method for high-concentration soil screening despite the lower baseline biomass. Both protocols gave comparable volumetric chlorophyll concentrations near 1.0 mg/L: under the milder accumulation method, pigment density stays high because chloroplast development is uninhibited, while under the wash method the smaller rosettes concentrate the remaining pigment.

In contrast, Prof. Cheng’s top-down drench gave a fresh weight of 0.15 g, a reduction of approximately 64%, which shows that top-down drenching impairs cell expansion and tissue water accumulation. The drench protocol produced clear, reproducible growth inhibition and salt stress symptoms without immediate lethal necrosis, which makes it the better method for high-concentration soil screening despite the lower baseline biomass. Both protocols gave comparable volumetric chlorophyll concentrations near 1.0 mg/L: under the milder accumulation method, pigment density stays high because chloroplast development is uninhibited, while under the wash method the smaller rosettes concentrate the remaining pigment.
blocks.zh: 底部灌溉累積法未能誘發足夠的滲透逆境，蓮座葉叢茂盛，平均鮮重高達約 0.42 g，因為各次之間的清水把累積的離子沖出了活躍根圈。相對地，Prof. Cheng 的由上往下淋灌使鮮重為 0.15 g，下降約 64%，顯示由上淋灌會妨礙細胞擴張與組織水分累積。淋灌流程產生了明確、可重現的生長抑制與鹽逆境徵狀，且未造成立即的致死壞死，因此儘管基線生物量較低，它仍是高濃度土壤篩選較好的方法。兩種流程得到的體積葉綠素濃度相當，都接近 1.0 mg/L：在較溫和的累積法下，色素密度保持高，因為葉綠體發育未受抑制；而在沖洗法下，較小的蓮座葉叢把剩餘的色素濃縮起來。
對 ACC 去胺酶測試的意涵

blocks.en: The choice of salinity treatment is particularly important for evaluating protection by ACC deaminase. Under salinity stress, plants accumulate 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid (ACC), the precursor of the plant hormone ethylene. Although ethylene has important roles in normal development and stress responses, excessive stress-induced ethylene can inhibit root elongation and plant growth. Orozco-Mosqueda et al. [21] reviewed evidence that plant-growth-promoting bacteria with ACC deaminase degrade ACC into ammonia and α-ketobutyrate, reducing excess ethylene and helping plants maintain growth under saline conditions, which supports using biomass and growth traits to study ACC deaminase. A salinity treatment that causes little growth inhibition makes it hard to distinguish a protective effect from normal growth, while one that causes extensive tissue damage leaves too little viable growth to measure a rescue. The lower mean fresh weight under the top-down drench therefore makes it a promising method for ACC deaminase screening, provided the plants remain viable and the response is reproducible across biological replicates.
blocks.text: The choice of salinity treatment is particularly important for evaluating protection by ACC deaminase. Under salinity stress, plants accumulate 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid (ACC), the precursor of the plant hormone ethylene. Although ethylene has important roles in normal development and stress responses, excessive stress-induced ethylene can inhibit root elongation and plant growth. Orozco-Mosqueda et al. [21] reviewed evidence that plant-growth-promoting bacteria with ACC deaminase degrade ACC into ammonia and α-ketobutyrate, reducing excess ethylene and helping plants maintain growth under saline conditions, which supports using biomass and growth traits to study ACC deaminase. A salinity treatment that causes little growth inhibition makes it hard to distinguish a protective effect from normal growth, while one that causes extensive tissue damage leaves too little viable growth to measure a rescue. The lower mean fresh weight under the top-down drench therefore makes it a promising method for ACC deaminase screening, provided the plants remain viable and the response is reproducible across biological replicates.
blocks.zh: 鹽度處理方式的選擇，對評估 ACC 去胺酶的保護作用特別重要。在鹽逆境下，植物會累積 1-胺基環丙烷-1-羧酸（ACC），也就是植物荷爾蒙乙烯的前驅物。雖然乙烯在正常發育與逆境反應中有重要角色，但逆境誘導的過量乙烯會抑制根伸長與植物生長。Orozco-Mosqueda et al. [21] 回顧的證據指出，具 ACC 去胺酶的植物生長促進菌會把 ACC 分解為氨與 α-酮丁酸，減少過量的乙烯，幫助植物在鹽化條件下維持生長，這支持以生物量與生長性狀來研究 ACC 去胺酶。幾乎不造成生長抑制的鹽度處理，會讓保護效果難以與正常生長區分；而造成大面積組織傷害的處理，則留下太少可存活的生長量來量測挽救。因此由上淋灌下較低的平均鮮重，使它成為 ACC 去胺酶篩選有潛力的方法，前提是植物仍保持存活，且反應在各生物重複間可重現。

blocks.en: In this preliminary soil assay, pre-treatment and co-treatment did not visibly prevent leaf bleaching, while post-treatment showed a limited effect on chlorosis. Without fresh-weight normalization, the measured extract concentrations were about 1.00 mg/L for the untreated control, 0.67 for pre-treatment, 0.30 for co-treatment and 1.13 for post-treatment. Post-treatment, applied one day after 300 mM NaCl, gave the highest unnormalized chlorophyll concentration, about 13% above the untreated control, suggesting that ACC deaminase applied later may still influence chlorophyll after severe salinity stress has begun. Further experiments are needed to confirm this response.

Without fresh-weight normalization, the measured extract concentrations were about 1.00 mg/L for the untreated control, 0.67 for pre-treatment, 0.30 for co-treatment and 1.13 for post-treatment. blocks.zh: 在這次初步的土壤檢測中，前處理與共處理都沒有明顯防止葉片白化，後處理對黃化則有有限的效果。在未以鮮重標準化的情況下，量測到的萃取液濃度約為未處理對照組 1.00 mg/L、前處理 0.67、共處理 0.30、後處理 1.13。後處理在 300 mM NaCl 之後一天施用，得到最高的未標準化葉綠素濃度，約比未處理對照組高 13%，顯示在嚴重鹽逆境已經開始之後較晚施用 ACC 去胺酶，仍可能影響葉綠素。這個反應需要進一步實驗才能確認。

blocks.en: Under our conditions, 100 mM NaCl was not enough to induce clear visible stress, whereas symptoms became apparent at 300 mM, so 300 mM became our soil stress baseline. Because post-treatment was applied one day after the first 300 mM NaCl exposure, it can be seen as a delayed co-treatment given once salinity stress had developed, while the co-treatment groups were dosed while the stress was still mild. The detectability of a protective effect therefore depends on the severity of the stress: under insufficient stress, protected and unprotected plants are hard to tell apart, and under severe stress the tissue damage may exceed the protection the treatment provides.

Because post-treatment was applied one day after the first 300 mM NaCl exposure, it can be seen as a delayed co-treatment given once salinity stress had developed, while the co-treatment groups were dosed while the stress was still mild. The detectability of a protective effect therefore depends on the severity of the stress: under insufficient stress, protected and unprotected plants are hard to tell apart, and under severe stress the tissue damage may exceed the protection the treatment provides.
blocks.zh: 在我們的條件下，100 mM NaCl 不足以誘發明顯可見的逆境，而徵狀在 300 mM 時變得明顯，因此 300 mM 成為我們土壤逆境的基準。由於後處理是在第一次 300 mM NaCl 暴露後一天施用，它可以看成在鹽逆境已經發展之後給予的延遲共處理，而共處理各組則是在逆境還很輕微時給藥。因此保護效果能不能被偵測到，取決於逆境的嚴重度：逆境不足時，受保護與未受保護的植物難以分辨；逆境嚴重時，組織傷害可能超過處理所能提供的保護。

blocks.en: The control pots show a healthy, centered rosette with dark green leaves and vigorous growth. Under 37 °C heat stress, the plants without ACC deaminase show clear wilting, reduced rosette size, leaf bleaching and lower overall biomass in both trials. Plants pre-treated with ACC deaminase before the heat show moderate leaf survival, although chlorosis and stunted leaf expansion are still visible in both trials. The co-treatment pots keep a fuller canopy, greener leaves and better structural integrity than the heat-stressed control, which points to some protection during sustained thermal stress. Post-treatment recovered unevenly: some green tissue is preserved, but most leaves show anthocyanin build-up (purple hues) and bleaching along the rims, and this group bolted the most and carried the tallest bolting stems of any group, so it was the most stressed under the conditions we set.

Under 37 °C heat stress, the plants without ACC deaminase show clear wilting, reduced rosette size, leaf bleaching and lower overall biomass in both trials. Plants pre-treated with ACC deaminase before the heat show moderate leaf survival, although chlorosis and stunted leaf expansion are still visible in both trials. The co-treatment pots keep a fuller canopy, greener leaves and better structural integrity than the heat-stressed control, which points to some protection during sustained thermal stress. Post-treatment recovered unevenly: some green tissue is preserved, but most leaves show anthocyanin build-up (purple hues) and bleaching along the rims, and this group bolted the most and carried the tallest bolting stems of any group, so it was the most stressed under the conditions we set.
blocks.zh: 對照組的盆栽呈現健康、居中的蓮座葉叢，葉色深綠、生長旺盛。在 37 °C 熱逆境下，未加 ACC 去胺酶的植物在兩次試驗中都明顯萎凋、蓮座葉叢變小、葉片白化，整體生物量也較低。在加熱前先以 ACC 去胺酶前處理的植物，葉片存活情況中等，不過兩次試驗仍可見黃化與葉片擴張受阻。共處理的盆栽相較熱逆境對照組保有較完整的葉幕、較綠的葉片與較好的結構完整性，顯示在持續熱逆境期間有一些保護作用。後處理的恢復並不一致：有部分綠色組織保留下來，但多數葉片出現花青素累積（紫色色調）與葉緣白化，而且這一組抽梗最多、花梗也是所有組別中最高的，因此在我們設定的條件下它受到的逆境最大。

blocks.en: The unstressed controls sit at a baseline fresh weight of about 0.12 g. Under 37 °C heat stress without ACC deaminase, fresh weight rises instead of falling, to 0.195 g in trial 1 and 0.225 g in trial 2, which we read as a difference in the developmental stage each pot had reached, not as a benefit of the heat. Among the treated groups, co-treatment reached the highest fresh weight in trial 1 (0.228 g) but not in trial 2 (0.166 g, below the heat-stressed control), and post-treatment was the lowest under heat in both trials, at 0.103 g and 0.052 g. Fresh weight here is one pot per condition, so each bar is a single measurement, not a replicated mean.

Among the treated groups, co-treatment reached the highest fresh weight in trial 1 (0.228 g) but not in trial 2 (0.166 g, below the heat-stressed control), and post-treatment was the lowest under heat in both trials, at 0.103 g and 0.052 g. blocks.zh: 未受逆境的對照組鮮重基線約 0.12 g。在 37 °C 熱逆境、未加 ACC 去胺酶的情況下，鮮重反而上升而非下降，試驗 1 為 0.195 g、試驗 2 為 0.225 g，我們把這解讀為各盆所達到的發育階段不同，而不是熱帶來的好處。在受處理的各組中，共處理在試驗 1 達到最高鮮重（0.228 g），但試驗 2 沒有（0.166 g，低於熱逆境對照組），而後處理在兩次試驗的熱逆境下都最低，分別為 0.103 g 與 0.052 g。這裡每一種條件只有一盆，所以每一根長條都是單次量測，不是重複的平均值。

blocks.en: Normalized to fresh weight (panel b), the unstressed plants keep a chlorophyll index near 1.0. Pre-treatment holds that level in trial 1 (1.00) while the heat-stressed control drops to 0.55 and co-treatment to 0.48; in trial 2 the same three read 0.77, 0.69 and 0.46. Because normalizing by fresh weight favors the groups with the least tissue, we read the ordering off panel c, the extract concentration without normalization. There the three timings fall in the same order in both trials: pre-treatment 1.05, co-treatment 0.91 and post-treatment 0.75 mg/L in trial 1, and 0.89, 0.63 and 0.355 mg/L in trial 2.
blocks.text: Normalized to fresh weight (panel b), the unstressed plants keep a chlorophyll index near 1.0. Pre-treatment holds that level in trial 1 (1.00) while the heat-stressed control drops to 0.55 and co-treatment to 0.48; in trial 2 the same three read 0.77, 0.69 and 0.46. Because normalizing by fresh weight favors the groups with the least tissue, we read the ordering off panel c, the extract concentration without normalization. There the three timings fall in the same order in both trials: pre-treatment 1.05, co-treatment 0.91 and post-treatment 0.75 mg/L in trial 1, and 0.89, 0.63 and 0.355 mg/L in trial 2.
blocks.zh: 以鮮重標準化後（圖板 b），未受逆境的植物葉綠素指數維持在接近 1.0。前處理在試驗 1 維持了這個水準（1.00），而熱逆境對照組降到 0.55、共處理降到 0.48；在試驗 2 中這三者分別為 0.77、0.69 與 0.46。由於以鮮重標準化會偏向組織最少的組別，我們改以圖板 c，也就是未標準化的萃取液濃度來看排序。在那裡，三個時機在兩次試驗中的順序相同：試驗 1 為前處理 1.05、共處理 0.91、後處理 0.75 mg/L；試驗 2 為 0.89、0.63 與 0.355 mg/L。

blocks.en: Post-treatment did least for plants under 37 °C heat, and in both trials its chlorophyll and its fresh weight came in below the heat-stressed control, which is what applying a protectant after the stress has already damaged the plant looks like. Pre-treatment held the most chlorophyll of the three timings in both trials, and exceeded the heat-stressed control in trial 1 though not in trial 2. On this platform the protectant therefore did most when it was already in place before the heat arrived, which is the argument for forecasting the stress and not waiting to react to it. The agar heat sets do not rank the timings the same way, so the two platforms do not yet agree on a best timing.

Pre-treatment held the most chlorophyll of the three timings in both trials, and exceeded the heat-stressed control in trial 1 though not in trial 2. On this platform the protectant therefore did most when it was already in place before the heat arrived, which is the argument for forecasting the stress and not waiting to react to it. The agar heat sets do not rank the timings the same way, so the two platforms do not yet agree on a best timing.
blocks.zh: 後處理對 37 °C 熱逆境下的植物幫助最小，而且在兩次試驗中它的葉綠素與鮮重都低於熱逆境對照組，這正是在逆境已經傷害植物之後才施用保護劑的樣子。前處理在兩次試驗中都是三個時機裡保留最多葉綠素的，在試驗 1 高於熱逆境對照組，試驗 2 則沒有。因此在這個平台上，保護劑在熱到來之前就已經就位時作用最大，這正是支持預報逆境、而不是等著事後反應的論據。瓊脂的熱逆境各組對時機的排序並不相同，因此兩個平台目前對最佳時機還沒有一致的結論。

blocks.en: Our collaboration with the dry lab began with two practical questions: how much protectant would be required to improve plant performance, and how early would it need to be applied? Our plant data enter the Math Model at three points.
blocks.text: Our collaboration with the dry lab began with two practical questions: how much protectant would be required to improve plant performance, and how early would it need to be applied? Our plant data enter the Math Model at three points.
blocks.zh: 我們與乾實驗的協作始於兩個實務問題：要改善植物表現需要多少保護劑，以及需要多早施用。我們的植物數據在三個地方進入數學模型。

blocks.en: 74.95 → 1.36 mmMean root length from 0 to 150 mM NaCl, set 6: the salt calibration
blocks.text: 74.95 → 1.36 mmMean root length from 0 to 150 mM NaCl, set 6: the salt calibration
blocks.zh: 74.95 → 1.36 mm第 6 組中 0 至 150 mM NaCl 的平均根長：鹽度校正

blocks.en: 1.67 mLThree sprays on a 78.5 cm² plate, set 9: the dose the model scales to a hectare
blocks.text: 1.67 mLThree sprays on a 78.5 cm² plate, set 9: the dose the model scales to a hectare
blocks.zh: 1.67 mL第 9 組中噴在 78.5 cm² 培養盤上的三次噴量：模型換算到每公頃的劑量

blocks.en: 3 runs, 2 answersPre-, co- or post-treatment: when the protectant must arrive
blocks.text: 3 runs, 2 answersPre-, co- or post-treatment: when the protectant must arrive
blocks.zh: 3 次執行，2 種答案前處理、共處理或後處理：保護劑必須在什麼時候到達

blocks.en: Our original approach was to build a dose-response curve from protectant concentration and a rescue index. Trehalose first seemed suitable because we had run six sets, but in set 3 two trials of the same design gave opposing trends, and each condition was a single plate, so its seedlings were not independent replicates. Trehalose was only a commercial protectant we used as a sample to validate the protocol, never part of the circuit, so we left it out of the model: a model should represent what the experiments can support, not force uncertain data into a quantitative relationship.
blocks.text: Our original approach was to build a dose-response curve from protectant concentration and a rescue index. Trehalose first seemed suitable because we had run six sets, but in set 3 two trials of the same design gave opposing trends, and each condition was a single plate, so its seedlings were not independent replicates. Trehalose was only a commercial protectant we used as a sample to validate the protocol, never part of the circuit, so we left it out of the model: a model should represent what the experiments can support, not force uncertain data into a quantitative relationship.
blocks.zh: 我們原本的做法是用保護劑濃度與挽救指數建立劑量反應曲線。海藻糖起初看來合適，因為我們做了六組，但在第 3 組中同一設計的兩次試驗給出相反的趨勢，而每一種條件只有一盤，所以盤上的苗並不是獨立的重複。海藻糖只是我們用來驗證流程的市售樣品保護劑，從來不是迴路的一部分，因此我們把它從模型中排除：模型應該呈現實驗所能支持的內容，而不是把不確定的數據硬塞進一個定量關係裡。

blocks.en: The model now scales the dose we sprayed. Three sprays delivered 1.67 mL onto a 10 cm plate (78.5 cm²), the same rate as 2126 L per hectare; with a modeled rice canopy correction and our secreted activity of 7.25 mU mL<sup>−1</sup>, this becomes 37.6 kU of protectant per hectare per application. It is the dose that worked, not the smallest that works, because our sets varied salt level and timing but not the applied amount.
blocks.text: The model now scales the dose we sprayed. Three sprays delivered 1.67 mL onto a 10 cm plate (78.5 cm²), the same rate as 2126 L per hectare; with a modeled rice canopy correction and our secreted activity of 7.25 mU mL−1, this becomes 37.6 kU of protectant per hectare per application. It is the dose that worked, not the smallest that works, because our sets varied salt level and timing but not the applied amount.
blocks.zh: 模型現在換算的是我們噴施的劑量。三次噴施把 1.67 mL 送到一個 10 cm 培養盤（78.5 cm²）上，相當於每公頃 2126 L 的施用率；再加上模型對水稻葉幕的修正，以及我們分泌的活性 7.25 mU mL<sup>−1</sup>，換算後是每公頃每次施用 37.6 kU 的保護劑。這是有效的劑量，不是最小的有效劑量，因為我們各組變動的是鹽度與時機，而不是施用量。

blocks.en: A weather forecast reaches about three days ahead, but ten 20-liter reactors need 5.4 days to make one hectare’s application. The reactor therefore has to produce through the season, and the forecast decides when the stock is used; if the protectant must arrive a day before the stress, production has to start 6.4 days ahead.
blocks.text: A weather forecast reaches about three days ahead, but ten 20-liter reactors need 5.4 days to make one hectare’s application. The reactor therefore has to produce through the season, and the forecast decides when the stock is used; if the protectant must arrive a day before the stress, production has to start 6.4 days ahead.
blocks.zh: 天氣預報大約能看到三天之後，但十座 20 公升的反應器要花 5.4 天才能生產出一公頃一次的施用量。因此反應器必須在整個季節持續生產，而由預報決定庫存何時使用；如果保護劑必須在逆境前一天到達，生產就得提前 6.4 天開始。

blocks.en: Our timing runs do not agree. On agar at 75 mM NaCl, pre-treatment gave the highest fresh weight (0.164 g against 0.144 g for co-treatment). In soil at 300 mM, co-treatment led on chlorophyll per gram, but its tubes held 22 to 199 mg of tissue and chlorophyll per gram tracked tissue weight (r = −0.85); read as total chlorophyll, co-treatment came last. No run bounds how much yield the protectant recovers, so the model treats efficacy as an axis instead of a fixed value.
blocks.text: Our timing runs do not agree. On agar at 75 mM NaCl, pre-treatment gave the highest fresh weight (0.164 g against 0.144 g for co-treatment). In soil at 300 mM, co-treatment led on chlorophyll per gram, but its tubes held 22 to 199 mg of tissue and chlorophyll per gram tracked tissue weight (r = −0.85); read as total chlorophyll, co-treatment came last. No run bounds how much yield the protectant recovers, so the model treats efficacy as an axis instead of a fixed value.
blocks.zh: 我們的時機試驗並不一致。在瓊脂上 75 mM NaCl 下，前處理的鮮重最高（0.164 g，對上共處理的 0.144 g）。在土壤 300 mM 下，共處理的每公克葉綠素領先，但它的試管只有 22 到 199 mg 的組織，而每公克葉綠素又跟著組織重量走（r = −0.85）；若讀成總葉綠素，共處理反而是最後一名。沒有任何一次試驗能界定保護劑能挽回多少產量，因此模型把效力當成一個軸，而不是一個固定值。

blocks.en: Potting the soil arm of a timing run, July 25.
blocks.text: Potting the soil arm of a timing run, July 25.
blocks.zh: 7 月 25 日，為一次時機試驗的土壤組上盆。

blocks.en: Root length tracks growth inhibition, fresh weight tracks accumulated biomass, and chlorophyll reflects the condition of the photosynthetic tissue. We explored a stress index that compares each measurement with the unstressed control from the same experiment, so that a value near 1 is the matched control and a value approaching 0 is severe impairment.
blocks.text: Root length tracks growth inhibition, fresh weight tracks accumulated biomass, and chlorophyll reflects the condition of the photosynthetic tissue. We explored a stress index that compares each measurement with the unstressed control from the same experiment, so that a value near 1 is the matched control and a value approaching 0 is severe impairment.
blocks.zh: 根長反映生長抑制，鮮重反映累積的生物量，葉綠素則反映光合組織的狀況。我們探索了一種逆境指數，把每一項量測與同一次實驗中未受逆境的對照組相比，所以數值接近 1 代表與配對的對照組相當，接近 0 則代表嚴重受損。

blocks.en: The index also made data quality a central concern. Normalizing chlorophyll by fresh weight can make severely stressed plants appear to have more chlorophyll because their biomass is lower, so we keep the original measurements beside the index.
blocks.text: The index also made data quality a central concern. Normalizing chlorophyll by fresh weight can make severely stressed plants appear to have more chlorophyll because their biomass is lower, so we keep the original measurements beside the index.
blocks.zh: 這個指數也讓數據品質成為核心問題。以鮮重標準化葉綠素，可能讓受逆境嚴重的植物看起來葉綠素更多，只因為它們的生物量較低，所以我們把原始量測值與指數並列保留。

blocks.en: The model that uses these results →
blocks.text: The model that uses these results →
blocks.zh: 使用這些結果的模型 →

blocks.en: Our model in 4 parts, August 15: sensing, expression, transport and plant response. The plant-response part uses our plant data.
blocks.text: Our model in 4 parts, August 15: sensing, expression, transport and plant response. The plant-response part uses our plant data.
blocks.zh: 8 月 15 日，我們的模型分成 4 個部分：感測、表現、傳輸與植物反應。植物反應的部分使用我們的植物數據。

blocks.en: The updated model goes beyond a protectant concentration. It fits a stress index to 25 years of Taiwan’s county rice harvests, which gives 32% less county error than a no-weather trend in the second crop, sets the lamp level for the light-controlled production system, and turns our plate dose into equipment: 81 liters of vessel and about US$3800 of capital per hectare.
blocks.text: The updated model goes beyond a protectant concentration. It fits a stress index to 25 years of Taiwan’s county rice harvests, which gives 32% less county error than a no-weather trend in the second crop, sets the lamp level for the light-controlled production system, and turns our plate dose into equipment: 81 liters of vessel and about US$3800 of capital per hectare.
blocks.zh: 更新後的模型不只處理保護劑濃度。它把一個逆境指數配適到臺灣 25 年的各縣市稻作收成，在二期作上縣市層級的誤差比不含天氣的趨勢低 32%，並決定光控生產系統的燈光強度，也把我們培養盤上的劑量換算成設備：每公頃 81 公升的槽體與約 3800 美元的資本支出。

blocks.en: Two of its inputs come from our plates: the salt calibration of set 6 (74.95 mm without salt, 34.77 mm at 75 mM, 11.00 mm at 100 mM and 1.36 mm at 150 mM), which separates moderate stress from arrested growth, and the applied dose. The secreted activity rests on one DNPH assay below the quantification limit, and two readings of one tube put the apparent half-time of the protectant at 0.7 to 1.5 hours while a replicated run rose over its first eight hours of light, so the production and application figures are conditional projections, not validated capacities.
blocks.text: Two of its inputs come from our plates: the salt calibration of set 6 (74.95 mm without salt, 34.77 mm at 75 mM, 11.00 mm at 100 mM and 1.36 mm at 150 mM), which separates moderate stress from arrested growth, and the applied dose. The secreted activity rests on one DNPH assay below the quantification limit, and two readings of one tube put the apparent half-time of the protectant at 0.7 to 1.5 hours while a replicated run rose over its first eight hours of light, so the production and application figures are conditional projections, not validated capacities.
blocks.zh: 其中兩項輸入來自我們的培養盤：第 6 組的鹽度校正（未加鹽 74.95 mm、75 mM 下 34.77 mm、100 mM 下 11.00 mm、150 mM 下 1.36 mm），用來區分中度逆境與生長停滯；以及施用劑量。分泌活性只依據一次低於定量極限的 DNPH 檢測，而同一支試管的兩次判讀把保護劑的表觀半衰期定在 0.7 到 1.5 小時，另一次有重複的執行卻在最初八小時的光照中上升，因此生產與施用的數字是有條件的推估，不是已驗證的能力。

blocks.en: Together, the plant and dry lab work changed our objective from fitting a curve to our existing data to identifying the measurements a reliable model needs: independent replicates, a consistent treatment protocol, appropriate controls, and a dose-response series for ACC deaminase.
blocks.text: Together, the plant and dry lab work changed our objective from fitting a curve to our existing data to identifying the measurements a reliable model needs: independent replicates, a consistent treatment protocol, appropriate controls, and a dose-response series for ACC deaminase.
blocks.zh: 植物與乾實驗的工作合起來，把我們的目標從把曲線配適到既有數據，改成辨認一個可靠的模型需要哪些量測：獨立重複、一致的處理流程、適當的對照組，以及 ACC 去胺酶的劑量反應系列。

blocks.en: Between March and August we made thirteen visits involving researchers, farmers, agricultural businesses, and students. Each one exposed an assumption that was difficult to see from the bench. The full accounts are on Human Practices and Education.
blocks.text: Between March and August we made thirteen visits involving researchers, farmers, agricultural businesses, and students. Each one exposed an assumption that was difficult to see from the bench. The full accounts are on Human Practices and Education.
blocks.zh: 三月到八月之間，我們進行了十三次拜訪，對象包括研究人員、農友、農業企業與學生。每一次都點出一個在實驗桌前難以看見的假設。完整記錄在人類實踐與教育。

blocks.en: We arrived with no plants and no protocol. She showed us how her group grows Arabidopsis on agar and in hydroponics, gave us seeds, and told us to start on agar plates before moving carefully to soil.
blocks.text: We arrived with no plants and no protocol. She showed us how her group grows Arabidopsis on agar and in hydroponics, gave us seeds, and told us to start on agar plates before moving carefully to soil.
blocks.zh: 我們到的時候既沒有植物也沒有流程。她示範了她的團隊如何在瓊脂與水耕中培養 Arabidopsis，給了我們種子，並要我們先從瓊脂培養盤開始，再小心地轉到土壤。

blocks.en: His vertical Arabidopsis plates inspired our own vertical plate rack, which let roots grow along a visible surface. He also suggested ramping soil salinity gradually, which Prof. Cheng later found too mild for older plants.
blocks.text: His vertical Arabidopsis plates inspired our own vertical plate rack, which let roots grow along a visible surface. He also suggested ramping soil salinity gradually, which Prof. Cheng later found too mild for older plants.
blocks.zh: 他的垂直 Arabidopsis 培養盤啟發了我們自己的垂直盤架，讓根能沿著可見的表面生長。他也建議讓土壤鹽度逐步升高，不過 Prof. Cheng 後來發現這對較大的植物來說太溫和。

blocks.en: He prompted us to consider a recirculating hydroponic system and an automatically filled reservoir. Both share the same requirement: a growing platform has to stay manageable across the weeks of a run, not only through a short demonstration.
blocks.text: He prompted us to consider a recirculating hydroponic system and an automatically filled reservoir. Both share the same requirement: a growing platform has to stay manageable across the weeks of a run, not only through a short demonstration.
blocks.zh: 他促使我們考慮循環式水耕系統與自動補水的蓄液槽。兩者有同樣的要求：一個栽培平台必須在一次執行的數週間都維持可管理的狀態，而不只是撐過一場短暫的示範。

blocks.en: We came back with two hydroponic boxes and one problem: contamination. She helped us standardize plant age, treatment timing and sample conditions, which is where the 2-week testing window and the three fixed timings come from.
blocks.text: We came back with two hydroponic boxes and one problem: contamination. She helped us standardize plant age, treatment timing and sample conditions, which is where the 2-week testing window and the three fixed timings come from.
blocks.zh: 我們帶著兩個水耕箱與一個問題回去：污染。她幫我們把植物年齡、處理時機與樣品條件標準化，2 週的測試窗口與三個固定時機就是從這裡來的。

blocks.en: Taipei Expo Farmers Market<small>花博農民市集</small>
blocks.text: Taipei Expo Farmers Market花博農民市集

blocks.en: We interviewed over 30 organic, smallholder farmers. Diseases and pests came up more than weather, and they are not against using technology in the field as long as it is affordable, accessible, and practical for their farms.
blocks.text: We interviewed over 30 organic, smallholder farmers. Diseases and pests came up more than weather, and they are not against using technology in the field as long as it is affordable, accessible, and practical for their farms.
blocks.zh: 我們訪談了 30 多位有機小農。病害與蟲害被提到的次數多於天氣，而他們並不反對在田間使用技術，只要負擔得起、取得容易、對自己的農場實用。

blocks.en: We helped harvest okra and luffa and watched her read soil and plants. A natural farmer, she reminded us that giving too much can take away a plant's ability to thrive on its own. Her worry about seeds lost to typhoons became our seed-exchange platform.
blocks.text: We helped harvest okra and luffa and watched her read soil and plants. A natural farmer, she reminded us that giving too much can take away a plant's ability to thrive on its own. Her worry about seeds lost to typhoons became our seed-exchange platform.
blocks.zh: 我們幫忙採收秋葵與絲瓜，看著她讀土、讀植物。身為自然農法的農友，她提醒我們：給得太多，反而會奪走一株植物自己長好的能力。她對種子被颱風打壞的憂心，後來成了我們的種子交換平台。

blocks.en: We left with 富肽2號, the peptide behind experiment set 7. Its active components were not disclosed to us, so we treat it as a product-level comparison rather than evidence for a specific compound.
blocks.text: We left with 富肽2號, the peptide behind experiment set 7. Its active components were not disclosed to us, so we treat it as a product-level comparison rather than evidence for a specific compound.
blocks.zh: 我們帶走了富肽2號，也就是實驗第 7 組背後的那支胜肽。它的有效成分沒有對我們揭露，因此我們把它當成產品層級的比較，而不是某個特定化合物的證據。

blocks.en: Yes Health iFarm<small>源鮮智慧農場</small>

blocks.en: Rows of stacked hydroponic racks next to our 250 mL box. We redesigned our float plate the same day (it now has thirteen planting positions) and took home one rule: minimize plant transfers, because transplantation itself can induce stress.
blocks.text: Rows of stacked hydroponic racks next to our 250 mL box. We redesigned our float plate the same day (it now has thirteen planting positions) and took home one rule: minimize plant transfers, because transplantation itself can induce stress.
blocks.zh: 一排排堆疊的水耕架，就在我們 250 mL 的小盒旁邊。我們當天就重新設計了浮板（現在有十三個植栽位），並帶回一條規則：盡量減少植物的移植次數，因為移植本身就可能誘發逆境。
教室<small>144 位學生，5 所學校</small>

blocks.en: In “Plant Defenders”, elementary students watched spinach leaf disks float up a beaker as they photosynthesized and turned PET bottles into self-watering planters. At Fuxing High School on August 14 we went from DNA to food security, and learned to keep what a system is designed to do apart from what the evidence has shown.

At Fuxing High School on August 14 we went from DNA to food security, and learned to keep what a system is designed to do apart from what the evidence has shown.
blocks.zh: 在「Plant Defenders」課程中，國小學生看著菠菜葉圓片在燒杯裡隨光合作用浮起，並把 PET 瓶做成自動澆水盆器。8 月 14 日在 Fuxing High School，我們從 DNA 講到糧食安全，也學會把一套系統設計要做的事，與證據已經顯示的事分開來看。
