blocks.en: Our plant experiments, bioreactor and Taiwan crop-stress map in one exhibition, with a forum of more than 50 farmers, experts and neighbors. Making a project accessible should not mean overstating what it has achieved.
blocks.text: Our plant experiments, bioreactor and Taiwan crop-stress map in one exhibition, with a forum of more than 50 farmers, experts and neighbors. Making a project accessible should not mean overstating what it has achieved.
blocks.zh: 我們的植物實驗、生物反應器與臺灣作物逆境地圖在同一場展覽中，並有 50 多位農友、專家與鄰里居民參加的論壇。讓一個專題變得平易近人，不應該意味著誇大它已經達成的事。

blocks.en: We built a method for evaluating protectants under salinity and heat stress across agar, hydroponic and soil systems. These platforms let us test protectant dosage and application timing, and read the plant’s response through chlorophyll content, fresh weight and root growth.
blocks.text: We built a method for evaluating protectants under salinity and heat stress across agar, hydroponic and soil systems. These platforms let us test protectant dosage and application timing, and read the plant’s response through chlorophyll content, fresh weight and root growth.
blocks.zh: 我們建立了一套方法，在瓊脂、水耕與土壤系統中評估保護劑在鹽逆境與熱逆境下的表現。這些平台讓我們能測試保護劑的劑量與施用時機，並透過葉綠素含量、鮮重與根生長來讀取植物的反應。

blocks.en: Our results still ran into limits in replication, in the range of treatments tested, and in environmental control. The work ahead is aimed at those limits: how much protectant is needed, how precisely we can measure its effect, and how it should be applied in a real field cultivation system.
blocks.text: Our results still ran into limits in replication, in the range of treatments tested, and in environmental control. The work ahead is aimed at those limits: how much protectant is needed, how precisely we can measure its effect, and how it should be applied in a real field cultivation system.
blocks.zh: 我們的結果仍受限於重複次數、所測試的處理範圍，以及環境控制。接下來的工作就是針對這些限制：需要多少保護劑、我們能多精確地量測它的效果，以及在真實的田間栽培系統中該如何施用。

blocks.en: To decide how much protectant the bioreactor should produce, we need the minimum effective dose. Dilution series were run in the hydroponic system but never in soil, so the effective concentration in soil, and the volume that has to be applied to reach it, are still unknown. Further experiments will test a range of dilutions on soil-grown plants, and from there the amounts a real field would need.
blocks.text: To decide how much protectant the bioreactor should produce, we need the minimum effective dose. Dilution series were run in the hydroponic system but never in soil, so the effective concentration in soil, and the volume that has to be applied to reach it, are still unknown. Further experiments will test a range of dilutions on soil-grown plants, and from there the amounts a real field would need.
blocks.zh: 要決定生物反應器該生產多少保護劑，我們需要最小有效劑量。稀釋系列只在水耕系統中做過，從未在土壤中進行，因此土壤中的有效濃度，以及要達到該濃度所需施用的體積，仍然未知。後續實驗會在土壤栽培的植物上測試一系列稀釋倍數，並據此推算真實田區所需的用量。

blocks.en: Because of time constraints we rarely repeated an experiment across the three planting systems. The only runs with a repeat were ACC deaminase heat stress on agar and ACC deaminase heat stress in soil, and each of those has two trials, not three. We will aim for at least three independent replicates per condition, so that an improvement in fresh weight or chlorophyll content can be shown to be reproducible and not just read off a single plate or pot.
blocks.text: Because of time constraints we rarely repeated an experiment across the three planting systems. The only runs with a repeat were ACC deaminase heat stress on agar and ACC deaminase heat stress in soil, and each of those has two trials, not three. We will aim for at least three independent replicates per condition, so that an improvement in fresh weight or chlorophyll content can be shown to be reproducible and not just read off a single plate or pot.
blocks.zh: 由於時間限制，我們很少在三種栽培系統中重複同一個實驗。唯一有重複的是瓊脂上的 ACC 去胺酶熱逆境與土壤中的 ACC 去胺酶熱逆境，而這兩者各只有兩次試驗，不是三次。我們會以每種條件至少三次獨立重複為目標，這樣鮮重或葉綠素含量的改善才能被證明是可重現的，而不只是從單一培養盤或單一盆讀出來的。

blocks.en: Replication is also what the timing comparison needs. We applied protectants at pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment on agar and in soil, but the timing that performed best was not consistent across experiments. More replicates are what would settle which timing actually rescues the plants.
blocks.text: Replication is also what the timing comparison needs. We applied protectants at pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment on agar and in soil, but the timing that performed best was not consistent across experiments. More replicates are what would settle which timing actually rescues the plants.
blocks.zh: 時機的比較也需要重複。我們在瓊脂與土壤上於前處理、共處理與後處理施用保護劑，但表現最好的時機在各實驗之間並不一致。要確定哪一個時機真的挽救了植物，需要的就是更多重複。

blocks.en: The hydroponic prototypes improved across several designs: box size, seedling supports and 3D-printed components. Contamination, variable plant growth and the possible effect of the culture medium remain the real constraints.
blocks.text: The hydroponic prototypes improved across several designs: box size, seedling supports and 3D-printed components. Contamination, variable plant growth and the possible effect of the culture medium remain the real constraints.
blocks.zh: 水耕原型經過好幾版設計逐步改善：箱子尺寸、苗的支撐與 3D 列印元件。真正的限制仍是污染、植物生長不一致，以及培養液可能造成的影響。

blocks.en: Future hydroponic work will prioritize more consistent nutrient-solution conditions: a fixed interval for changing the medium, the volume of Bacillus subtilis culture standardized across every group, and evaporation accounted for instead of simply topped up. Without those three, a dilution series cannot be read as a dose, because the groups also differ in how much culture they received.
blocks.text: Future hydroponic work will prioritize more consistent nutrient-solution conditions: a fixed interval for changing the medium, the volume of Bacillus subtilis culture standardized across every group, and evaporation accounted for instead of simply topped up. Without those three, a dilution series cannot be read as a dose, because the groups also differ in how much culture they received.
blocks.zh: 未來的水耕工作會優先把養液條件做得更一致：固定的換液間隔、每一組都標準化的 Bacillus subtilis 培養液體積，以及把蒸發量計入而不是單純補滿。少了這三項，稀釋系列就不能讀成劑量，因為各組接受的培養液量也不同。

blocks.en: Our soil experiments show that the method used to induce stress strongly affects how the plants respond. The preliminary comparison of sub-irrigation against top-down application produced limited visible growth inhibition under the watering conditions we tested, while the top-down application of 100, then 200, then 300 mM NaCl produced much clearer salinity symptoms.
blocks.text: Our soil experiments show that the method used to induce stress strongly affects how the plants respond. The preliminary comparison of sub-irrigation against top-down application produced limited visible growth inhibition under the watering conditions we tested, while the top-down application of 100, then 200, then 300 mM NaCl produced much clearer salinity symptoms.
blocks.zh: 我們的土壤實驗顯示，誘發逆境所用的方法會強烈影響植物的反應。底部灌溉與由上施用的初步比較中，在我們測試的澆水條件下可見的生長抑制有限；而先 100、再 200、再 300 mM NaCl 的由上施用，則產生明顯清楚的鹽度徵狀。

blocks.en: Even so, the top-down method does not establish the salt concentration actually present around the roots. Drainage, dilution, evaporation and salt accumulation all change how much NaCl a plant takes up from the same applied dose. The next step is a standardized salinity schedule, with the three ACC deaminase timings compared against it, so that every pot receives the same salt load and the timings can be compared on equal terms. Once we have a treatment window, we will test intermediate times within it to find whether the effectiveness of ACC deaminase depends on a particular stage of stress development.
blocks.text: Even so, the top-down method does not establish the salt concentration actually present around the roots. Drainage, dilution, evaporation and salt accumulation all change how much NaCl a plant takes up from the same applied dose. The next step is a standardized salinity schedule, with the three ACC deaminase timings compared against it, so that every pot receives the same salt load and the timings can be compared on equal terms. Once we have a treatment window, we will test intermediate times within it to find whether the effectiveness of ACC deaminase depends on a particular stage of stress development.
blocks.zh: 即使如此，由上施用的方法並不能確立根部周圍實際存在的鹽濃度。排水、稀釋、蒸發與鹽的累積，都會改變同一施用劑量下植物實際吸收多少 NaCl。下一步是建立標準化的加鹽排程，並以此比較 ACC 去胺酶的三個時機，使每一盆接受相同的鹽負荷，讓各時機能在相同條件下比較。一旦有了處理窗口，我們會在窗口內測試中間的時間點，看 ACC 去胺酶的效果是否取決於逆境發展的某個特定階段。

blocks.en: The stress index gives us a way to use root length, fresh weight and chlorophyll together rather than choosing one of them, but the measurements behind it are not yet strong enough to fit a dose-response curve. Future experiments should prioritize independent replicates, a more consistent treatment protocol, appropriate controls, and a dose-response series for ACC deaminase. Those are the measurements that would let the model move from exploratory calculation to a prediction supported by experimental evidence.

Future experiments should prioritize independent replicates, a more consistent treatment protocol, appropriate controls, and a dose-response series for ACC deaminase. Those are the measurements that would let the model move from exploratory calculation to a prediction supported by experimental evidence.
blocks.zh: 逆境指數讓我們能把根長、鮮重與葉綠素一起使用，而不必從中挑一個，但支撐它的量測還不夠強，無法配適劑量反應曲線。後續實驗應優先取得獨立重複、更一致的處理流程、適當的對照組，以及 ACC 去胺酶的劑量反應系列。這些就是能讓模型從探索性計算走向有實驗證據支持的預測的量測。

attrs.en: The agar workflow drawn as one sheet. Agar salinity stress tests: agar preparation and initial germination, then three phases of salinity and protectant treatment (NaCl with trehalose, NaCl with CH Bio peptide, NaCl with ACC deaminase, LEA14 and BoPEP4). Below it the agar heat stress test at 37 degrees, then recording daily pictures and the data collected: root length in ImageJ, fresh weight, chlorophyll, malondialdehyde, total protein and relative gene expression.
attrs.zh: 瓊脂實驗流程畫成一張圖。瓊脂鹽逆境試驗：配製瓊脂與初期發芽，接著是三階段的鹽度與保護劑處理（NaCl 搭配海藻糖、NaCl 搭配 CH Bio 胜肽、NaCl 搭配 ACC 去胺酶、LEA14 與 BoPEP4）。下方是 37 度的瓊脂熱逆境試驗，然後是每日拍照記錄與收集的數據：以 ImageJ 量根長、鮮重、葉綠素、丙二醛、總蛋白質與相對基因表現量。

attrs.en: Agar design
attrs.zh: 瓊脂實驗設計

attrs.en: A timeline. Day 0 vernalize at 4 degrees; day 4 place in growth chamber; day 8 pre-treatment; day 9 co-treatment plus 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl to all corresponding groups; day 10 post-treatment; day 17 observe for 7 days: leaf area, chlorophyll extraction, fresh weight.
attrs.zh: 一條時間軸。第 0 天於 4 度春化；第 4 天放入生長箱；第 8 天前處理；第 9 天共處理，並對所有對應組加入 75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度的 NaCl；第 10 天後處理；第 17 天起觀察 7 天：葉面積、葉綠素萃取、鮮重。

attrs.en: A timeline. Day 0 stratify at 4 degrees; day 4 grow until 7 days old; day 11 pre-treatment, 3 sprays of TB medium on control groups; day 12 co-treatment, 3 sprays of corresponding 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl on stress groups; day 13 post-treatment; day 20, 7 days of observation: leaf area, chlorophyll extraction, fresh weight, MDA, total protein, relative gene expression.
attrs.zh: 一條時間軸。第 0 天於 4 度層積；第 4 天生長至 7 天齡；第 11 天前處理，對照組噴 3 次 TB 培養液；第 12 天共處理，逆境組噴 3 次對應的 75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl；第 13 天後處理；第 20 天起觀察 7 天：葉面積、葉綠素萃取、鮮重、MDA、總蛋白質、相對基因表現量。

attrs.en: The hydroponic box workflow drawn as one sheet. Down the left, preparation: box and board, seed holders, seed-holder agar, medium, and planting Arabidopsis seeds in the holders. On the right, salinity and protectant treatment in two phases. Phase 1, NaCl with CH Bio peptide: 4-day-old seedlings into 300 millilitres of 0.1 times MS medium, 10 days old, then 600 microlitres of CH Bio peptide and 290 millilitres of medium with 10 millilitres of 3 molar NaCl, the peptide removed 3 days after, 7 days of observation. Phase 2 repeats this with ACC deaminase or BoPEP4 at 1/40 WB800, 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100. Below, the heat stress test: boxes into a 37 degree incubator, protectants added once the medium reaches 37 degrees, three days of observation, then the protectant removed, the plants moved to fresh medium and a 22 degree incubator for 7 days of observation.
attrs.zh: 水耕箱實驗流程畫成一張圖。左側自上而下是準備工作：箱子與浮板、種子座、種子座瓊脂、培養液，以及把阿拉伯芥種子種進種子座。右側是兩階段的鹽度與保護劑處理。階段 1，NaCl 搭配 CH Bio 胜肽：4 天齡的苗移入 300 毫升 0.1 倍 MS 培養液，長到 10 天齡，再加入 600 微升 CH Bio 胜肽與 290 毫升培養液，其中含 10 毫升 3 莫耳濃度 NaCl，3 天後移除胜肽，觀察 7 天。階段 2 以 ACC 去胺酶或 BoPEP4 重複同樣步驟，稀釋倍數為 1/40 WB800、1/40、1/60、1/80 與 1/100。下方是熱逆境試驗：把箱子放入 37 度培養箱，待培養液達 37 度後加入保護劑，觀察三天，然後移除保護劑，把植物移到新鮮培養液與 22 度培養箱，再觀察 7 天。

attrs.en: The hydroponic rack workflow drawn as one sheet. The same preparation down the left. On the right, salinity and protectant treatment on racks: 2.1 millilitres of 0.1 times MS medium a well at 7 days old, changed to 1.9 millilitres at 10 days old, then a master mix made for each treatment from WB800, 0.1 times MS medium, ACC deaminase or BoPEP4, and PLP at 1/100 for ACC deaminase only. Each labelled rack takes 2.1 millilitres of its master mix and 0.07 millilitres of 3 molar NaCl, the plants go back to the rack, and 7 days of observation follow. Below, the heat stress test runs the same way for the ACC deaminase combinations and finishes in a 37 degree incubator with 7 days of observation.
attrs.zh: 水耕試管架實驗流程畫成一張圖。左側是同樣的準備工作。右側是試管架上的鹽度與保護劑處理：7 天齡時每孔 2.1 毫升 0.1 倍 MS 培養液，10 天齡時改為 1.9 毫升，接著為每種處理以 WB800、0.1 倍 MS 培養液、ACC 去胺酶或 BoPEP4，以及僅在 ACC 去胺酶組加入 1/100 的 PLP，配成母液。每個貼好標籤的試管架取 2.1 毫升自己的母液與 0.07 毫升 3 莫耳濃度 NaCl，再把植物放回架上，隨後觀察 7 天。下方的熱逆境試驗對 ACC 去胺酶的各組合以相同方式進行，最後放入 37 度培養箱觀察 7 天。

attrs.en: The hydroponic preparation drawn as one sheet. Top, the experiment overview: Arabidopsis seeds germinated on a tube rack, then moved either to hydroponic tip boxes or kept on tube racks for salinity and heat treatment. Below, seed holder preparation (Eppendorf caps cut and punched with a 3 millimetre hole, kept in a foil-wrapped beaker), the 0.6% seed-holder agar, 0.1% MS medium preparation with the pH adjusted to 5.7 to 5.8 with 1 molar KOH, and planting Arabidopsis seeds in the holders.
attrs.zh: 水耕準備工作畫成一張圖。上方是實驗概覽：阿拉伯芥種子在試管架上發芽，之後或移入水耕吸頭盒、或留在試管架上進行鹽度與熱處理。下方是種子座的製作（把 Eppendorf 管蓋剪開並打出 3 毫米的孔，存放在包鋁箔的燒杯中）、0.6% 種子座瓊脂、0.1% MS 培養液的配製（以 1 莫耳濃度 KOH 將 pH 調到 5.7 至 5.8），以及把阿拉伯芥種子種進種子座。

attrs.en: The soil workflow drawn in three panels. Soil medium preparation and seed sowing; stress conditioning and plant set-up, with a salinity row (pre-treatment, co-treatment with NaCl, then 200 and 300 millimolar NaCl, post-treatment, no watering between) and a heat row (pre-treatment, co-treatment with heat stress in the incubator at 37 degrees, five days of observation, post-treatment); and phenotypic evaluation: fresh weight, chlorophyll extraction, anthocyanin, morphology and rosette area.
attrs.zh: 土壤實驗流程畫成三格。第一格是介質配製與播種；第二格是逆境條件設定與植株配置，含鹽度一排（前處理、與 NaCl 共處理、接著 200 與 300 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl、後處理，期間不澆水）與熱一排（前處理、在 37 度培養箱中以熱逆境共處理、觀察五天、後處理）；第三格是表現型評估：鮮重、葉綠素萃取、花青素、形態與蓮座葉叢面積。

attrs.en: Eight square plates in two rows. Top row 0 millimolar NaCl, bottom row 100 millimolar NaCl; columns 0, 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 millimolar trehalose. Two of the top-row plates carry large white fungal growth.
attrs.zh: 八個方盤排成兩排。上排為 0 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl，下排為 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl；由左至右四欄分別為 0、0.25、0.5 與 1.0 毫莫耳濃度海藻糖。上排有兩盤長出大片白色真菌。

attrs.en: Four panels: fresh weight; relative chlorophyll content with fresh weight normalization, with significance brackets; relative chlorophyll content without normalization, with a red box around the 100 millimolar groups; primary root length box plot. Groups are 0, 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 millimolar trehalose at 0 and 100 millimolar NaCl.
attrs.zh: 四個圖板：鮮重；以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素含量，附顯著性標記；未標準化的相對葉綠素含量，100 毫莫耳濃度各組以紅框標出；主根長度盒形圖。各組為 0 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 下的 0、0.25、0.5 與 1.0 毫莫耳濃度海藻糖。

attrs.en: A grid of square plates. Top row 0 millimolar NaCl, tall seedlings with long roots; second row 150 millimolar, short seedlings; third row 250 millimolar, two plates marked ND and two with tiny seedlings. Columns 0, 1, 5 and 10 millimolar trehalose.
attrs.zh: 方盤排成格狀。上排為 0 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl，苗高、根長；第二排為 150 毫莫耳濃度，苗矮小；第三排為 250 毫莫耳濃度，兩盤標示 ND，兩盤只有極小的苗。四欄分別為 0、1、5 與 10 毫莫耳濃度海藻糖。

attrs.en: Four panels: fresh weight; relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization, with brackets at 150 millimolar; relative total chlorophyll; primary root length. Several 250 millimolar groups are marked ND.
attrs.zh: 四個圖板：鮮重；以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，150 毫莫耳濃度處有顯著性標記；相對總葉綠素；主根長度。有幾個 250 毫莫耳濃度組標示 ND。

attrs.en: The 150 and 250 millimolar NaCl rows of set 5 cut out from the plate grid: short seedlings at 150 millimolar, two 250 millimolar plates with tiny seedlings and two marked ND.
attrs.zh: 從培養盤格狀圖中切出第 5 組的 150 與 250 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 兩排：150 毫莫耳濃度的苗矮小，250 毫莫耳濃度有兩盤只有極小的苗、兩盤標示 ND。

attrs.en: Eight square plates in two rows, 0 millimolar trehalose on top and 5 millimolar below; columns 0, 75, 100 and 150 millimolar NaCl. Seedlings shrink sharply from left to right in both rows.
attrs.zh: 八個方盤排成兩排，上排為 0 毫莫耳濃度海藻糖，下排為 5 毫莫耳濃度；四欄分別為 0、75、100 與 150 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl。兩排的苗都由左至右急遽變小。

attrs.en: Four panels: fresh weight; relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization, with significance brackets at 75, 100 and 150 millimolar and a red box around 100 millimolar; relative chlorophyll without normalization, with brackets at 75 and 100 millimolar; primary root length.
attrs.zh: 四個圖板：鮮重；以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，75、100 與 150 毫莫耳濃度處有顯著性標記，100 毫莫耳濃度以紅框標出；未標準化的相對葉綠素，75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度處有標記；主根長度。

attrs.en: Round plates. Left, a 0 millimolar plate. Right, a two by three grid: rows control and 100 millimolar NaCl, columns pre-, co- and post-treatment with CH Bio peptide.
attrs.zh: 圓盤。左方是一盤 0 毫莫耳濃度。右方是二乘三的格狀排列：兩排為對照組與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl，三欄為 CH Bio 胜肽的前處理、共處理與後處理。

attrs.en: Three panels for pre-, co- and post-treatment at 0 and 100 millimolar NaCl: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization, and relative chlorophyll without normalization, with significance brackets.
attrs.zh: 三個圖板，呈現 0 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 下的前處理、共處理與後處理：鮮重、以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，以及未標準化的相對葉綠素，附顯著性標記。

attrs.en: Round plates. Left, one plate with no CH Bio peptide at 0 millimolar NaCl. Right, a two by three grid: rows 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl, columns no peptide added, co-treatment and post-treatment, with red, purple and blue guide lines.
attrs.zh: 圓盤。左方是一盤 0 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl、未加 CH Bio 胜肽。右方是二乘三的格狀排列：兩排為 75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl，三欄為未加胜肽、共處理與後處理，並有紅、紫、藍色的輔助線。

attrs.en: Three panels for the control with no peptide, co- and post-treatment at 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl: fresh weight, and relative chlorophyll content in two forms, with significance brackets.
attrs.zh: 三個圖板，呈現 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 下未加胜肽的對照組、共處理與後處理：鮮重，以及兩種形式的相對葉綠素含量，附顯著性標記。

attrs.en: A three by four grid of round plates: rows 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl; columns no ACCD added, pre-treatment, co-treatment and after-treatment. The 100 millimolar co-treatment plate is overgrown.
attrs.zh: 圓盤排成三乘四的格狀：三排為 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl；四欄為未加 ACCD、前處理、共處理與後處理。100 毫莫耳濃度的共處理盤過度生長。

attrs.en: Three panels for no ACCD, pre-, co- and post-treatment at 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization, and without. Error bars are wide in the chlorophyll panels.
attrs.zh: 三個圖板，呈現 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 下未加 ACCD、前處理、共處理與後處理：鮮重、以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，以及未標準化者。葉綠素圖板的誤差線很寬。

attrs.en: A three by four grid of round plates. Rows 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl; columns no ACCD added, pre-, co- and post-treatment ACC deaminase. The pre-treatment plates show the densest green rosettes at every salt level; the 100 millimolar post-treatment plate is marked ND.
attrs.zh: 圓盤排成三乘四的格狀。三排為 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl；四欄為未加 ACCD、以及 ACC 去胺酶的前處理、共處理與後處理。各鹽度下前處理盤的綠色蓮座葉叢都最密；100 毫莫耳濃度的後處理盤標示 ND。

attrs.en: Three panels for no ACCD, pre-, co- and post-treatment at 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization with several significance brackets, and without normalization. The post-treatment 100 millimolar group is marked ND.
attrs.zh: 三個圖板，呈現 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 下未加 ACCD、前處理、共處理與後處理：鮮重、以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素（有數個顯著性標記），以及未標準化者。後處理的 100 毫莫耳濃度組標示 ND。

attrs.en: A three by three grid of round plates labelled a to i. Rows 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl; columns no BoPEP4 added, co-treatment and post-treatment BoPEP4. The co-treatment plates are the most yellowed.
attrs.zh: 圓盤排成三乘三的格狀，標示 a 到 i。三排為 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl；三欄為未加 BoPEP4、以及 BoPEP4 的共處理與後處理。共處理的盤子黃化最嚴重。

attrs.en: Three panels for no BoPEP4 added, co- and post-treatment, each with bars for 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization carrying significance brackets on the post-treatment group, and relative total chlorophyll with brackets on the untreated and post-treatment groups.
attrs.zh: 三個圖板，呈現未加 BoPEP4、共處理與後處理，每個圖板都有 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 的長條：鮮重；以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，後處理組上有顯著性標記；相對總葉綠素，未處理組與後處理組上有標記。

attrs.en: A three by three grid of round plates labelled a to i. Rows 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl; columns no AtLEA14 added, pre-treatment and post-treatment AtLEA14. The 0 millimolar post-treatment plate is marked ND. Every plate has green rosettes, with the densest foliage in the 75 millimolar pre- and post-treatment plates.
attrs.zh: 圓盤排成三乘三的格狀，標示 a 到 i。三排為 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl；三欄為未加 AtLEA14、以及 AtLEA14 的前處理與後處理。0 毫莫耳濃度的後處理盤標示 ND。每一盤都有綠色的蓮座葉叢，其中 75 毫莫耳濃度的前處理與後處理盤葉片最密。

attrs.en: Three panels for no LEA14 added, pre-treatment and post-treatment, each with bars for 0, 75 and 100 millimolar NaCl: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization carrying one significance bracket, and relative chlorophyll without normalization.
attrs.zh: 三個圖板，呈現未加 LEA14、前處理與後處理，每個圖板都有 0、75 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 的長條：鮮重；以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，上有一個顯著性標記；未標準化的相對葉綠素。

attrs.en: Two rows of seedlings photographed on black. Top, no heat stress at 22 degrees; bottom, heat stress thermo priming at 37 degrees. Columns no ACCD added, pre-treat, co-treat and post-treat ACCD. Two groups are marked contaminated.
attrs.zh: 兩排苗在黑色背景上拍攝。上排為 22 度、無熱逆境；下排為 37 度的熱逆境熱預備處理。四欄為未加 ACCD、以及 ACCD 的前處理、共處理與後處理。有兩組標示污染。

attrs.en: Four panels for no ACCD, pre-, co- and post-treatment ACCD with no heat stress and with 37 degree thermo priming: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization, without normalization, and primary root length.
attrs.zh: 四個圖板，呈現未加 ACCD 與 ACCD 的前處理、共處理、後處理，在無熱逆境與 37 度熱預備處理兩種條件下：鮮重、以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素、未標準化者，以及主根長度。

attrs.en: Two rows of seedlings laid out on black. Top, no heat stress at 22 degrees; bottom, heat stress thermo priming at 37 degrees. Columns no ACCD added, pretreat, cotreat and posttreat ACCD. The heat-stressed rows are much smaller, and the post-treatment group keeps the most green tissue.
attrs.zh: 兩排苗攤放在黑色背景上。上排為 22 度、無熱逆境；下排為 37 度的熱逆境熱預備處理。四欄為未加 ACCD、以及 ACCD 的前處理、共處理與後處理。受熱逆境的那排小得多，而後處理組保留最多綠色組織。

attrs.en: Two panels for no ACCD, pre-, co- and post-treatment ACCD with and without 37 degree thermo priming: fresh weight, and relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization carrying three significance brackets on the unstressed groups.
attrs.zh: 兩個圖板，呈現未加 ACCD 與 ACCD 的前處理、共處理、後處理，在有與沒有 37 度熱預備處理的條件下：鮮重，以及以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，未受逆境各組上有三個顯著性標記。

attrs.en: Hydroponic tests, grouped by protectant
attrs.zh: 水耕試驗，依保護劑分組

attrs.en: A timeline. 7/25, Arabidopsis day 10, pre-treatment, add CH Bio peptide. 7/28, day 13, all hydroponic boxes add 100 millimolar NaCl and co-treatment adds CH Bio peptide. 7/31, day 16, post-treatment adds CH Bio peptide. 8/4, day 20, end test, chlorophyll extraction.
attrs.zh: 一條時間軸。7/25，阿拉伯芥第 10 天，前處理，加入 CH Bio 胜肽。7/28，第 13 天，所有水耕箱加入 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl，共處理組加入 CH Bio 胜肽。7/31，第 16 天，後處理組加入 CH Bio 胜肽。8/4，第 20 天，試驗結束，進行葉綠素萃取。

attrs.en: A hydroponic box seen from above after 7 days of 100 millimolar NaCl, no peptide: pale, yellowed rosettes.
attrs.zh: 一個水耕箱的俯視圖，經過 7 天 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl、未加胜肽：蓮座葉叢蒼白、黃化。

attrs.en: The pre-treatment box from above: small rosettes, several pale.
attrs.zh: 前處理箱的俯視圖：蓮座葉叢小，有幾株蒼白。

attrs.en: The co-treatment box from above: the greenest and largest rosettes.
attrs.zh: 共處理箱的俯視圖：蓮座葉叢最綠、最大。

attrs.en: The post-treatment box from above: small, yellowing rosettes.
attrs.zh: 後處理箱的俯視圖：蓮座葉叢小且轉黃。

attrs.en: Three bar panels, each with four bars in the order control, pre-treatment, co-treatment, post-treatment: fresh weight in grams, chlorophyll content per plant number, and relative chlorophyll content. No error bars.
attrs.zh: 三個長條圖板，每板依對照組、前處理、共處理、後處理的順序各有四根長條：以公克計的鮮重、每株植物的葉綠素含量，以及相對葉綠素含量。沒有誤差線。

attrs.en: A timeline. 8/14, day 11, pre-treatment. 8/15, day 12, co-treatment, heat stress begins, pre-treatment peptide removed. 8/16, day 13, post-treatment, co-treatment peptide removed. 8/17, day 14, post-treatment peptide removed. 8/22, day 19, end test, chlorophyll extraction. Heat stress spans 7 days.
attrs.zh: 一條時間軸。8/14，第 11 天，前處理。8/15，第 12 天，共處理，熱逆境開始，移除前處理的胜肽。8/16，第 13 天，後處理，移除共處理的胜肽。8/17，第 14 天，移除後處理的胜肽。8/22，第 19 天，試驗結束，進行葉綠素萃取。熱逆境橫跨 7 天。

attrs.en: The heat control box from above: green rosettes in a black float board.
attrs.zh: 熱逆境對照箱的俯視圖：黑色浮板上的綠色蓮座葉叢。

attrs.en: The heat pre-treatment box from above.
attrs.zh: 熱逆境前處理箱的俯視圖。

attrs.en: The heat co-treatment box from above.
attrs.zh: 熱逆境共處理箱的俯視圖。

attrs.en: The heat post-treatment box from above.
attrs.zh: 熱逆境後處理箱的俯視圖。

attrs.en: Three bar panels after heat, each with four bars in the order control, pre-treatment, co-treatment, post-treatment: fresh weight in grams, chlorophyll content per plant number, and relative chlorophyll content. No error bars.
attrs.zh: 熱逆境後的三個長條圖板，每板依對照組、前處理、共處理、後處理的順序各有四根長條：以公克計的鮮重、每株植物的葉綠素含量，以及相對葉綠素含量。沒有誤差線。

attrs.en: Arabidopsis seedlings on a blue tube rack, treated with B. subtilis-containing TB medium at dilutions 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 and 0, at pH 5.7 in the top row and pH 7 below.
attrs.zh: 藍色試管架上的阿拉伯芥苗，以含枯草桿菌（B. subtilis）的 TB 培養液處理，稀釋倍數為 1、1/2、1/4、1/8、1/16 與 0，上排為 pH 5.7，下排為 pH 7。

attrs.en: Bar chart of fresh weight per group for 0, 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16 WB800 at pH 5.7 and pH 7.1.
Bar chart of chlorophyll content per plant for the same groups, with every diluted group significantly below the 0 WB800 control at both pH values.
attrs.zh: 同樣各組每株葉綠素含量的長條圖；在兩個 pH 值下，每一個稀釋組都顯著低於 0 WB800 對照組。

attrs.en: A tube rack photographed from above, labelled in red. Rows of seedlings at 1/60, 1/40, 1/20 and 1/10 ACCD and 0 ACCD, at 0 and 100 millimolar NaCl, with 1/20 TB medium controls along the bottom.
attrs.zh: 試管架的俯視照，以紅字標示。各排苗分別為 1/60、1/40、1/20 與 1/10 ACCD 以及 0 ACCD，在 0 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 下，底部一排是 1/20 TB 培養液對照組。

attrs.en: Bar chart of fresh weight for 1/20 WB800, 1/10, 1/20, 1/40, 1/60 and 0 ACCD at 0 and 100 mM NaCl.
attrs.zh: 0 與 100 mM NaCl 下 1/20 WB800 以及 1/10、1/20、1/40、1/60 與 0 ACCD 鮮重的長條圖。

attrs.en: Bar chart of chlorophyll content per plant for the same ACCD groups at 0 and 100 mM NaCl.
attrs.zh: 0 與 100 mM NaCl 下同樣各 ACCD 組每株葉綠素含量的長條圖。

attrs.en: A blue tube rack from above, labelled in red: ACCD at 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100, BoPEP4 at the same four dilutions, and 1/40 WB800 and 0.1 times MS medium controls. The rosettes are green.
attrs.zh: 藍色試管架的俯視照，以紅字標示：1/40、1/60、1/80 與 1/100 的 ACCD、同樣四種稀釋倍數的 BoPEP4，以及 1/40 WB800 與 0.1 倍 MS 培養液對照組。蓮座葉叢呈綠色。

attrs.en: The same labelled layout on a white rack after heat: most rosettes are bleached white, a few of the ACCD groups still carry green leaves.
attrs.zh: 熱逆境後白色試管架上的同一套標示配置：大多數蓮座葉叢已白化，少數 ACCD 組仍有綠葉。

attrs.en: Bar chart of fresh weight for 0.1x MS medium, 1/40 WB800 and 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100 ACCD, without and with heat.
attrs.zh: 0.1x MS 培養液、1/40 WB800 以及 1/40、1/60、1/80 與 1/100 ACCD 在無熱與有熱條件下鮮重的長條圖。

attrs.en: Bar chart of chlorophyll content per plant for the same ACCD groups, without and with heat.
attrs.zh: 同樣各 ACCD 組在無熱與有熱條件下每株葉綠素含量的長條圖。

attrs.en: Bar chart of fresh weight for 0.1x MS medium, 1/40 WB800 and 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100 BoPep4, without and with heat.
attrs.zh: 0.1x MS 培養液、1/40 WB800 以及 1/40、1/60、1/80 與 1/100 BoPep4 在無熱與有熱條件下鮮重的長條圖。

attrs.en: Bar chart of chlorophyll content per plant for the same BoPep4 groups, without and with heat.
attrs.zh: 同樣各 BoPep4 組在無熱與有熱條件下每株葉綠素含量的長條圖。

attrs.en: A green tube rack from above, labelled in red: BoPEP4 at 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100 with 1/40 WB800 and 0.1 times MS medium controls, at 0 and 100 millimolar NaCl. The salt rows are mostly bleached.
attrs.zh: 綠色試管架的俯視照，以紅字標示：1/40、1/60、1/80 與 1/100 的 BoPEP4，以及 1/40 WB800 與 0.1 倍 MS 培養液對照組，在 0 與 100 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 下。加鹽的那幾排大多已白化。

attrs.en: Bar chart of fresh weight for 0.1x MS medium, 1/40 WB800 and 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100 BoPep4, at 0 and 100 mM NaCl.
attrs.zh: 0 與 100 mM NaCl 下 0.1x MS 培養液、1/40 WB800 以及 1/40、1/60、1/80 與 1/100 BoPep4 鮮重的長條圖。

attrs.en: Bar chart of chlorophyll content per plant for the same BoPep4 groups, at 0 and 100 mM NaCl.
attrs.zh: 0 與 100 mM NaCl 下同樣各 BoPep4 組每株葉綠素含量的長條圖。

attrs.en: Soil trials, in date order
attrs.zh: 土壤試驗，依日期排列

attrs.en: Four soil pots from above in two rows. Left column accumulation method, right column wash method. Top row day 0 of salinity, bottom row day 5, where the wash pot carries smaller and paler rosettes than the accumulation pot.
attrs.zh: 四個土壤盆的俯視圖，排成兩排。左欄為累積法，右欄為沖洗法。上排為鹽度處理第 0 天，下排為第 5 天；第 5 天沖洗法的盆中蓮座葉叢比累積法的更小、更蒼白。

attrs.en: Bar chart of fresh weight in grams. Prof Cheng wash method about 0.15, 100 millimolar accumulate about 0.42.
attrs.zh: 以公克計的鮮重長條圖。Prof Cheng 沖洗法約 0.15，100 毫莫耳濃度累積法約 0.42。

attrs.en: Bar chart of relative chlorophyll content in milligrams per litre. Both methods sit near 1.0, the wash method with a wider error bar.
attrs.zh: 以每公升毫克計的相對葉綠素含量長條圖。兩種方法都接近 1.0，沖洗法的誤差線較寬。

attrs.en: Eight soil pots from above in two rows of four: control in TB medium, pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment ACC deaminase, all with 300 millimolar NaCl. Top row the first day, bottom row the last; by the last day the co-treatment pot is the most bleached and the post-treatment pot keeps the most green rosettes.
attrs.zh: 八個土壤盆的俯視圖，排成兩排各四盆：TB 培養液對照組，以及 ACC 去胺酶的前處理、共處理與後處理，全都加 300 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl。上排為第一天，下排為最後一天；到最後一天，共處理盆白化最嚴重，後處理盆保留最多綠色的蓮座葉叢。

attrs.en: Three panels for the TB control and pre-, co- and post-treatment ACC deaminase at 300 millimolar NaCl: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization where co-treatment is highest, and relative chlorophyll without normalization where post-treatment is highest.
attrs.zh: 三個圖板，呈現 300 毫莫耳濃度 NaCl 下的 TB 對照組與 ACC 去胺酶的前處理、共處理、後處理：鮮重；以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，其中共處理最高；未標準化的相對葉綠素，其中後處理最高。

attrs.en: Soil pots photographed from above. At the left, the unstressed control with no ACC deaminase. To the right, two rows of four heat-stressed pots, trial 1 above and trial 2 below: control, pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment ACC deaminase. The post-treatment pots carry purple leaves and tall bolting stems.
attrs.zh: 土壤盆的俯視照。左方是未受逆境、未加 ACC 去胺酶的對照組。右方是兩排各四盆受熱逆境的盆，上排為試驗 1、下排為試驗 2：對照組，以及 ACC 去胺酶的前處理、共處理與後處理。後處理的盆有紫色葉片與抽高的花梗。

attrs.en: Trial 1, three bar panels for the unstressed control and the heat-stressed control, pre-, co- and post-treatment ACC deaminase: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization, and relative chlorophyll without normalization.
attrs.zh: 試驗 1，三個長條圖板，呈現未受逆境的對照組與受熱逆境的對照組，以及 ACC 去胺酶的前處理、共處理與後處理：鮮重、以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，以及未標準化的相對葉綠素。

attrs.en: Trial 2, the same three bar panels: fresh weight, relative chlorophyll with fresh weight normalization, and relative chlorophyll without normalization.
attrs.zh: 試驗 2，同樣的三個長條圖板：鮮重、以鮮重標準化的相對葉綠素，以及未標準化的相對葉綠素。

attrs.en: Three team members potting Arabidopsis seedlings into small pots at the bench.
attrs.zh: 三位團隊成員在實驗桌前把阿拉伯芥苗移植到小盆中。

attrs.en: A hand-drawn four-part sketch of the maths model, illustrations along the top and the corresponding equations underneath each one.
attrs.zh: 手繪的四部分數學模型草圖，上方是插圖，每張插圖下方是對應的方程式。

attrs.en: Prof. Cheng holding up an Arabidopsis agar plate in front of an open growth chamber, students around her taking photos.
attrs.zh: Prof. Cheng 在打開的生長箱前舉起一盤阿拉伯芥瓊脂培養盤，身旁的學生在拍照。

attrs.en: A hand pointing into a lit growth chamber holding rows of vertical Arabidopsis agar plates.
attrs.zh: 一隻手指向亮著燈的生長箱，箱內是一排排垂直擺放的阿拉伯芥瓊脂培養盤。

attrs.en: Prof. Chen standing beside a wall display showing the team's own slide about auto-filling medium, two students standing with him.
attrs.zh: Prof. Chen 站在牆面顯示器旁，螢幕上是團隊自己做的自動補液投影片，兩位學生與他同站。

attrs.en: Prof. Cheng and a student standing together in her laboratory beside the team's hydroponic boxes.
attrs.zh: Prof. Cheng 與一位學生一同站在她的實驗室裡，旁邊是團隊的水耕箱。

attrs.en: A grower in a green apron explaining his produce to three students at his stall.
attrs.zh: 一位穿綠色圍裙的農友在攤位前向三位學生介紹自己的農產品。

attrs.en: Ms. Chen and students harvesting among tall okra plants.
attrs.zh: Ms. Chen 與學生在高大的秋葵植株間採收。

attrs.en: A researcher presenting to students in a showroom lined with research posters and shelves of product bottles.
attrs.zh: 一位研究人員在陳列著研究海報與一架架產品瓶的展示間向學生介紹。

attrs.en: Two students looking at a wall of stacked hydroponic racks under purple grow lights.
attrs.zh: 兩位學生看著紫色植物燈下層層堆疊的水耕架。

attrs.en: A team member demonstrating the spinach leaf-disk experiment to elementary students seated around a table.
attrs.zh: 一位團隊成員向圍桌而坐的國小學生示範菠菜葉圓片實驗。

attrs.en: A student cutting and assembling a plastic bottle into a self-watering planter at a lab bench.
attrs.zh: 一位學生在實驗桌上剪裁並組裝塑膠瓶，做成自動澆水盆器。

attrs.en: Visitors leaning in to look at the bioreactor prototype glowing green inside its black case.
attrs.zh: 參觀者湊近觀看黑色機殼內發出綠光的生物反應器原型。

attrs.en: A team member explaining a map of crop stress across Taiwan to visitors at the booth.
attrs.zh: 一位團隊成員在攤位向參觀者解說全臺作物逆境地圖。

attrs.en: Plant notebook record
attrs.zh: 植物實驗記錄簿
